docs.title: FontLab Scriptmix
docs.text:
Scriptmix contains small scripts for FontLab's Scripts menu. Use the reports to inspect an open font. Use the editors to preview a change before you apply it. Canvas reporters draw on the Glyph window without changing the font.

Start with installation. The script catalogue contains the purpose and complete source of every current menu script.

The working with scripts page explains font selection, previews and window cleanup. The documentation guide explains how to rebuild this site from the checked-out source.

docs.title: Porting backlog
docs.text:
The active menu contains 99 practical tools: 69 sample adaptations and 30 additional tools. Source and native acceptance differ; new reviewed candidates retain their pending native status in additional-tools.json and their docstrings.

These 61 archived launchers were removed from Scripts, not completed. Every original remains byte-exact under rescued/. rescue-index.json retains the historical menu path, source path and SHA-256. The other 69 sample originals also remain preserved. The sample migration denominator stays 130; released acceptance remains 68/130, with the Italic Angle candidate and these 61 ports still subject to their existing gates. The wider Glyphs source corpus, PythonQt adaptations, package cleanup and native acceptance remain in scope.

docs.title: Build and edit the documentation
docs.text:
The source configuration is src_docs/mkdocs.yml. Authored pages are in src_docs/md. The build writes the static site to docs.

./build.sh
./build.sh --offline
./build.sh --serve

The first build needs network access to install the packages pinned in uv.lock. Use --offline after those packages are cached. The build needs Python 3.12 or later and uv. It does not start FontLab or execute the scripts shown on a page.

Serve starts a local preview. Live Edit is available only in that preview; it saves changes to the authored Markdown. The static site has no editing server. Edit generated catalogue pages through their source generator, because the next build replaces them.

docs.title: Include source and shared text
docs.text:
Use codeinclude for an executable script. The plugin reads the actual source file, so the displayed code follows changes to that file. Do not paste a second copy of the script into Markdown. Use include-markdown for shared prose. Use mkdocstrings with Python inspection disabled when documenting an importable module. Menu scripts and archived host scripts are displayed as source instead.

Name the action and its scope. Give one instruction per step where possible. Put prerequisites before the action. Keep exact API identifiers and interface labels. State a host limitation beside the operation that it affects. This is ASD-STE100-inspired writing; it is not a claim of controlled-language certification.

Use page tags and categories to connect related tasks. The navigation follows .nav.yml. Use the print page for a combined printable copy.

docs.title: Install the scripts
docs.text:
These scripts use FontLab 9's Python 3.11 and its PythonQt binding. Install fontlab-fly and fontlab-fontlabapp 0.2.23 or later in FontLab's Python environment. Feature editors also need App's fontedit extra and native fontpr. The documentation build uses a separate Python environment.

  1. Open FontLab's Scripts folder.
  2. Copy the contents of this repository's Scripts folder into that folder.
  3. Keep the category folders. FontLab supports one folder level in the Scripts menu.
  4. Open a font. Choose a script from the corresponding category in the Scripts menu.

Start with Reports > Font Overview to inspect the font. Read the script's description before you run an editor. Test edits on a copy of the font.

Close a script's panel with its Close control. The shared lifecycle code disconnects the script's signals and destroys its owned window.

docs.title: Compatibility decisions
docs.text:
mkdocs-toc-sidebar-plugin 0.1.0 fails to load because it refers to the removed mkdocs.utils.string_types attribute. The site uses MaterialX's native ToC. The old breadcrumbs plugin generates index files in the source tree and brings in the original Material package. MaterialX's navigation.path supplies breadcrumbs without a second theme or source writes. Neither old plugin is installed.

The large API reference keeps its complete sharded search and verified archive. It does not concatenate its thousands of API pages into a single print page.

docs.title: Work with an open font
docs.text: Keep the font that supplied a preview open until you apply the change. Editors refuse an Apply operation if that font or its relevant source values have changed. Refresh the preview after editing the font.

docs.title: Reports and selection
docs.text: Reports inspect font data. Some reports can select the glyphs in their results. Selection is a change to the workspace, even when the font data stays intact. Rescan a report after switching fonts. A failed scan clears partial results.

docs.title: Editors and history
docs.text: Read the complete preview before you choose Apply. The current editors use shared history helpers and refuse conditions that cannot preserve the recorded Undo and Redo behavior. A no-op plan does not add a history step. The individual script's source and description give its scope and remaining host restrictions.

docs.title: Canvas reporters
docs.text: Open a Glyph window before you start a reporter. Set its direction or handle size in the panel. Disable or Close removes the overlay. Reopen the reporter after switching the font, master or Glyph window. These foreground adaptations do not implement Glyphs' background ordering or automatic tool suppression.

docs.title: Cloud View
docs.text:
Overlay the selected glyphs faintly and show every anchor of one name as a cloud of dots, per master.

A tight cloud means marks will sit consistently; a stray dot is a glyph whose anchor is off. Hover-free and read-only: the list under each panel gives the extreme values. Nothing in the font is changed.

Run Anchors > Cloud View from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

docs.title: Source
docs.text:
Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Anchors/Cloud View.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Anchors · Cloud View
"""Overlay the selected glyphs faintly and show every anchor of one name as a cloud of dots, per master.

A tight cloud means marks will sit consistently; a stray dot is a glyph whose anchor
is off. Hover-free and read-only: the list under each panel gives the extreme values.
Nothing in the font is changed."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    anchors_action,
    anchors_api,
    anchors_dialog_type,
    anchors_snapshot_refresh,
    anchors_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = anchors_api()
current_package = _api.current_package
selected_glyphs = _api.selected_glyphs
anchor_names = _api.anchor_names
cloud = _api.cloud
glyph_path = _api.glyph_path
pen = _api.pen
muted = _api.muted
frame = _api.frame
layer_of = _api.cloud_layer_of
CloudView = anchors_view_types().CloudView

TITLE = "Anchor Cloud"
KEY = "anchors_cloud_view"


class AnchorCloud(anchors_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build all original controls before reading native font or anchor values."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(660)
        root = self.root
        bar = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        bar.setSpacing(10)
        self.name = QtGui.QComboBox()
        bar.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Anchor"))
        bar.addWidget(self.name, 1)
        root.addLayout(bar)
        self.view = CloudView()
        root.addWidget(self.view, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.close_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.name.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    @anchors_action
    def choose(self, name: Any) -> None:
        """Select named original options while checking the prior displayed source."""
        if self.name.findText(name) >= 0:
            self.name.setCurrentIndex(self.name.findText(name))

    @anchors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild all original display data for the current source and selectors."""
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            names = ", ".join(g.name for g in self.glyphs[:10]) + (
                " …" if count > 10 else ""
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')} overlaid: {names}"
            )
        name = self.name.currentText
        (panels, self.points) = ([], {})
        for master in self.masters:
            paths = [
                glyph_path(l)
                for l in (layer_of(g, master) for g in self.glyphs)
                if l is not None
            ]
            self.points[master] = cloud(self.glyphs, master, name) if name else []
            panels.append((master, paths, self.points[master]))
        self.view.set_panels(panels if self.glyphs else [])
        found = sum(len(p) for p in self.points.values())
        self.status.setText(
            f"{found} “{name}” anchors on {len(self.masters)} masters"
            if name
            else "No anchors"
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned anchor panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(AnchorCloud, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.title: Compatibility Report
docs.text:
Compare anchor names across masters: a glyph whose masters carry different anchors cannot interpolate them.

The tree lists each glyph with its anchor count per master; expand a glyph to see which master lacks which anchor. Mismatches are flagged and listed first. # this_file: Scripts/Anchors/Compatibility Report.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Anchors · Compatibility Report
"""Compare anchor names across masters: a glyph whose masters carry different anchors cannot interpolate them.

The tree lists each glyph with its anchor count per master; expand a glyph to see
which master lacks which anchor. Mismatches are flagged and listed first.
Auto layers show "auto" and are not compared: FontLab rebuilds their anchors.
Double-click a glyph to select it in the Font window. Nothing is changed."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    anchors_action,
    anchors_api,
    anchors_dialog_type,
    anchors_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = anchors_api()
current_package = _api.current_package
font_glyph_names = _api.font_glyph_names
anchor_sets = _api.anchor_sets
is_mismatch = _api.is_mismatch
item_ink = _api.item_ink
muted = _api.muted
frame = _api.frame
selected_names = _api.exact_selected_names

TITLE = "Anchor Compatibility"
KEY = "anchors_compatibility_report"
ERROR = "#d33"


class AnchorCompatibility(anchors_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build all original controls before reading native font or anchor values."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(600)
        root = self.root
        bar = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        bar.setSpacing(10)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem("Whole font")
        self.scope.addItem(f"Selected glyphs ({len(self.selection)})")
        self.only_bad = QtGui.QCheckBox("Only mismatches")
        bar.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyphs"))
        bar.addWidget(self.scope)
        bar.addStretch(1)
        bar.addWidget(self.only_bad)
        root.addLayout(bar)
        self.tree = QtGui.QTreeWidget()
        self.tree.setColumnCount(2)
        self.tree.setHeaderLabels(["Glyph / anchor", ""])
        self.tree.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.tree.setUniformRowHeights(True)
        self.tree.setRootIsDecorated(True)
        self.tree.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.tree.setMinimumHeight(320)
        root.addWidget(self.tree, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select mismatches")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.rescan())
        self._connect(self.only_bad.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(
            self.tree.itemDoubleClicked, lambda item, column: self.open_item(item)
        )
        self._connect(
            self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_names(self.mismatches())
        )
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    @anchors_snapshot_refresh
    def rescan(self) -> None:
        """Scan captured names and masters into the complete anchor compatibility tree."""
        names = font_glyph_names() if self.scope.currentIndex == 0 else self.selection
        self.rows = (
            anchor_sets(self.package, names, self.masters) if self.package else []
        )
        self.refresh()

    def mismatches(self) -> Any:
        """List glyphs whose non-auto master anchor-name sets differ."""
        return [name for (name, sets) in self.rows if is_mismatch(sets)]

    @anchors_action
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild all original display data for the current source and selectors."""
        bad = set(self.mismatches())
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Anchor names per master for {len(self.rows)} glyphs with anchors. Expand a glyph for details; double-click to select it in the Font window."
            )
        text = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        dim = QtGui.QColor(text)
        dim.setAlpha(120)
        error = QtGui.QColor(ERROR)
        self.tree.clear()
        # Controls exist before binding; configure the actual master columns now.
        self.tree.setColumnCount(len(self.masters) + 2)
        self.tree.setHeaderLabels(["Glyph / anchor", *self.masters, ""])
        header = self.tree.header()
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(
            len(self.masters) + 1, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents
        )
        ordered = sorted(self.rows, key=lambda r: (r[0] not in bad,))
        for name, sets in ordered:
            if self.only_bad.isChecked() and name not in bad:
                continue
            counts = [
                "auto" if m in sets and sets[m] is None else str(len(sets.get(m) or []))
                for m in self.masters
            ]
            top = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem([name, *counts, "✗" if name in bad else "✓"])
            for column in range(self.tree.columnCount):
                top.setForeground(column, item_ink())
            top.setData(0, QtCore.Qt.UserRole, name)
            mark = len(self.masters) + 1
            top.setForeground(mark, QtGui.QBrush(error if name in bad else dim))
            if name in bad:
                bold = top.font(0)
                bold.setBold(True)
                top.setFont(0, bold)
            every = sorted({a for names in sets.values() if names for a in names})
            for anchor in every:
                cells = [
                    "auto"
                    if m in sets and sets[m] is None
                    else "✓"
                    if anchor in (sets.get(m) or [])
                    else "missing"
                    for m in self.masters
                ]
                child = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem([anchor, *cells, ""])
                for column in range(self.tree.columnCount):
                    child.setForeground(column, item_ink())
                child.setData(0, QtCore.Qt.UserRole, name)
                for column, cell in enumerate(cells, 1):
                    child.setForeground(
                        column, QtGui.QBrush(error if cell == "missing" else dim)
                    )
                top.addChild(child)
            for column in range(1, len(self.masters) + 2):
                top.setTextAlignment(column, int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter))
            self.tree.addTopLevelItem(top)
            for index in range(top.childCount()):
                for column in range(1, len(self.masters) + 2):
                    top.child(index).setTextAlignment(
                        column, int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter)
                    )
            if name in bad:
                top.setExpanded(True)
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(bad))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(bad)} glyph{('s' if len(bad) != 1 else '')} with different anchors across masters"
            if bad
            else "All masters carry the same anchor names"
        )

    @anchors_action
    def open_item(self, item: Any) -> None:
        """Select the tree item glyph after validating the captured font source."""
        name = item.data(0, QtCore.Qt.UserRole)
        if name:
            self.select_names([name])
            self.status.setText(f"Selected {name} in the Font window")


def select_in_font(names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Route the original helper through the active panel's source guard."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open this panel before selecting its results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned anchor panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(AnchorCompatibility, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Anchors/Copy Anchors From Glyph.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Copy a source glyph's anchors to selected glyphs, master by master.

Type a source name with fontwide completion; choose merge/replace, width scaling
and current/all masters. Automatic layers are skipped. Unsafe automatic
dependants and stale source previews refuse the complete write before history.
One Copy is one native Undo. Close disconnects every owned callback.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    anchor_copy_api,
    anchor_copy_dialog_type,
    anchor_copy_snapshot_refresh,
    components_action,
    masters_make_table,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
TITLE, KEY = "Copy Anchors from Glyph", "anchors_copy_from_glyph"
_api = anchor_copy_api()
layer_of, anchor_points, plan = _api.layer_of, _api.anchor_points, _api.plan


def fmt(point) -> str:
    return "removed" if point is None else f"{point[0]}, {point[1]}"


class CopyAnchors(anchor_copy_dialog_type()):
    """Original complete copy workflow on the shared owned lifecycle."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Retain all original copy controls before binding any native font data."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self._scanning = False
        self.last_result = None
        self.glyphs = []
        self.pending_targets = set()
        self.pending_origins = []
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QFormLayout()
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.source = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.source.setPlaceholderText("source glyph name, e.g. n")
        self.completer = QtGui.QCompleter(self)
        self.completion_model = QtGui.QStringListModel(self.completer)
        self.completer.setModel(self.completion_model)
        self.completer.setCaseSensitivity(QtCore.Qt.CaseInsensitive)
        self.completer.setFilterMode(QtCore.Qt.MatchContains)
        self.source.setCompleter(self.completer)
        self.mode = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.mode.addItem("Add and move (keep other anchors)")
        self.mode.addItem("Replace (remove anchors the source lacks)")
        self.scale = QtGui.QCheckBox("Scale x by advance-width ratio")
        self.scale.setChecked(True)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        form.addRow("Source glyph", self.source)
        form.addRow("Mode", self.mode)
        form.addRow("", self.scale)
        form.addRow("Masters", self.scope)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.table = masters_make_table(
            ["Glyph · master", "Anchor", "Current", "New"], 220
        )
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        self.rebuild_label = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.rebuild_label.setWordWrap(True)
        root.addWidget(self.rebuild_label)
        self._connect(self.source.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.mode.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.scale.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())

    def source_glyph(self):
        name = self.source.text.strip()
        return self.package.findName(name) if self.package and name else None

    @anchor_copy_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self.pending_targets = set()
        self.pending_origins = []
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select the glyphs to receive anchors, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            names = ", ".join(g.name for g in self.glyphs[:8]) + (
                " …" if count > 8 else ""
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Anchors go to {count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')}: {names}"
            )
        source = self.source_glyph()
        rows = []
        if source is not None:
            replace = self.mode.currentIndex == 1
            for glyph in self.glyphs:
                if glyph.name == source.name:
                    continue
                for master in self.chosen_masters():
                    (src, dst) = (layer_of(source, master), layer_of(glyph, master))
                    if src is None or dst is None:
                        continue
                    tag = f"{glyph.name} · {master}"
                    if dst.autoLayer:
                        rows.append(((tag, "auto layer", "", "skipped"), False))
                        continue
                    for name, old, new in plan(
                        src, dst, self.scale.isChecked(), replace
                    ):
                        if old != new:
                            self.pending_targets.add(glyph.name)
                            if old is not None and new == (0, 0):
                                self.pending_origins.append((glyph.name, master, name))
                        rows.append(
                            (
                                (tag, name, "–" if old is None else fmt(old), fmt(new)),
                                old != new,
                            )
                        )
        self.fill_rows(rows)
        pending = sum(1 for (_, changed) in rows if changed)
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(pending > 0)
        if not self.source.text.strip():
            self.status.setText("Type the source glyph name")
        elif source is None:
            self.status.setText(f"No glyph named “{self.source.text.strip()}”")
        else:
            self.status.setText(
                f"{pending} anchor change{('s' if pending != 1 else '')} from {source.name}"
            )
        self.guard_apply()

    @components_action
    def apply(self) -> Any:
        self.last_result = _api.run(
            self.source_glyph(),
            self.glyphs,
            self.chosen_masters(),
            self.scale.isChecked(),
            self.mode.currentIndex == 1,
            package=self.package,
            title=TITLE,
        )
        self._snapshot_valid = False
        self.refresh()
        result = self.last_result
        note = (
            f" · {len(result['skipped'])} auto layers skipped"
            if result["skipped"]
            else ""
        )
        self.status.setText(
            f"Copied {result['anchors']} anchor changes to {result['layers']} layers{note}"
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show one complete owned copy panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(CopyAnchors, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Anchors/Mark Attachment Preview.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Anchors · Mark Attachment Preview
"""Preview a mark attached to a base glyph by matching anchors (top + _top), side by side for every master.

Pick a base glyph, a mark glyph and an anchor family; the mark is drawn where
mark positioning would put it: base anchor minus mark anchor. Offsets per master
are listed under the drawing. Nothing in the font is changed."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    anchors_action,
    anchors_api,
    anchors_dialog_type,
    anchors_snapshot_refresh,
    anchors_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = anchors_api()
current_package = _api.current_package
selected_names = _api.selected_names
font_glyph_names = _api.font_glyph_names
anchor_points = _api.anchor_points
classify = _api.classify
families = _api.families
attachment = _api.attachment
glyph_path = _api.glyph_path
pen = _api.pen
muted = _api.muted
layer_of = _api.attachment_layer_of
AttachmentView = anchors_view_types().AttachmentView

TITLE = "Mark Attachment Preview"
KEY = "anchors_mark_attachment_preview"


class MarkPreview(anchors_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build all original controls before reading native font or anchor values."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(640)
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        self.base = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.base.addItems(self.bases)
        self.mark = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.mark.addItems(self.marks)
        self.family = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for column, (label, combo) in enumerate(
            (("Base", self.base), ("Mark", self.mark), ("Anchor", self.family))
        ):
            form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel(label), 0, column * 2)
            form.addWidget(combo, 0, column * 2 + 1)
            form.setColumnStretch(column * 2 + 1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.view = AttachmentView()
        root.addWidget(self.view, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.close_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.base.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.pair_changed())
        self._connect(self.mark.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.pair_changed())
        self._connect(self.family.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    @anchors_action
    def choose(self, base: Any = None, mark: Any = None, family: Any = None) -> None:
        """Select combo entries by name (used by tests and for the initial pair)."""
        for combo, value in ((self.base, base), (self.mark, mark)):
            if value is not None and combo.findText(value) >= 0:
                combo.setCurrentIndex(combo.findText(value))
        if family is not None and self.family.findText(family) >= 0:
            self.family.setCurrentIndex(self.family.findText(family))

    @anchors_snapshot_refresh
    def pair_changed(self) -> None:
        """Keep the previous matching family while rebuilding base and mark choices."""
        base = (
            layer_of(self.package, self.base.currentText, self.current_master)
            if self.package
            else None
        )
        mark = (
            layer_of(self.package, self.mark.currentText, self.current_master)
            if self.package
            else None
        )
        common = families(base, mark) if base is not None and mark is not None else []
        previous = self.family.currentText
        self.family.blockSignals(True)
        self.family.clear()
        self.family.addItems(common)
        if previous in common:
            self.family.setCurrentIndex(common.index(previous))
        self.family.blockSignals(False)
        self.refresh()

    @anchors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild all original display data for the current source and selectors."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        (base_name, mark_name, family) = (
            self.base.currentText,
            self.mark.currentText,
            self.family.currentText,
        )
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{mark_name or '–'} attached to {base_name or '–'} with {family or '–'} / _{family or '–'} on {len(self.masters)} masters. {len(self.bases)} base and {len(self.marks)} mark glyphs found."
        )
        (panels, self.offsets) = ([], {})
        for master in self.masters:
            base = layer_of(self.package, base_name, master)
            mark = layer_of(self.package, mark_name, master)
            if base is None:
                continue
            offset = (
                attachment(base, mark, family) if mark is not None and family else None
            )
            self.offsets[master] = offset
            mark_path = None
            point = None
            if offset is not None:
                mark_path = QtGui.QTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, offset[0], offset[1]).map(
                    glyph_path(mark)
                )
                point = anchor_points(base)[family]
            note = (
                f"offset {offset[0]}, {offset[1]}"
                if offset is not None
                else "no matching anchors"
            )
            panels.append(
                (master, glyph_path(base), mark_path, point, base.advanceWidth, note)
            )
        self.view.set_panels(panels)
        missing = [m for (m, o) in self.offsets.items() if o is None]
        self.status.setText(
            f"Missing anchors on {', '.join(missing)}"
            if missing
            else "Mark offset = base anchor − mark anchor"
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned anchor panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(MarkPreview, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Cleanup/Select Unreferenced Glyphs.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Cleanup · Select Unreferenced Glyphs
"""List unencoded glyphs that nothing references, and select them in the Font window for review.

A glyph counts as referenced when it has a code point, is used as a component or in an
auto recipe on any layer, is named in the OpenType feature source, or belongs to a feature
class that the source uses. Candidates are often alternates waiting for a feature, so the
script only selects them; it never deletes. Feature files pulled in with include() cannot
be read and stop the scan."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - Original public helper re-export.
    review_action,
    review_dialog_type,
    review_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
    unreferenced_api,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = unreferenced_api()
feature_source, tokens, class_members = (
    _api.feature_source,
    _api.tokens,
    _api.class_members,
)
font_names, unreferenced, RESERVED = (
    _api.font_glyph_names,
    _api.unreferenced,
    _api.RESERVED,
)
TITLE = "Select Unreferenced Glyphs"
KEY = "cleanup_unused_glyphs_report"


def muted(widget: Any) -> str:
    """Copy the original WindowText colour before applying the 160 alpha value."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(160)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class Dialog(review_dialog_type()):
    """Review every original candidate; selection is the only intended action."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build all original controls and Close before reading native references."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self.last_result = None
        root = self.root
        self.subtitle.setText(
            "Unencoded glyphs not used as components, in auto recipes, in the feature code or in its classes. Many are alternates waiting for a feature: review before deleting anything."
        )
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 2)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Glyph", "Hint"])
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        self.table.setFocusPolicy(QtCore.Qt.NoFocus)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()

            else "Every glyph is encoded or referenced"

# FLM: Components · Compatibility
"""Compare component names and order across masters; glyphs that differ cannot interpolate their components.

One row per composite glyph, one column per master. Masters whose component list
differs from the first master are shown in red, and mismatching glyphs are listed
first. Double-click a row to select the glyph in the Font window. Nothing is changed."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_action,
    components_api,
    components_dialog_type,
    components_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = components_api()
current_package = _api.current_package
font_glyph_names = _api.font_glyph_names
selected_names = _api.selected_names
component_lists = _api.component_lists
odd_masters = _api.odd_masters
item_ink = _api.item_ink
muted = _api.muted
frame = _api.frame

TITLE = "Component Compatibility"
KEY = "components_compatibility"
ERROR = "#d33"


class Compatibility(components_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original component inspector with owned read-only source guards."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every original control and Close before reading native sources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        root = self.root
        self.setMinimumWidth(680)
        bar = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        bar.setSpacing(10)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem("Whole font")
        self.scope.addItem(f"Selected glyphs ({len(self.selection)})")
        self.only_bad = QtGui.QCheckBox("Only mismatches")
        bar.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyphs"))
        bar.addWidget(self.scope)
        bar.addStretch(1)
        bar.addWidget(self.only_bad)
        root.addLayout(bar)
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(self.masters) + 1)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Glyph", *self.masters])
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(320)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select mismatches")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.rescan())
        self._connect(self.only_bad.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked, lambda row, column: self.open_row(row)
        )
        self._connect(
            self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_names(self.mismatches())
        )
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    @components_snapshot_refresh
    def rescan(self) -> None:
        """Preserve the original rescan calculation and native interface."""
        self.table.setColumnCount(len(self.masters) + 1)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Glyph", *self.masters])
        names = font_glyph_names() if self.scope.currentIndex == 0 else self.selection
        self.rows = (
            component_lists(self.package, names, self.masters) if self.package else []
        )
        self.refresh()

    def mismatches(self) -> Any:
        """Preserve the original mismatches calculation and native interface."""
        return [name for (name, lists) in self.rows if odd_masters(lists, self.masters)]

    @components_action
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Preserve the original refresh calculation and native interface."""
        bad = set(self.mismatches())
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(self.rows)} composite glyphs compared across {len(self.masters)} masters. Red cells differ from the first master."
            )
        error = QtGui.QColor(ERROR)
        self.shown = [
            r
            for r in sorted(self.rows, key=lambda r: r[0] not in bad)
            if not self.only_bad.isChecked() or r[0] in bad
        ]
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.shown))
        for row, (name, lists) in enumerate(self.shown):
            odd = set(odd_masters(lists, self.masters))
            item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(name)
            item.setForeground(item_ink())
            if name in bad:
                bold = item.font()
                bold.setBold(True)
                item.setFont(bold)
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, item)
            for column, master in enumerate(self.masters, 1):
                cell = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(" + ".join(lists.get(master, [])) or "–")
                cell.setForeground(item_ink())
                if master in odd:
                    cell.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(error))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, cell)
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(bad))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(bad)} glyph{('s' if len(bad) != 1 else '')} with incompatible components"
            if bad
            else "All composites have the same components on every master"
        )

    @components_action
    def open_row(self, row: Any) -> None:
        """Preserve the original open row calculation and native interface."""
        name = self.shown[row][0]
        self.select_names([name])
        self.status.setText(f"Selected {name} in the Font window")

    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open this panel before selecting its results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and display the complete original owned component inspector."""
    return show_script_dialog(Compatibility, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Accent badges count components, muted badges count the glyph's own contours; a master that differs from the first one is marked with a dot, and auto layers are labelled. A quick way to see which glyphs are composites, outlines or a mix. Nothing in the font is changed.

Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Components/Count Badges.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Components · Count Badges
"""A painted card per selected glyph: its drawing plus component and contour counts for every master.

Accent badges count components, muted badges count the glyph's own contours; a
master that differs from the first one is marked with a dot, and auto layers are
labelled. A quick way to see which glyphs are composites, outlines or a mix.
Nothing in the font is changed."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_api,
    components_dialog_type,
    components_snapshot_refresh,
    components_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = components_api()
current_package = _api.current_package
selected_glyphs = _api.selected_glyphs
layer_of = _api.layer_of
counts = _api.counts
glyph_path = _api.glyph_path
pen = _api.pen
muted = _api.muted
frame = _api.frame
BadgeGrid = components_view_types().BadgeGrid

TITLE = "Component Count Badges"
KEY = "components_count_badges"
(CARD_W, DRAW_H, LINE_H, PAD) = (212, 92, 20, 10)
COLUMNS = 3


class CountBadges(components_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original component inspector with owned read-only source guards."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every original control and Close before reading native sources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        root = self.root
        self.setMinimumWidth(COLUMNS * (CARD_W + 8) + 84)
        self.grid = BadgeGrid()
        self.scroll_area = QtGui.QScrollArea()
        self.scroll_area.setWidget(self.grid)
        self.scroll_area.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.scroll_area.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.scroll_area.setFrameShape(QtGui.QFrame.NoFrame)
        self.scroll_area.setMinimumHeight(self.grid_height_hint())
        root.addWidget(self.scroll_area, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.close_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    def grid_height_hint(self) -> Any:
        """Preserve the original grid height hint calculation and native interface."""
        lines = DRAW_H + LINE_H + len(self.masters) * LINE_H + 2 * PAD
        return (
            min(2, max(1, (len(self.glyphs) + COLUMNS - 1) // COLUMNS)) * (lines + 8)
            + 6
        )

    @components_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Preserve the original refresh calculation and native interface."""
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')}, drawn from {self.current_master}. Accent: components · grey: own contours · dot: auto layer (blue) or differs (red)."
            )
        (cards, self.counts) = ([], {})
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            per = {
                m: counts(l)
                for (m, l) in ((m, layer_of(glyph, m)) for m in self.masters)
                if l is not None
            }
            self.counts[glyph.name] = {m: list(v) for (m, v) in per.items()}
            first = next(iter(per.values()), None)
            lines = [
                (m, c, k, auto, first is not None and (c, k) != first[:2])
                for (m, (c, k, auto)) in per.items()
            ]
            shown = layer_of(glyph, self.current_master) or next(
                (
                    l
                    for l in (layer_of(glyph, m) for m in self.masters)
                    if l is not None
                ),
                None,
            )
            path = glyph_path(shown) if shown is not None else QtGui.QPainterPath()
            box = QtCore.QRectF(
                0, -250, max(shown.advanceWidth if shown else 500, 1), 1000
            ).united(path.boundingRect())
            cards.append((glyph.name, path, box, lines))
        self.grid.set_cards(
            cards, max(self.scroll_area.viewport().width, COLUMNS * (CARD_W + 8) + 4)
        )
        composites = sum(
            1 for per in self.counts.values() if any(v[0] for v in per.values())
        )
        self.status.setText(f"{composites} of {count} glyphs use components")

    def resizeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Preserve the original resizeEvent calculation and native interface."""
        QtGui.QDialog.resizeEvent(self, event)
        self.grid.relayout(self.scroll_area.viewport().width)

    """Route the original helper alias through the active panel's source guard."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open this panel before selecting its results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)

    """Replace and display the complete original owned component inspector."""

Select glyphs or editor layer occurrences, then run this command. The modeless read-only report gives one base+base=glyph line per layer with components. Selected-layer order, repeated occurrences/bases and mixed layers are retained. The source format omits positions, transforms and own contours; the text is a composition aid, not a complete geometry export or a guaranteed import recipe.

Use Refresh after changing the font, master or selection. Empty/missing/stale sources and deadline overruns give a clear diagnosis; partial rows are cleared. Close releases this owned panel. The report calls no font, selection, history, preferences, clipboard or Output writers. Requires matching App and fontlab-fly in FontLab9 Python3.11. Adapted from Simon Cozens' MIT Recipe Dumper; see NOTICE. The shared reader retains each editor slot’s explicit layer choice. Font-window selection uses the current master. Actual FontLab behavior and complete native preservation remain pending acceptance.

Run Components > Dump Component Recipes from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

# FLM: Components · Missing Bases
"""Find components that point to glyphs which do not exist, or to a base glyph without that master.

Such components draw nothing and break exports. The tree groups the problems by
the missing base glyph; expand a group to see the composites and masters affected.
Select affected glyphs puts them in the Font window selection. Nothing is changed."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_action,
    components_api,
    components_dialog_type,
    components_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = components_api()
current_package = _api.current_package
font_glyph_names = _api.font_glyph_names

missing = _api.missing
item_ink = _api.item_ink
muted = _api.muted
frame = _api.frame

TITLE = "Missing Component Bases"
KEY = "components_missing_bases"
ERROR = "#d33"


class MissingBases(components_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original component inspector with owned read-only source guards."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every original control and Close before reading native sources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        root = self.root
        self.setMinimumWidth(540)
        self.tree = QtGui.QTreeWidget()
        self.tree.setColumnCount(3)
        self.tree.setHeaderLabels(["Missing base / composite", "Master", "Problem"])
        self.tree.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.tree.setUniformRowHeights(True)
        self.tree.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        header = self.tree.header()
        header.setStretchLastSection(True)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.tree.setMinimumHeight(280)
        root.addWidget(self.tree, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select affected glyphs")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_affected())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    def affected(self) -> Any:
        """Preserve the original affected calculation and native interface."""
        return sorted(
            {glyph for rows in self.groups.values() for (glyph, _, _) in rows}
        )

    @components_snapshot_refresh
    def rescan(self, exists: Any = None) -> None:
        """Preserve the original rescan calculation and native interface."""
        self.groups = (
            missing(self.package, font_glyph_names(), self.masters, exists)
            if self.package
            else {}
        )
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Every component on all {len(self.masters)} masters checked against the glyphs and master layers of this font."
            )
        error = QtGui.QColor(ERROR)
        dim = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        dim.setAlpha(140)
        self.tree.clear()
        for base, rows in sorted(self.groups.items()):
            top = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem(
                [base, "", f"{len(rows)} component{('s' if len(rows) != 1 else '')}"]
            )
            for column in range(self.tree.columnCount):
                top.setForeground(column, item_ink())
            top.setForeground(0, QtGui.QBrush(error))
            bold = top.font(0)
            bold.setBold(True)
            top.setFont(0, bold)
            for glyph, master, reason in rows:
                child = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem([glyph, master, reason])
                for column in range(self.tree.columnCount):
                    child.setForeground(column, item_ink())
                child.setForeground(2, QtGui.QBrush(dim))
                top.addChild(child)
            self.tree.addTopLevelItem(top)
            top.setExpanded(True)
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(self.groups))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.groups)} missing base{('s' if len(self.groups) != 1 else '')} in {len(self.affected())} glyphs"
            if self.groups
            else "Every component has its base glyph"
        )

    @components_action
    def select_affected(self) -> None:
        """Preserve the original select affected calculation and native interface."""
        self.select_names(self.affected())
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(self.affected())} glyphs in the Font window"
        )

muted = _api.muted

TITLE = "Components Report"
KEY = "components_report"
COLUMNS = ["Glyph", "Master", "Components", "Offsets", "Layer"]


class ComponentsReport(components_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original component inspector with owned read-only source guards."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every original control and Close before reading native sources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        root = self.root
        self.setMinimumWidth(680)
        bar = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        bar.setSpacing(10)
        self.filter = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.filter.setPlaceholderText("Filter by glyph, component or “auto”")
        self.filter.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        bar.addWidget(self.filter, 1)
        bar.addWidget(self.scope)
        root.addLayout(bar)
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(len(self.rows), len(COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(COLUMNS)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        for column in (0, 1, 4):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(320)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.copy_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy CSV")
        self.copy_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.filter.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked, lambda row, column: self.open_glyph(row)
        )
        self._connect(self.copy_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.copy_csv())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    def matches(self, values: Any) -> Any:
        """Preserve the original matches calculation and native interface."""
        needle = self.filter.text.strip().lower()
        if self.scope.currentIndex == 0 and values[1] != self.current_master:
            return False
        return not needle or any(needle in str(v).lower() for v in values)

    def visible_rows(self) -> Any:
        """Preserve the original visible rows calculation and native interface."""
        return [values for values in self.rows if self.matches(values)]

    @components_action
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Preserve the original refresh calculation and native interface."""
        if self._scanning and self.package is not None:
            self.rows = report(self.package, self.names, self.masters)
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.rows))
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        dim = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        dim.setAlpha(140)
        for row, values in enumerate(self.rows):
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                item.setForeground(item_ink())
                if column == 4:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(dim if text == "auto" else accent))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            glyphs = len({r[0] for r in self.rows})
            auto = sum(1 for r in self.rows if r[4] == "auto")
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{glyphs} composite glyphs · {len(self.rows)} layers with components, {auto} of them auto layers. Double-click a row to open the glyph."
            )
        shown = 0
        for row, values in enumerate(self.rows):
            hide = not self.matches(values)
            self.table.setRowHidden(row, hide)
            shown += not hide
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(shown > 0)
        self.status.setText(f"{shown} of {len(self.rows)} rows shown")

    def csv_text(self) -> Any:
        """Preserve the original csv text calculation and native interface."""
        return to_csv(self.visible_rows())

    @components_action
    def copy_csv(self) -> None:
        """Preserve the original copy csv calculation and native interface."""
        QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.csv_text())
        self.status.setText(f"Copied {len(self.visible_rows())} rows as CSV")

    @components_action
    def open_glyph(self, row: Any) -> None:
        """Preserve the original open glyph calculation and native interface."""
        glyph = self.package.findName(self.rows[row][0]) if self.package else None
        if glyph is not None:
            self.package.activateGlyph(glyph)
            fontlab.UpdateAll()


def select_in_font(names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Route the original helper alias through the active panel's source guard."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open this panel before selecting its results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and display the complete original owned component inspector."""
    return show_script_dialog(ComponentsReport, KEY)

    main()

docs.title: Angularizzle
docs.text:
Turn selected closed outlines into angular planes with a modeless preview.

Min plane defaults to 80; Keep detail preserves short segments. Single-layer Process always samples the opening selected layer and writes its glyph's first master. Process can repeat; Cancel restores that actual target's opening paths while retaining the source tool's colour mark. Closing keeps processed paths. Batch Process follows ordered selected occurrences, including repeats, then closes. Open paths are omitted when a closed angular result replaces paths.

The bound session refuses stale sources, unsupported hints, automatic dependants and ambiguous shape ownership before editing. A late native failure disables further writes and retains recovery data; close the panel and inspect the diagnosed result before continuing. Native FontLab acceptance is pending. Requires matching App/Fly candidates. Adapted from NaN Angularizzle; see NOTICE.

Run Contours > Angularizzle from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Each contour carries its index at the start node, a dot on the start node and an arrow along
its first segment, so start-point and order mismatches between masters are visible at a glance
before interpolation surprises you. Read-only: nothing in the font changes."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt

    current_package as current_package,  # noqa: PLC0414 - original public helper

    inspectors_api,

    inspectors_snapshot_refresh,
    inspectors_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)

        """Finish controls/status/Close before fallible font reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class ContourOrder(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original inspector with complete snapshots and owned cleanup."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Create every original control and guarded signal before native reads."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(640)
        grid = self.form()
        self.glyph_combo = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for name in self.names:
            self.glyph_combo.addItem(name)
        self._connect(self.glyph_combo.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyph"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.glyph_combo, 0, 1)
        grid.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        self.view = OrderView()
        self.view.report = self.paint_report
        self.root.addWidget(self.view, 1)
        legend = QtGui.QLabel(
            "● start node · number = contour order · arrow = direction of the first segment",
        )
        legend.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        self.root.addWidget(legend)

    @inspectors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete original report under the shared font/master snapshot guard."""
        self.sync_controls()
        self.info = {}
        if not self.describe_selection():
            self.view.columns = []
            self.view.update()
            return
        glyph = self.package.findName(self.glyph_combo.currentText)
        columns = []
        for master, layer in master_layers(glyph, self.masters).items():
            info = [] if layer.autoLayer else contour_info(layer)
            self.info[master] = [
                (i, start, direction, len(points))
                for i, points, start, _, direction in info
            ]
            columns.append((master + (" (auto)" if layer.autoLayer else ""), info))
        self.view.columns = columns
        self.view.update()
        counts = {len(v) for v in self.info.values()}
        note = (
            "contour counts match"
            if len(counts) == 1
            else "contour counts differ between masters"
        )
        self.status.setText(f"{glyph.name}: {len(columns)} masters · {note}")

    """Replace and show the complete original owned inspector."""

# this_file: Scripts/Contours/Node Coordinates Panel.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Follow selected nodes as you edit; inspect coordinates, offsets and distances.

Open a glyph, run this script and select nodes. Both tables update every 400 ms.
Copy exports the displayed node coordinates as tab-separated lines. Contour
numbers start at one; node indices start at zero. Component contours are excluded.
The modeless panel reads the bound font only. Switching or closing that font
stops polling; reopen the tool to bind another font. No font data is written.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
api = ap.scripting.node_coordinates_api()
current_glyph, selected_nodes = api.current_glyph, api.selected_nodes
measures, number, own_contours = api.measures, api.number, api.own_contours
make_table = ap.scripting.masters_make_table
fill_table = ap.scripting.masters_fill_table
NamesDialog = ap.scripting.names_dialog_type()
TITLE, KEY, INTERVAL_MS = "Node Coordinates", "outlines_node_coordinates_panel", 400


class NodePanel(NamesDialog):
    """Retain original live controls with guarded Copy and owned timer cleanup."""

    ACTION = "Copy"

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.package, self._bound_id = None, None
        self._expired, self._closed = False, False
        self.signature, self.rows_data, self.glyph_name = None, [], None
        self.last_error = ""
        self.setMinimumWidth(440)
        self.nodes = make_table(["Contour : node", "x", "y", "Type"], 160)
        self.root.addWidget(self.nodes, 2)
        self.root.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Between consecutive selected nodes"))
        self.pairs = make_table(["From → to", "dx", "dy", "Distance", "Angle"], 100)
        self.root.addWidget(self.pairs, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button, self.apply_button = (
            QtGui.QPushButton("Close"),
            QtGui.QPushButton("Copy"),
        )
        self.apply_button.setDefault(True)
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(False)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.apply_button)
        self.root.addLayout(footer)
        self.timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.timer.setInterval(INTERVAL_MS)
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self._connect(self.apply_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.apply())
        self._connect(self.timer.timeout, lambda *a: self.tick())
        try:
            self.package = current_package()
            if self.package is None:
                raise ValueError("Open a font first, then reopen this tool.")
            self._bound_id = self.package.id
            self.timer.start()
            self.refresh()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - Contain errors at the native UI boundary.
            if self._bound_id is None:
                self._expired, self.package = True, None
                self.timer.stop()
            self.show_error(error)

    def invalidate(self) -> None:
        """Clear partial/stale coordinates and Copy without discarding the timer."""
        self.signature, self.rows_data, self.last_result = None, [], None
        self._snapshot_valid = False
        for name in ("nodes", "pairs"):
            table = getattr(self, name, None)
            if table is not None:
                table.setRowCount(0)
        button = getattr(self, "apply_button", None)
        if button is not None:
            button.setEnabled(False)

    def show_error(self, error: Exception) -> None:
        """Contain native read/render/clipboard errors and remove obsolete values."""
        self.invalidate()
        self.last_error = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
        self.status.setText(f"Paused: {self.last_error}")

    def snapshot(self) -> tuple:
        """Read only a fresh matching package; intended glyph/master edits are live."""
        if self._closed or self._expired:
            raise ValueError("Reopen this tool to bind a font.")
        package = current_package(self._bound_id)
        if package is None:
            self._expired, self.package = True, None
            self.timer.stop()
            raise ValueError("The font changed or closed; reopen this tool.")
        glyph, master = current_glyph(package), package.master
        layer = glyph.findLayer(master) if glyph is not None else None
        rows = selected_nodes(layer) if layer is not None else []
        if current_package(self._bound_id) is None:
            self._expired, self.package = True, None
            self.timer.stop()
            raise ValueError("The font changed during the read; reopen this tool.")
        return (glyph.name if glyph is not None else None, master, tuple(rows))

    def tick(self) -> None:
        """Poll through a contained slot; transient read failures can recover."""
        if self._closed or self._expired:
            return
        try:
            self.refresh()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - Contain errors at the native UI boundary.
            self.show_error(error)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Publish only after both complete tables render from one current read."""
        signature = self.snapshot()
        if signature == self.signature and tuple(self.rows_data) == signature[2]:
            return
        self.invalidate()
        name, master, raw = signature
        rows = list(raw)
        fill_table(
            self.nodes,
            [
                (f"{c + 1} : {n}", number(x), number(y), "on" if on else "handle")
                for c, n, x, y, on in rows
            ],
        )
        fill_table(
            self.pairs,
            [
                (label, number(dx), number(dy), f"{d:.1f}", f"{a:.1f}°")
                for label, dx, dy, d, a in measures(rows)
            ],
            lambda r, c, text: c == 3,
        )
        if self.snapshot() != signature:
            raise ValueError(
                "Selected nodes changed during display; wait for the next refresh."
            )
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{name} · {master} — select nodes in the Glyph window"
            if name is not None
            else "Open a glyph to see its selected nodes."
        )
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(rows)} node{'s' if len(rows) != 1 else ''} selected · live, every {INTERVAL_MS} ms"
        )
        self.signature, self.rows_data, self.glyph_name = signature, rows, name
        self.last_error, self._snapshot_valid = "", True
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(rows))

    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Copy the displayed snapshot only when it still matches the active nodes."""
        if self._closed:
            return
        try:
            current = self.snapshot()
            if (
                not self._snapshot_valid
                or current != self.signature
                or tuple(self.rows_data) != current[2]
            ):
                raise ValueError("Selected nodes changed; wait for the next refresh.")
            if not self.rows_data:
                return
            lines = [
                f"{c + 1}:{n}\t{number(x)}\t{number(y)}"
                for c, n, x, y, _ in self.rows_data
            ]
            QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText("\n".join(lines))
            self.last_result = {"copied": len(lines)}
            self.status.setText(f"Copied {len(lines)} lines")
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - Contain errors at the native UI boundary.
            self.show_error(error)

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Stop polling, disconnect signals, release the font and destroy this panel."""
        self._closed, self.package, self._bound_id = True, None, None
        self.invalidate()
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY, timers=(self.timer,))


def main() -> Any:
    """Show one owned modeless panel through the existing script registry."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(NodePanel, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FLM: Contours · Node Statistics
"""Contours and nodes per glyph and master in one table, with incompatible glyphs flagged.

Each cell reads "contours / nodes" for a master; a glyph is flagged when its masters differ,
which breaks interpolation. Work on the selection or the whole font, then select the flagged
glyphs in the Font window with one click. Read-only: nothing in the font changes."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package as current_package,  # noqa: PLC0414 - original public helper
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    inspectors_api,
    inspectors_dialog_type,
    inspectors_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_fill_table as fill_table,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_make_table as make_table,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = inspectors_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_names = _api.selected_names
master_layers = _api.master_layers
own_contours = _api.own_contours
layer_counts = _api.layer_counts
glyph_counts = _api.glyph_counts
incompatible = _api.incompatible
all_names = _api.all_names
TITLE = "Node Statistics"
KEY = "outlines_node_statistics"


class SampleDialog(inspectors_dialog_type()):
    """Original menu shell on the existing owned Proof/Names/Masters lifecycle."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Finish controls/status/Close before fallible font reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


def select_in_font_window(names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Select through the active panel's complete source and identity preflight."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open this panel before selecting its results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


class NodeStatistics(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original inspector with complete snapshots and owned cleanup."""

    ACTION = "Select Flagged"

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Create every original control and guarded signal before native reads."""
        grid = self.form()
        self.source = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.source.addItem(f"Selected glyphs ({len(self.names)})")
        self.source.addItem("Whole font")
        self._connect(self.source.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self.only_flagged = QtGui.QCheckBox("Show flagged glyphs only")
        self._connect(self.only_flagged.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyphs"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.source, 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.only_flagged, 0, 2)
        grid.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        self.table = make_table(["Glyph", *list(self.masters), "Masters"], 300)
        self.root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

    def source_names(self) -> Any:
        """Return captured selection or actual ordered Whole-font membership."""
        if self.package is None:
            return []
        return all_names(self.package) if self.source.currentIndex == 1 else self.names

    @inspectors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete original report under the shared font/master snapshot guard."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            self.apply_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.table.setColumnCount(len(self.masters) + 2)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Glyph", *self.masters, "Masters"])
        self._scope_whole = self.source.currentIndex == 1
        names = self.source_names()
        self._scope_names = tuple(names)
        self.data, self.flagged = {}, []
        for name in names:
            glyph = self.require_glyphs([name])[0]
            if glyph is not None:
                self.data[name] = glyph_counts(glyph, self.masters)
                if incompatible(self.data[name]):
                    self.flagged.append(name)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(self.data)} glyphs × {len(self.masters)} masters · "
            f"cells show contours / nodes drawn in each master",
        )
        rows, odd = [], {}
        for name, counts in self.data.items():
            if self.only_flagged.isChecked() and name not in self.flagged:
                continue
            values = [v for v in counts.values() if v is not None]
            common = max(set(values), key=values.count) if values else None
            cells = [name]
            for column, master in enumerate(self.masters, start=1):
                value = counts.get(master)
                cells.append("auto" if value is None else f"{value[0]} / {value[1]}")
                if value is not None and value != common:
                    odd[len(rows), column] = True
            cells.append("✗ differ" if name in self.flagged else "✓")
            rows.append(tuple(cells))
        last = len(self.masters) + 1
        fill_table(
            self.table,
            rows,
            lambda r, c, text: (
                odd.get((r, c), False) or (c == last and text.startswith("✗"))
            ),
        )
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(self.flagged))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.flagged)} of {len(self.data)} glyphs have masters that differ",
        )

    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Preflight displayed counts before selecting exactly the flagged glyphs."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        self.select_names(self.flagged)
        self.last_result = {"selected": list(self.flagged)}
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(self.flagged)} flagged glyphs in the Font window",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned inspector."""
    return show_script_dialog(NodeStatistics, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
