# this_file: Scripts/Guides/Copy Guides Between Masters.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Merge or replace glyph guides on explicitly selected target masters.

Select glyphs and choose From, To, merge/replace and optional width scaling.
Inspect every add/remove row, then use Copy. Nonpositive widths cannot be scaled.
Matching target guides retain native colour, tags and geometry; hints are kept.
Unsafe automatic dependants are refused before history. Close releases signals.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_action,
    guide_rewrite_api,
    guide_rewrite_dialog_type,
    guides_api,
    masters_make_table,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
TITLE, KEY = "Copy Guides Between Masters", "guides_copy_between_masters"
_api, _guide = guide_rewrite_api(), guides_api()
master_layers, guide_record, glyph_guides = (
    _guide.master_layers,
    _guide.guide_record,
    _guide.glyph_guides,
)
target_records, scaled = _api.target_records, _api.scaled


class CopyGuides(guide_rewrite_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original guide controls on the shared owned lifecycle."""

    ACTION = "Copy"

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Finish controls before any native source read."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Retain every original control and callback."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self.last_result = None
        self.glyphs = []
        self.glyph = None
        self.pending_targets = set()
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.source = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.source.addItems(self.masters)
        if self.current_master in self.masters:
            self.source.setCurrentIndex(self.masters.index(self.current_master))
        targets = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        self.targets_grid = targets
        targets.setHorizontalSpacing(14)
        self.target_checks = {}
        for index, master in enumerate(self.masters):
            check = QtGui.QCheckBox(master)
            check.setChecked(True)
            self.target_checks[master] = check
            targets.addWidget(check, index // 3, index % 3)
        self.mode = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.mode.addItems(["Add to the target guides", "Replace the target guides"])
        self.follow_width = QtGui.QCheckBox(
            "Scale x positions by the advance-width ratio"
        )
        self.follow_width.setChecked(True)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("From"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.source, 0, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("To"), 1, 0, QtCore.Qt.AlignTop)
        form.addLayout(targets, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Mode"), 2, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.mode, 2, 1)
        form.addWidget(self.follow_width, 3, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.table = masters_make_table(
            ["Glyph · master", "Guide", "Position", "Action"], 220
        )
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        self._connect(self.source.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        for check in self.target_checks.values():
            self._connect(check.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.mode.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.follow_width.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())

    def targets(self) -> Any:
        source = self.source.currentText
        return [
            m for m in self.masters if m != source and self.target_checks[m].isChecked()
        ]

    def position(self, record: Any) -> Any:
        x, y, angle, _ = record
        return (
            f"y {y:g}"
            if angle == 0
            else f"x {x:g}"
            if angle == 90
            else f"{x:g}, {y:g} · {angle:g}°"
        )

    def plan(self) -> Any:
        """[(glyph, master, layer, old records, new records or None, note)]."""
        self.check_binding()
        planned = []
        source_master = self.source.currentText
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            source = glyph.findLayer(source_master)
            if source is None or source.isNull:
                continue
            for master, layer in master_layers(glyph, self.targets()):
                old = [guide_record(g) for g in glyph_guides(layer)]
                if layer.autoLayer:
                    planned.append(
                        (glyph, master, layer, old, None, "auto layer, skipped")
                    )
                    continue
                new = target_records(
                    source,
                    layer,
                    self.mode.currentIndex == 1,
                    self.follow_width.isChecked(),
                )
                note = "zero advance width, skipped" if new is None else ""
                planned.append((glyph, master, layer, old, new, note))
        self.pending_targets = {
            g.name
            for g, m, layer, old, new, note in planned
            if new is not None and new != old
        }
        return planned

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> Any:
        for master, check in self.target_checks.items():
            check.setEnabled(master != self.source.currentText)
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            names = ", ".join(g.name for g in self.glyphs[:8]) + (
                " …" if count > 8 else ""
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Copies glyph guides in {count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')}: {names}"
            )
        rows, changes = ([], 0)
        for glyph, master, _layer, old, new, note in self.plan() if self.glyphs else []:
            label = f"{glyph.name} · {master}"
            if new is None:
                rows.append((label, note, "", ""))
                continue
            rows.extend(
                (label, record[3] or "(unnamed)", self.position(record), "remove")
                for record in old
                if record not in new
            )
            rows.extend(
                (label, record[3] or "(unnamed)", self.position(record), "add")
                for record in new
                if record not in old
            )
            if new != old:
                changes += 1
        self.fill_guide_rows(rows, {2}, 3)
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(changes > 0)
        self.status.setText(f"{changes} layer{('s' if changes != 1 else '')} to change")
        self.guard_apply(changes)

    @components_action
    def apply(self) -> Any:
        jobs = [
            (glyph, layer, new)
            for glyph, master, layer, old, new, note in self.plan()
            if new is not None and new != old
        ]
        self.last_result = _api.replace_guides(self.package, jobs, TITLE)
        self.refresh()
        self.status.setText(f"Copied guides to {self.last_result['layers']} layers")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete owned guide editor."""
    return show_script_dialog(CopyGuides, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Guides/Font Guides Panel.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""List font-guide names and add named horizontal or vertical glyph guides.

Select glyphs, run the script, name a guide and choose its position and master
scope. Inspect every planned row, then use Add glyph guide. Existing matching
guides and automatic layers are kept. Fonts whose automatic dependants cannot
be restored by Undo are refused before editing. Close releases owned signals.
This panel adds glyph guides; it does not add font-wide guides.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_action,
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - retain the original public helper.
    guides_api,
    guides_dialog_type,
    masters_make_table,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
TITLE, KEY = "Font Guides Panel", "guides_font_guides_panel"
_api = guides_api()
font_guide_names, master_layers, guide_record, glyph_guides = (
    _api.font_guide_names,
    _api.master_layers,
    _api.guide_record,
    _api.glyph_guides,
)


class FontGuidesPanel(guides_dialog_type()):
    """List font-guide names and add a complete named glyph guide."""

    ACTION = "Add glyph guide"

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Use the shared owned shell, with status and Close before font binding."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build the original controls before the first native source access."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(540)
        self.glyphs = []
        self.pending_targets = set()
        self.last_result = None
        root = self.root
        self.font_guides = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.font_guides.setWordWrap(True)
        root.addWidget(self.font_guides)
        self.notice = QtGui.QLabel(
            "Font guide names are shown above. Add a glyph guide to the selected glyphs below."
        )
        self.notice.setWordWrap(True)
        self.notice.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link).name()};"
        )
        root.addWidget(self.notice)
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.direction = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.direction.addItems(["Horizontal", "Vertical"])
        self.position = self._spin(-5000, 5000, 0)
        self.guide_name = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.guide_name.setPlaceholderText("guide name")
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Direction"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.direction, 0, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Position"), 0, 2)
        form.addWidget(self.position, 0, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Name"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.guide_name, 1, 1, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Masters"), 2, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.scope, 2, 1, 1, 3)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(3, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.table = masters_make_table(
            ["Glyph · master", "Glyph guides now", "Action"], 180
        )
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        self._connect(self.direction.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.position.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.guide_name.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())

    def record(self) -> tuple:
        """Read the original named horizontal/vertical guide coordinates."""
        value = float(self.position.value)
        name = self.guide_name.text.strip()
        return (
            (0.0, value, 0.0, name)
            if self.direction.currentIndex == 0
            else (value, 0.0, 90.0, name)
        )

    def plan(self) -> list:
        """[(glyph, master, layer, guide count, action)]; action is add / exists / auto layer."""
        self.check_binding()
        record = self.record()
        planned = []
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            for master, layer in master_layers(glyph, self.chosen_masters()):
                existing = [guide_record(g) for g in glyph_guides(layer)]
                action = (
                    "auto layer, skipped"
                    if layer.autoLayer
                    else "exists"
                    if record in existing
                    else "add"
                )
                planned.append((glyph, master, layer, len(existing), action))
        self.pending_targets = {
            g.name for (g, m, layer, n, action) in planned if action == "add"
        }
        return planned

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Show all planned rows and current font-guide names before Apply."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.font_guides.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            names = font_guide_names(self.package)
            listed = ", ".join(names) if names else "none"
            self.font_guides.setText(f"Font guides in {self.current_master}: {listed}")
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is not None and (not count):
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        elif count:
            names = ", ".join(g.name for g in self.glyphs[:8]) + (
                " …" if count > 8 else ""
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')}: {names}"
            )
        rows = [
            (f"{g.name} · {m}", str(n), action)
            for (g, m, layer, n, action) in (self.plan() if self.glyphs else [])
        ]
        self.fill_guide_rows(rows, {1}, 2)
        adds = sum(1 for cells in rows if cells[2] == "add")
        named = bool(self.guide_name.text.strip())
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(adds > 0 and named)
        self.status.setText(
            f"{adds} layer{('s' if adds != 1 else '')} to change"
            if named
            else "Name the guide to add it"
        )
        self.guard_apply(adds)

    @components_action
    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Recheck the complete source and write the original jobs as one Undo step."""
        record = self.record()
        jobs = [
            (g, layer, [record])
            for (g, m, layer, n, action) in self.plan()
            if action == "add"
        ]
        self.last_result = _api.add_guides(self.package, jobs, TITLE)
        self.refresh()
        self.status.setText(f"Added {self.last_result['guides']} glyph guides")

    def option_values(self) -> tuple:
        """Bind the exact record and master scope shown in the preview."""
        return (self.scope.currentIndex, self.record())


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete owned modeless guide panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(FontGuidesPanel, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Guides/Grid Generator.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Preview and add named horizontal, vertical or combined glyph-guide grids.

Select glyphs, choose current or all masters and inspect the complete preview.
Existing matching guides and automatic layers are kept. Apply uses one named Undo
step. Unsafe automatic dependants are refused before history. Close releases all
owned signals and preview paths. No font-wide guides or outlines are changed.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_action,
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - retain the original public helper.
    guides_api,
    guides_dialog_type,
    guides_preview_type,
    masters_make_table,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
TITLE, KEY = "Grid Generator", "guides_grid_generator"
_api = guides_api()
master_layers, guide_record, glyph_guides = (
    _api.master_layers,
    _api.guide_record,
    _api.glyph_guides,
)
layer_path, grid = _api.layer_path, _api.grid

DIRECTIONS = ["Horizontal and vertical", "Horizontal", "Vertical"]
GridPreview = guides_preview_type()


class GridGenerator(guides_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original guide controls on the shared owned modeless shell."""

    ACTION = "Apply"

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Use the shared owned shell and late native binding."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build all original controls before reading native source."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(540)
        (self.glyphs, self.planned) = ([], [])
        self.pending_targets = set()
        self.last_result = None
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.direction = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.direction.addItems(DIRECTIONS)
        self.origin = self._spin(-5000, 5000, 0)
        self.step = self._spin(1, 5000, 100)
        self.count = self._spin(1, 100, 5)
        self.count.setSuffix("")
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Lines"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.direction, 0, 1, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Origin"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.origin, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Step"), 1, 2)
        form.addWidget(self.step, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Count"), 2, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.count, 2, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Masters"), 3, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.scope, 3, 1, 1, 3)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(3, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.preview = GridPreview()
        self.preview.on_error = lambda message: self.status.setText(
            f"Preview error: {message}"
        )
        root.addWidget(self.preview, 1)
        self._connect(self.direction.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        for spin in (self.origin, self.step, self.count):
            self._connect(spin.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self.table = masters_make_table(
            ["Glyph · master", "Guides to add", "Already there"], 120
        )
        root.addWidget(self.table)
        self.preview.before_draw = self.check_preview
        self.preview.on_error = self.paint_report
        self.preview.failure_cleanup = self.paint_report

    def records(self) -> Any:
        """Retain original guide controls, complete data and guarded native actions."""
        return grid(
            self.direction.currentIndex,
            self.origin.value,
            self.step.value,
            self.count.value,
        )

    def plan(self) -> Any:
        """[(glyph, master, layer, [records to add], [records already there])]."""
        self.check_binding()
        wanted = self.records()
        planned = []
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            for master, layer in master_layers(glyph, self.chosen_masters()):
                existing = {guide_record(g) for g in glyph_guides(layer)}
                planned.append(
                    (
                        glyph,
                        master,
                        layer,
                        [r for r in wanted if r not in existing],
                        [r for r in wanted if r in existing],
                    )
                )
        self.pending_targets = {
            g.name
            for (g, m, layer, add, there) in planned
            if add and (not layer.autoLayer)
        }
        return planned

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Retain original guide controls, complete data and guarded native actions."""
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            names = ", ".join(g.name for g in self.glyphs[:8]) + (
                " …" if count > 8 else ""
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Adds grid guides to {count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')}: {names}"
            )
        records = self.records()
        if self.glyphs:
            layer = self.glyphs[0].findLayer(self.current_master)
            metrics = fontlab.FontMetrics(self.package, self.current_master)
            frame = (float(metrics.descender), float(metrics.ascender))
            if layer is not None and (not layer.isNull):
                self.preview.set_content(
                    layer_path(layer), layer.advanceWidth, records, frame
                )
        else:
            self.preview.set_content(None, 0, records, (-250.0, 750.0))
        rows = []
        for glyph, master, layer, add, there in self.plan() if self.glyphs else []:
            if layer.autoLayer:
                rows.append((f"{glyph.name} · {master}", "auto layer, skipped", ""))
            else:
                rows.append(
                    (f"{glyph.name} · {master}", str(len(add)), str(len(there)))
                )
        self.fill_guide_rows(rows, {1, 2}, None)
        adds = sum(int(cells[1]) for cells in rows if cells[1].isdigit())
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(adds > 0)
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(records)} grid lines · {adds} guide{('s' if adds != 1 else '')} to add"
        )
        self.guard_apply(adds)

    @components_action
    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Retain original guide controls, complete data and guarded native actions."""
        jobs = [
            (glyph, layer, add)
            for (glyph, master, layer, add, there) in self.plan()
            if not layer.autoLayer
        ]
        self.last_result = _api.add_guides(self.package, jobs, TITLE)
        self.refresh()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Added {self.last_result['guides']} guides to {self.last_result['layers']} layers"
        )

    def option_values(self) -> tuple:
        """Bind each visible control used by the guide preview."""
        return (
            self.scope.currentIndex,
            self.direction.currentIndex,
            self.origin.value,
            self.step.value,
            self.count.value,
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete owned modeless guide panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(GridGenerator, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Guides/Guide List Editor.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Edit glyph-guide coordinates, angles and names of the first selected glyph.

Choose current or all masters. Edit X, Y, angle in degrees and name; Add guide,
Delete selected and Revert change the proposal. Apply makes each editable master
match its rows in one Undo step. Unchanged guides retain their native properties;
hints are kept. Bad/non-finite cells and unknown masters refuse the whole write.
Unsafe automatic dependants are refused. Close releases signals and glyphs.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_action,
    guide_editor_dialog_type,
    guide_rewrite_api,
    guides_api,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
TITLE, KEY = "Guide List Editor", "guides_list_editor"
_api, _guide = guide_rewrite_api(), guides_api()
master_layers, guide_record, glyph_guides = (
    _guide.master_layers,
    _guide.guide_record,
    _guide.glyph_guides,
)
COLUMNS = ["Master", "X", "Y", "Angle °", "Name"]
parse_row = _api.parse_row


class ListEditor(guide_editor_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original guide controls on the shared owned lifecycle."""

    ACTION = "Apply"

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Finish controls before any native source read."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Retain every original control and callback."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self.last_result = None
        self.glyphs = []
        self.glyph = None
        self.pending_targets = set()
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Masters"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.scope, 0, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(COLUMNS)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(220)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        rows = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.add_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Add guide")
        self.delete_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Delete selected")
        self.reload_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Revert")
        rows.addWidget(self.add_button)
        rows.addWidget(self.delete_button)
        rows.addStretch(1)
        rows.addWidget(self.reload_button)
        root.addLayout(rows)
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.reload())
        self._connect(self.add_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.add_row())
        self._connect(self.delete_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.delete_row())
        self._connect(self.reload_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.reload())

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def reload(self) -> Any:
        """Fill the table from the font (discards unapplied edits)."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif self.glyph is None:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select a glyph in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            skipped = [m for m, layer in self.layers() if layer.autoLayer]
            note = (
                f" · auto layer{('s' if len(skipped) != 1 else '')} not editable: {', '.join(skipped)}"
                if skipped
                else ""
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Glyph guides of {self.glyph.name}; Apply makes each master match its rows{note}"
            )
        rows = [
            (m, guide_record(g))
            for m, layer in self.layers()
            if not layer.autoLayer
            for g in glyph_guides(layer)
        ]
        self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, (master, values) in enumerate(rows):
            self.set_row(row, master, values)
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(self.editable_masters()))
        self.status.setText(f"{len(rows)} guide{('s' if len(rows) != 1 else '')}")
        self.table.setEnabled(self.glyph is not None)
        self.add_button.setEnabled(bool(self.editable_masters()))
        self.delete_button.setEnabled(bool(self.editable_masters()))
        self.pending_targets = {self.glyph.name} if self.glyph is not None else set()
        self.guard_apply(len(self.editable_masters()))

    @components_action
    def apply(self) -> Any:
        wanted = self.table_records()
        jobs = []
        for master, layer in self.layers():
            if (
                master in wanted
                and [guide_record(g) for g in glyph_guides(layer)] != wanted[master]
            ):
                jobs.append((self.glyph, layer, wanted[master]))
        self.last_result = _api.replace_guides(self.package, jobs, TITLE)
        self.reload()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Updated guides on {self.last_result['layers']} master{('s' if self.last_result['layers'] != 1 else '')}"
        )

    refresh = reload


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete owned guide editor."""
    return show_script_dialog(ListEditor, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Existing matching guides and automatic layers are kept. Apply uses one named Undo
step. Unsafe automatic dependants are refused before history. Close releases all
owned signals and preview paths. No font-wide guides or outlines are changed.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    components_action,
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - retain the original public helper.
    guides_api,
    guides_dialog_type,
    masters_make_table,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
TITLE, KEY = "Metric Reference Lines", "guides_metric_lines"
_api = guides_api()
master_layers, guide_record, glyph_guides, layer_path, metric_values = (
    _api.master_layers,
    _api.guide_record,
    _api.glyph_guides,
    _api.layer_path,
    _api.metric_values,
)
METRICS = _api.METRICS


class MetricLines(guides_dialog_type()):
    """Complete original guide controls on the shared owned modeless shell."""

    ACTION = "Apply"

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Use the shared owned shell and late native binding."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build all original controls before reading native source."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(540)
        (self.glyphs, self.planned) = ([], [])
        self.pending_targets = set()
        self.last_result = None
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        checks = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        checks.setSpacing(14)
        self.metric_checks = {}
        for label, _ in METRICS:
            check = QtGui.QCheckBox(label)
            check.setChecked(True)
            self.metric_checks[label] = check
            checks.addWidget(check)
        checks.addStretch(1)
        self.offset = self._spin(-2000, 2000, 0)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Lines"), 0, 0)
        form.addLayout(checks, 0, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Offset"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.offset, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Masters"), 2, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.scope, 2, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        for check in self.metric_checks.values():
            self._connect(check.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.offset.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self.table = masters_make_table(["Glyph · master", "Guide", "y", "Action"], 220)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

    def plan(self) -> Any:
        """[(glyph, master, layer, [(record, action)])]; action is add / exists / auto."""
        self.check_binding()
        wanted = [
            label for (label, _) in METRICS if self.metric_checks[label].isChecked()
        ]
        values = {m: metric_values(self.package, m) for m in self.chosen_masters()}
        rows = []
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            for master, layer in master_layers(glyph, self.chosen_masters()):
                records = [
                    (
                        0.0,
                        round(values[master][label] + self.offset.value, 2),
                        0.0,
                        label,
                    )
                    for label in wanted
                ]
                if layer.autoLayer:
                    rows.append(
                        (
                            glyph,
                            master,
                            layer,
                            [(r, "auto layer, skipped") for r in records],
                        )
                    )
                    continue
                existing = {guide_record(g) for g in glyph_guides(layer)}
                rows.append(
                    (
                        glyph,
                        master,
                        layer,
                        [(r, "exists" if r in existing else "add") for r in records],
                    )
                )
        self.pending_targets = {
            g.name
            for (g, m, layer, entries) in rows
            if any(action == "add" for (record, action) in entries)
        }
        return rows

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Retain original guide controls, complete data and guarded native actions."""
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            names = ", ".join(g.name for g in self.glyphs[:8]) + (
                " …" if count > 8 else ""
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Adds horizontal glyph guides to {count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')}: {names}"
            )
        self.planned = self.plan() if self.glyphs else []
        rows = [
            (f"{g.name} · {m}", r[3], f"{r[1]:g}", action)
            for (g, m, layer, entries) in self.planned
            for (r, action) in entries
        ]
        self.fill_guide_rows(rows, {2}, 3)
        adds = sum(1 for cells in rows if cells[3] == "add")
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(adds > 0)
        self.status.setText(f"{adds} guide{('s' if adds != 1 else '')} to add")
        self.guard_apply(adds)

    @components_action
    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Retain original guide controls, complete data and guarded native actions."""
        jobs = [
            (g, layer, [r for (r, action) in entries if action == "add"])
            for (g, m, layer, entries) in self.plan()
            if not layer.autoLayer
        ]
        self.last_result = _api.add_guides(self.package, jobs, TITLE)
        self.refresh()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Added {self.last_result['guides']} guides to {self.last_result['layers']} layers"
        )

    def option_values(self) -> tuple:
        """Bind each visible control used by the guide preview."""
        return (
            self.scope.currentIndex,
            self.offset.value,
            tuple(
                (label, check.isChecked())
                for (label, check) in self.metric_checks.items()
            ),
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete owned modeless guide panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(MetricLines, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Classes Browser.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Classes Browser
"""Browse kerning classes: their side, members, and every pair that uses them on each master.

The list on the left shows each class with its side (left = first glyph of a pair, right =
second) and size; filter it by class or member name. Pick a class to see its members and the
pairs that use it with one value column per master. "Select members" selects the class's glyphs
in the Font window. Nothing is edited.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
# The tiny facade stays lazy until a native menu script asks for its panel.
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_classes,
    kerning_dialog_type,
    kerning_pairs,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_snapshot_refresh as snapshot_refresh,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,
)

KerningDialog = kerning_dialog_type()

TITLE = "Kerning Classes"
KEY = "kerning_classes_browser"
SIDES = {"KernLeft": "left", "KernRight": "right", "KernBothSide": "both"}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def pairs_using(package: Any, masters: list[str], name: str) -> dict:
    """{(left, right): {master: value}} for pairs with @name on either side."""
    tag, rows = "@" + name, {}
    for master in masters:
        for (left, right), value in kerning_pairs(package, master).items():
            if tag in {left, right}:
                rows.setdefault((left, right), {})[master] = value
    return rows


def matches(name: str, members: list[str], text: str) -> bool:
    """Class name contains the text (any case), or a member is exactly the text (glyph names are case-sensitive)."""
    text = text.strip()
    return not text or text.lower() in name.lower() or text in members


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI


class ClassesBrowser(KerningDialog):
    """Retain the original Classes Browser controls on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Initialize owned controls without changing the font."""
        KerningDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)

        self.classes = (
            kerning_classes(self.package, self.current_master) if self.package else {}
        )
        self.names, self.selected = [], None
        root = self.root

        self.filter = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.filter.setPlaceholderText("Filter by class name or member glyph")
        self.filter.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        root.addWidget(self.filter)

        self.splitter = QtGui.QSplitter(QtCore.Qt.Horizontal)
        self.list = QtGui.QListWidget()
        self.list.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.list.setMinimumWidth(220)
        self.splitter.addWidget(self.list)

        detail = QtGui.QWidget()
        side = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(detail)
        side.setContentsMargins(12, 0, 0, 0)
        side.setSpacing(8)
        self.title = QtGui.QLabel()
        title_font = self.title.font
        title_font.setBold(True)
        title_font.setPointSizeF(title_font.pointSizeF() * 1.15)
        self.title.setFont(title_font)
        side.addWidget(self.title)
        self.members = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.members.setWordWrap(True)
        self.members.setTextInteractionFlags(QtCore.Qt.TextSelectableByMouse)
        side.addWidget(self.members)
        self.pairs = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(self.masters) + 1)
        self.pairs.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Pair", *self.masters])
        self.pairs.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.pairs.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.pairs.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        self.pairs.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.pairs.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.pairs.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.pairs.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        side.addWidget(self.pairs, 1)
        self.splitter.addWidget(detail)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        root.addWidget(self.splitter, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select members")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.filter.textChanged, lambda *a: self.fill())
        self._connect(self.list.currentRowChanged, self.show_class)
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_members())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.fill()

    @snapshot_refresh
    def fill(self) -> None:
        """Render the complete filtered rows from the current snapshot."""
        text = self.filter.text
        self.names = sorted(
            n for n, (members, _) in self.classes.items() if matches(n, members, text)
        )
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            counts = {
                s: sum(1 for _, side in self.classes.values() if side == s)
                for s in ("left", "right", "both")
            }
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(self.classes)} classes: {counts['left']} left, {counts['right']} right, "
                f"{counts['both']} both sides. Values are shown for all {len(self.masters)} masters.",
            )
        self.list.clear()
        for name in self.names:
            members, side = self.classes[name]
            self.list.addItem(f"@{name}   {side} · {len(members)}")
        self.status.setText(f"{len(self.names)} of {len(self.classes)} classes")
        if self.names:
            self.list.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self.show_class(-1)

    @snapshot_refresh
    def show_class(self, row: int) -> None:
        """Show the selected class members and every master pair value."""
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.names):
            self.selected = None
            self.title.setText("No class")
            self.members.setText("")
            self.pairs.setRowCount(0)
            self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        name = self.names[row]
        members, side = self.classes[name]
        self.selected = name
        self.title.setText(f"@{name} · {side} side")
        self.members.setText(" ".join(members))
        rows = pairs_using(self.package, self.masters, name)
        QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        self.pairs.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for r, pair in enumerate(sorted(rows)):
            label = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(f"{pair[0]}  {pair[1]}")
            self.pairs.setItem(r, 0, label)
            for column, master in enumerate(self.masters, 1):
                value = rows[pair].get(master)
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("–" if value is None else f"{value:g}")
                item.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                )
                if value is None:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(QtGui.QColor(muted(self))))
                self.pairs.setItem(r, column, item)
        self.select_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.status.setText(
            f"@{name}: {len(members)} members, used in {len(rows)} pairs",
        )
        self.pair_rows = {f"{l} {r}": v for (l, r), v in rows.items()}

    def select_class(self, name: str) -> None:
        """Show a class by name (used by tests and handy from the console)."""
        self.list.setCurrentRow(self.names.index(name))

    def select_members(self) -> None:
        """Select validated class members only in the scanned current font."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        if self.selected is None:
            return
        members = self.classes[self.selected][0]
        self.select_names(members)
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(members)} glyphs of @{self.selected} in the Font window",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry window and show this owned modeless panel."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(ClassesBrowser, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.text:
Line up every kerning pair across all masters and flag the ones that look inconsistent.

Each row is one pair (glyph or @class sides) with its value on every master; a pair missing on a master shows a dash. Rows are flagged when the sign flips between masters, when a pair exists on some masters only, or when neighbouring masters differ by more than the jump threshold. Tick "Only flagged" to proof just those. Nothing is edited.

Run Kerning > Compare Masters from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Compare Masters.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Compare Masters
"""Line up every kerning pair across all masters and flag the ones that look inconsistent.

Each row is one pair (glyph or @class sides) with its value on every master; a pair missing
on a master shows a dash. Rows are flagged when the sign flips between masters, when a pair
exists on some masters only, or when neighbouring masters differ by more than the jump
threshold. Tick "Only flagged" to proof just those. Nothing is edited.
"""

import itertools
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
# The tiny facade stays lazy until a native menu script asks for its panel.
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_dialog_type,
    kerning_pairs,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_snapshot_refresh as snapshot_refresh,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,
)

KerningDialog = kerning_dialog_type()

TITLE = "Compare Kerning Across Masters"
KEY = "kerning_compare_masters"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def table(
    package: Any, masters: list[str]
) -> dict[tuple[str, str], list[float | None]]:
    """{(left, right): [value or None per master]} sorted by pair."""
    per_master = [kerning_pairs(package, m) for m in masters]
    keys = sorted(set().union(*per_master)) if per_master else []
    return {k: [p.get(k) for p in per_master] for k in keys}


def flags(values: list[float | None], threshold: float) -> list[str]:
    """Reasons a row looks inconsistent: 'sign', 'missing', 'jump'."""
    present = [v for v in values if v is not None]
    reasons = []
    if any(v < 0 for v in present) and any(v > 0 for v in present):
        reasons.append("sign")
    if len(present) < len(values):
        reasons.append("missing")
    if any(abs(b - a) > threshold for a, b in itertools.pairwise(present)):
        reasons.append("jump")
    return reasons


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI


class CompareMasters(KerningDialog):
    """Retain the original Compare Masters controls on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Initialize owned controls without changing the font."""
        KerningDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)

        self.rows, self.shown = {}, []
        root = self.root

        controls = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        controls.setSpacing(10)
        self.search = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.search.setPlaceholderText("Filter pairs, e.g. A or @L_")
        self.threshold = QtGui.QSpinBox()
        self.threshold.setRange(0, 1000)
        self.threshold.setValue(40)
        self.threshold.setSuffix(" units")
        self.threshold.setAlignment(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight)
        self.only_flagged = QtGui.QCheckBox("Only flagged")
        controls.addWidget(self.search, 1)
        controls.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Jump above"))
        controls.addWidget(self.threshold)
        controls.addWidget(self.only_flagged)
        root.addLayout(controls)

        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(self.masters) + 2)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Pair", *self.masters, "Flags"])
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(260)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.reload_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Reload")
        footer.addWidget(self.reload_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.search.textChanged, lambda *a: self.fill())
        self._connect(self.threshold.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.fill())
        self._connect(self.only_flagged.toggled, lambda *a: self.fill())
        self._connect(self.reload_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.reload())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.reload()

    @snapshot_refresh
    def reload(self) -> None:
        """Read every master without changing the active master."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        self.rows = table(self.package, self.masters)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(self.rows)} pairs across {len(self.masters)} masters. Flags: sign = the value "
            "changes sign, missing = absent on some masters, jump = neighbouring masters "
            "differ by more than the threshold.",
        )
        self.fill()

    @snapshot_refresh
    def fill(self) -> None:
        """Render the complete filtered rows from the current snapshot."""
        needle = self.search.text.strip()
        threshold = self.threshold.value
        warn = QtGui.QColor(196, 72, 48)
        self.shown = []
        for (left, right), values in self.rows.items():
            if needle and needle not in left and needle not in right:
                continue
            reasons = flags(values, threshold)
            if self.only_flagged.checked and not reasons:
                continue
            self.shown.append(((left, right), values, reasons))
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.shown))
        for row, ((left, right), values, reasons) in enumerate(self.shown):
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(f"{left}  {right}"))
            for column, value in enumerate(values, 1):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("–" if value is None else f"{value:g}")
                item.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                )
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            note = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(", ".join(reasons))
            if reasons:
                note.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(warn))
            self.table.setItem(row, len(values) + 1, note)
        flagged = sum(1 for values in self.rows.values() if flags(values, threshold))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.shown)} rows shown · {flagged} of {len(self.rows)} pairs flagged",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry window and show this owned modeless panel."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(CompareMasters, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.text:
Copy the kerning of one master to other masters, optionally scaled.

Start a new master's kerning from an existing one, or push corrections from the Regular to its neighbours. "Replace" makes the targets identical to the source, "Add missing" only adds pairs the target lacks, "Overwrite matching" updates pairs both have. The summary shows, per target, how many pairs are added, changed and removed. One Apply is one Undo step for all targets.

Run Kerning > Copy Between Masters from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Copy Between Masters.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Copy Between Masters
"""Copy the kerning of one master to other masters, optionally scaled.

Start a new master's kerning from an existing one, or push corrections from the Regular to its
neighbours. "Replace" makes the targets identical to the source, "Add missing" only adds pairs
the target lacks, "Overwrite matching" updates pairs both have. The summary shows, per target,
how many pairs are added, changed and removed. One Apply is one Undo step for all targets."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_edit_dialog_type,
    kerning_editor_api,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_editor_apply as editor_apply,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_editor_refresh as editor_refresh,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
api = kerning_editor_api()
KerningEditDialog = kerning_edit_dialog_type()
native_side = api.native_side
current_package = ap.scripting.current_package
kerning_pairs = ap.scripting.kerning_pairs

TITLE = "Copy Kerning Between Masters"
KEY = "kerning_copy_between_masters"
MODES = [
    ("Replace all pairs", "replace"),
    ("Add missing pairs only", "missing"),
    ("Overwrite matching pairs, keep others", "matching"),
]


def write_kerning(
    package: Any, edits: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], int | None]]
) -> None:
    """Apply a fully validated multi-master batch using the tool's native Undo label."""
    api.write_kerning(package, edits, TITLE)


scaled, plan, summary = api.scaled, api.copy_plan, api.summary


def run(
    package: Any,
    source_master: str,
    targets: list[str],
    mode: str,
    percent: float,
    *,
    expected: Any = None,
) -> dict[str, tuple[int, int, int]]:
    """Stage all target masters before a single snapshot-bound history batch."""
    return api.copy_run(
        package,
        source_master,
        targets,
        mode,
        percent,
        expected=expected,
        undo_name=TITLE,
    )


class CopyKerning(KerningEditDialog):
    """Retain the complete original Copy Between Masters workflow with shared native safety."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:

        KerningEditDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)
        root = self.root

        self.targets.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Master", "Pairs now", "Added", "Changed", "Removed"]
        )
        self.targets.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.targets.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.targets.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        self.targets.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.targets.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.targets.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.targets.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.targets.setMinimumHeight(160)
        root.addWidget(self.targets, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.apply_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy")
        self.apply_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.apply_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self.add_refresh(footer, self.rebuild)
        self.checked = dict.fromkeys(self.masters, False)
        self._connect(self.source.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.rebuild())
        self._connect(self.mode.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.percent.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.targets.itemChanged, self.toggled)
        self._connect(self.apply_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.apply())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.rebuild()

    def source_master(self) -> str:
        """Return the chosen source master without activating it in FontLab."""
        return self.masters[self.source.currentIndex] if self.masters else ""

    def chosen_targets(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return checked target names, excluding the current source."""
        return [
            m for m in self.masters if self.checked.get(m) and m != self.source_master()
        ]

    def set_targets(self, names: list[str]) -> None:
        """Tick exactly these target masters (used by scripts and tests)."""
        self.checked = {m: m in names for m in self.masters}
        self.refresh()

    def toggled(self, item: Any) -> None:
        """Update the original controls while retaining the shared safety boundary."""
        if self.filling or item.column() != 0:
            return
        self.checked[item.text()] = item.checkState() == QtCore.Qt.Checked
        self.refresh()

    def rebuild(self) -> None:
        """One checkable row per target master; rebuilt only when the source changes."""
        others = [m for m in self.masters if m != self.source_master()]
        self.filling = True
        self.targets.setRowCount(len(others))
        for row, master in enumerate(others):
            name = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(master)
            name.setCheckState(
                QtCore.Qt.Checked if self.checked.get(master) else QtCore.Qt.Unchecked
            )
            self.targets.setItem(row, 0, name)
            for column in range(1, 5):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("")
                item.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
                )
                self.targets.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.filling = False
        self.refresh()

    @editor_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Update the numbers in place: items are never replaced inside their own signal."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        source_name = self.source_master()
        source = kerning_pairs(self.package, source_name)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{source_name} has {len(source)} pairs. Tick the masters that receive them."
        )
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        plain = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.filling = True
        total = 0
        for row in range(self.targets.rowCount):
            name = self.targets.item(row, 0)
            master = name.text()
            name.setCheckState(
                QtCore.Qt.Checked if self.checked.get(master) else QtCore.Qt.Unchecked
            )
            target = kerning_pairs(self.package, master)
            numbers = [len(target), "", "", ""]
            if self.checked.get(master):
                (added, changed, removed) = summary(
                    target, plan(source, target, self.mode_key(), self.percent.value)
                )
                numbers = [len(target), added, changed, removed]
                total += added + changed + removed
            for column, value in enumerate(numbers, 1):
                item = self.targets.item(row, column)
                item.setText(str(value))
                item.setForeground(
                    QtGui.QBrush(accent if column > 1 and value else plain)
                )
        self.filling = False
        chosen = self.chosen_targets()
        self.status.setText(
            f"{total} pair edits in {len(chosen)} master{('s' if len(chosen) != 1 else '')}"
            if chosen
            else "Tick at least one target master"
        )
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(chosen) and total > 0)

    def mode_key(self) -> str:
        """Return the exact selected copy policy used in preview and Apply."""
        return MODES[self.mode.currentIndex][1]

    @editor_apply
    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Write the complete displayed batch, refresh its baseline and report counts."""
        result = run(
            self.package,
            self.source_master(),
            self.chosen_targets(),
            self.mode_key(),
            self.percent.value,
            expected=self._kerning_snapshot,
        )
        self.last_result = result
        self._batch_written = any(sum(counts) for counts in result.values())
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.refresh_after_apply(self.refresh)
        self.status.setText(
            "Copied: "
            + " · ".join(f"{m} +{a} ~{c} −{r}" for (m, (a, c, r)) in result.items())
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace only this tool's registry entry and show the owned modeless dialog."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(CopyKerning, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Exceptions Finder.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Exceptions Finder
"""Find kerning exceptions: pairs that override a class pair, and remove the ones you tick.

An exception is a pair whose glyph side belongs to a kerning class that already has a pair
with the same partner (A V overriding @A V). Exceptions with the same value as the class pair
are redundant and safe to delete; the others are deliberate overrides worth a second look.
Tick rows (or "Tick redundant") and Remove; one Undo step for all masters.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_edit_dialog_type, kerning_selection_api
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_editor_apply as editor_apply
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_editor_make_table as make_table
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_editor_refresh as editor_refresh
from fly.ap.scripting import names_muted as muted

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
api = kerning_selection_api()
KerningEditDialog = kerning_edit_dialog_type()
current_package = ap.scripting.current_package
kerning_pairs = ap.scripting.kerning_pairs

TITLE = "Kerning Exceptions"
KEY = "kerning_exceptions_finder"


class_maps = api.class_maps
native_side = ap.scripting.kerning_editor_api().native_side
exceptions = api.exceptions
find = api.find


def write_kerning(
    package: Any, edits: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], int | None]]
) -> None:
    """Retain the original console interface through the shared preflight writer."""
    ap.scripting.kerning_editor_api().write_kerning(package, edits, TITLE)


class ExceptionsFinder(KerningEditDialog):
    """Preserve all original controls on the shared snapshot-bound native panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Create original controls; connect every callback through owned guards."""
        KerningEditDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(640)
        self.resize(680, 560)
        self.rows = []
        self.filling = False
        root = self.root

        form = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        form.setSpacing(10)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Masters"))
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        form.addWidget(self.scope, 1)
        self.tick_redundant = QtGui.QPushButton("Tick redundant")
        self.tick_none = QtGui.QPushButton("Untick all")
        form.addWidget(self.tick_redundant)
        form.addWidget(self.tick_none)
        root.addLayout(form)

        self.table = make_table(
            ["Exception", "Master", "Value", "Overrides", "Class value", "Δ"]
        )
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(240)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.apply_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Remove ticked")
        self.apply_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.apply_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self.add_refresh(footer, self.refresh)
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.table.itemChanged, lambda *a: self.count())
        self._connect(
            self.tick_redundant.clicked,
            lambda *a: self.tick(lambda row: row[2] == row[4]),
        )
        self._connect(self.tick_none.clicked, lambda *a: self.tick(lambda row: False))
        self._connect(self.apply_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.apply())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()

    def chosen_masters(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return current or all originally captured masters, retaining scope semantics."""
        return [self.current_master] if self.scope.currentIndex == 0 else self.masters

    @editor_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Re-scan the kerning (call again after editing kerning elsewhere)."""
        self.rows = find(self.package, self.chosen_masters()) if self.package else []
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            redundant = sum(1 for r in self.rows if r[2] == r[4])
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(self.rows)} exceptions, {redundant} of them redundant (same value as the class pair "
                "they override). Tick the ones to delete.",
            )
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        dim = QtGui.QColor(muted(self))
        self.filling = True
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.rows))
        for row, (master, pair, value, broader, broader_value) in enumerate(self.rows):
            name = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(f"{pair[0]}  {pair[1]}")
            name.setCheckState(QtCore.Qt.Unchecked)
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, name)
            self.table.setItem(row, 1, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(master))
            delta = value - broader_value
            cells = [
                (2, f"{value:g}"),
                (3, f"{broader[0]}  {broader[1]}"),
                (4, f"{broader_value:g}"),
                (5, "same" if not delta else f"{delta:+g}"),
            ]
            for column, text in cells:
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column != 3:
                    item.setTextAlignment(
                        int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                    )
                if column == 5:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(dim if not delta else accent))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.filling = False
        self.count()

    def ticked(
        self,
    ) -> list[tuple[str, tuple[str, str], float, tuple[str, str], float]]:
        """Read actual table check states; never substitute stored tick intentions."""
        return [
            self.rows[r]
            for r in range(self.table.rowCount)
            if self.table.item(r, 0).checkState() == QtCore.Qt.Checked
        ]

    def tick(self, rule: Any) -> None:
        """Apply a predicate to actual row checkboxes and recount once."""
        self.filling = True
        for r, row in enumerate(self.rows):
            self.table.item(r, 0).setCheckState(
                QtCore.Qt.Checked if rule(row) else QtCore.Qt.Unchecked,
            )
        self.filling = False
        self.count()

    def count(self) -> None:
        """Update original tick counts and enable Apply only for selected rows."""
        if self.filling:
            return
        ticked = self.ticked()
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(ticked)} of {len(self.rows)} ticked"
            if self.rows
            else "No exceptions found",
        )
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(ticked))
        self.tick_redundant.setEnabled(any(r[2] == r[4] for r in self.rows))

    @editor_apply
    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Preflight the complete ticked batch, write once, then refresh its baseline."""
        edits = api.exception_plan(self.ticked())
        self.write_edits(edits, TITLE)
        self.last_result = {m: len(p) for m, p in edits.items()}
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.refresh_after_apply(self.refresh)
        self.status.setText(f"Removed {sum(self.last_result.values())} exceptions")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace only this tool's registry entry and show its owned modeless dialog."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(ExceptionsFinder, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Missing Pairs.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Missing Pairs
"""List the combinations of two glyph groups that no kerning pair covers on a master.

Enter left and right glyphs: names separated by spaces, plain characters (“AVT”), or @class
tokens that stand for all their members. Every left + right combination that neither a glyph
pair nor a class pair reaches is listed, ready to proof or to kern. "Copy list" puts the
missing pairs on the clipboard, one "left right" per line. Nothing is edited.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
# The tiny facade stays lazy until a native menu script asks for its panel.
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_class_lists as class_lists,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_dialog_type,
    kerning_pairs,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_snapshot_refresh as snapshot_refresh,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,
)

KerningDialog = kerning_dialog_type()

TITLE = "Missing Kerning Pairs"
KEY = "kerning_missing_pairs"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def parse_glyphs(text: str, package: Any, members: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[str]:
    """Glyph names from 'names', 'characters' and '@class' tokens, unique, in order."""
    out = []
    for token in text.split():
        if token.startswith("@") and token[1:] in members:
            names = members[token[1:]]
        elif package.findName(token) is not None:
            names = [token]
        else:
            names = [
                g.name
                for g in (package.findUnicode(ord(c)) for c in token)
                if g is not None
            ]
        out += [n for n in names if n not in out]
    return out


def covered(
    pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], float],
    left_classes: dict[str, list[str]],
    right_classes: dict[str, list[str]],
    left: str,
    right: str,
) -> bool:
    """Report explicit glyph/class coverage, including pairs stored with zero.

    Class indexes contain only classes allowed on their respective pair side.
    Any explicit combination of the glyph and its applicable classes covers it.
    """
    lefts = [left, *left_classes.get(left, [])]
    rights = [right, *right_classes.get(right, [])]
    return any((a, b) in pairs for a in lefts for b in rights)


def missing(
    package: Any, master: str, lefts: list[str], rights: list[str]
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Return uncovered left/right Cartesian-product pairs in input order.

    Read the native FontLab package on the named master without switching it.
    A glyph pair or applicable class pair, even with a zero value, covers a pair.
    """
    pairs = kerning_pairs(package, master)
    left_classes, right_classes, _ = class_lists(package, master)
    return [
        (l, r)
        for l in lefts
        for r in rights
        if not covered(pairs, left_classes, right_classes, l, r)
    ]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI


class MissingPairs(KerningDialog):
    """Retain the original Missing Pairs controls on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Initialize owned controls without changing the font."""
        KerningDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)

        self.lefts, self.rights, self.missing = [], [], []
        root = self.root

        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.left_text = QtGui.QLineEdit("AFLPTVWY")
        self.left_text.setPlaceholderText("Left glyphs: names, characters or @class")
        self.right_text = QtGui.QLineEdit("aeosuy")
        self.right_text.setPlaceholderText("Right glyphs: names, characters or @class")
        self.master = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for name in self.masters:
            self.master.addItem(name)
        if self.current_master in self.masters:
            self.master.setCurrentIndex(self.masters.index(self.current_master))
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Left"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.left_text, 0, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Right"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.right_text, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Master"), 2, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.master, 2, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)

        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 2)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Left", "Right"])
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(220)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.copy_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy list")
        self.copy_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        for line in (self.left_text, self.right_text):
            self._connect(line.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.master.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.copy_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.copy())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()

    def chosen_master(self) -> str:
        """Return the master named by the original combo box."""
        return self.masters[self.master.currentIndex] if self.masters else ""

    @snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render a complete native snapshot for the chosen controls."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        _, _, members = class_lists(self.package, self.chosen_master())
        self.lefts = parse_glyphs(self.left_text.text, self.package, members)
        self.rights = parse_glyphs(self.right_text.text, self.package, members)
        self.missing = missing(
            self.package,
            self.chosen_master(),
            self.lefts,
            self.rights,
        )
        combos = len(self.lefts) * len(self.rights)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(self.lefts)} left × {len(self.rights)} right glyphs = {combos} combinations on "
            f"{self.chosen_master()}; listed are those no glyph or class pair covers.",
        )
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.missing))
        for row, (left, right) in enumerate(self.missing):
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(left))
            self.table.setItem(row, 1, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(right))
        share = f" ({100 * len(self.missing) // combos} %)" if combos else ""
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.missing)} of {combos} combinations unkerned{share}",
        )
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(self.missing))

    def copy(self) -> str:
        """Copy the complete missing-pair list after checking the font binding."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        text = "\n".join(f"{l} {r}" for l, r in self.missing)
        QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
        self.status.setText(f"Copied {len(self.missing)} pairs to the clipboard")
        return text


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry window and show this owned modeless panel."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(MissingPairs, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Edit every kerning pair that involves one glyph, with one column per master.

Rows are the pairs where the glyph, or a kerning class it belongs to, is on the left or right. Type a new value in any master's cell; clear a cell to delete that pair on that master. Run Kerning > Pair Editor from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.
