# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Pair Editor.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Pair Editor
"""Edit every kerning pair that involves one glyph, with one column per master.

Rows are the pairs where the glyph, or a kerning class it belongs to, is on the left or right.
Type a new value in any master's cell; clear a cell to delete that pair on that master. Edited
cells turn the accent colour until Apply, which writes all of them as one Undo step. Add a row
for a new partner with the field under the table."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_edit_dialog_type,
    kerning_editor_api,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_editor_apply as editor_apply,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_editor_refresh as editor_refresh,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
api = kerning_editor_api()
KerningEditDialog = kerning_edit_dialog_type()
native_side = api.native_side
current_package = ap.scripting.current_package
kerning_pairs = ap.scripting.kerning_pairs

TITLE = "Kerning Pair Editor"
KEY = "kerning_pair_editor"


def write_kerning(
    package: Any, edits: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], int | None]]
) -> None:
    """Apply a fully validated multi-master batch using the tool's native Undo label."""
    api.write_kerning(package, edits, TITLE)


class_sides, involving, parse_cell = api.class_sides, api.involving, api.parse_cell


def current_glyph_name(package: Any) -> str | None:
    """Keep the original Font-window selection, then current-glyph fallback."""
    names = ap.scripting.names_selected_names() if package is not None else []
    return names[0] if names else None


class PairEditor(KerningEditDialog):
    """Retain the complete original Pair Editor workflow with shared native safety."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Create all original controls on the shared snapshot-bound owned panel."""
        KerningEditDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)
        root = self.root
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self.resize(600, 620)
        self.glyph = current_glyph_name(self.package) if self.package else None
        self.rows = {}
        self.order = []
        self.staged = {}
        self.filling = False
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(self.masters) + 1)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Pair", *self.masters])
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(260)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        add = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        add.setSpacing(8)
        self.side = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.side.addItem(f"{self.glyph or '…'}  +  partner")
        self.side.addItem(f"partner  +  {self.glyph or '…'}")
        self.partner = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.partner.setPlaceholderText("Partner glyph or @class")
        self.add_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Add row")
        add.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("New pair"))
        add.addWidget(self.side)
        add.addWidget(self.partner, 1)
        add.addWidget(self.add_button)
        root.addLayout(add)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.revert_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Revert")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.apply_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Apply")
        self.apply_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.revert_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.apply_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self.add_refresh(footer, self.load)
        self._connect(self.table.itemChanged, self.cell_edited)
        self._connect(self.add_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.add_row())
        self._connect(self.partner.returnPressed, lambda *a: self.add_row())
        self._connect(self.revert_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.load())
        self._connect(self.apply_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.apply())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.load()

    @editor_refresh
    def load(self) -> None:
        """Discard staged cells and read the complete original-font pair table."""
        self.staged = {}
        self.errors = {}
        self.rows = (
            involving(self.package, self.masters, self.glyph)
            if self.package and self.glyph
            else {}
        )
        self.order = sorted(
            self.rows,
            key=lambda p: (p[0] != self.glyph and (not p[0].startswith("@")), p),
        )
        self.fill()

    def fill(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild the table (never called from inside its own itemChanged signal)."""
        self.filling = True
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.order))
        for row, pair in enumerate(self.order):
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(f"{pair[0]}  {pair[1]}"))
            for column, master in enumerate(self.masters, 1):
                value = self.staged.get(
                    (pair, master), self.rows.get(pair, {}).get(master)
                )
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(
                    self.errors.get(
                        (pair, master), "" if value is None else f"{value:g}"
                    )
                )
                item.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
                )
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.filling = False
        self.refresh()

    def cell_edited(self, item: Any) -> None:
        """Stage valid cell input; keep invalid feedback without losing other edits."""
        if self.filling:
            return
        if item.column() == 0:
            self.filling = True
            pair = self.order[item.row()]
            item.setText(f"{pair[0]}  {pair[1]}")
            self.filling = False
            return
        (pair, master) = (self.order[item.row()], self.masters[item.column() - 1])
        self.ensure_edit_snapshot()
        error = self.stage_editor_cell(
            pair, master, item.text(), self.rows.get(pair, {}).get(master)
        )
        self.refresh()
        if error:
            self.status.setText(error)

    def set_cell(self, left: str, right: str, master: str, text: str) -> None:
        """Type into a cell, as a user would (used by tests and handy from the console)."""
        (row, column) = (
            self.order.index((left, right)),
            self.masters.index(master) + 1,
        )
        self.table.item(row, column).setText(text)

    def add_row(self) -> None:
        """Add a valid side-specific glyph/class partner without writing font data."""
        partner = self.partner.text.strip()
        if not partner or self.glyph is None:
            return
        self.ensure_edit_snapshot()
        pair = (
            (self.glyph, partner)
            if self.side.currentIndex == 0
            else (partner, self.glyph)
        )
        if not api.partner_exists(self.package, self.masters, pair):
            self.status.setText(f"No glyph or side-compatible class named “{partner}”")
            return
        if pair not in self.order:
            self.order.append(pair)
            self.fill()
        self.partner.setText("")

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Render preview values and counts; enable Apply only for actual staged edits."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif self.glyph is None:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select a glyph in the Font window, then run this script again."
            )
        else:
            (left, right) = class_sides(self.package, self.masters[0], self.glyph)
            classes = ", ".join(c for c in (left, right) if c) or "no kerning class"
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Pairs with {self.glyph} ({classes}) on either side. Empty cell = no pair; clear a cell to delete that pair."
            )
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        plain = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.filling = True
        for row, pair in enumerate(self.order):
            for column, master in enumerate(self.masters, 1):
                item = self.table.item(row, column)
                if item is None:
                    continue
                staged = (pair, master) in self.staged
                bold = item.font()
                bold.setBold(staged)
                item.setFont(bold)
                item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(accent if staged else plain))
        self.filling = False
        count = len(self.staged)
        self.status.setText(
            f"{count} edited cell{('s' if count != 1 else '')}"
            if count
            else f"{len(self.order)} pairs"
        )
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(count))
        self.revert_button.setEnabled(bool(count or self.errors))
        if self.errors:
            self.status.setText(
                f"{count} valid edited cells; {len(self.errors)} invalid cells ignored. Correct them or Revert."
            )

    @editor_apply
    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Write the complete displayed batch, refresh its baseline and report counts."""
        edits = {}
        for (pair, master), value in self.staged.items():
            edits.setdefault(master, {})[pair] = value
        self.write_edits(edits, TITLE)
        self.last_result = {m: len(p) for (m, p) in edits.items()}
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.refresh_after_apply(self.load)
        self.status.setText(
            f"Wrote {sum(self.last_result.values())} cells in {len(edits)} masters"
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace only this tool's registry entry and show the owned modeless dialog."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(PairEditor, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Browse every kerning pair of a master: filter, sort by any column, export to CSV.

Type in the filter to keep pairs whose left or right side contains the text (glyph or @class name); "=" anchors a whole side, so "=T" shows pairs with exactly T on one side. Click a header to sort; values sort numerically. Export writes the pairs shown to a CSV file. Read-only.

Run Kerning > Pair List Browser from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Pair List Browser.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Pair List
"""Browse every kerning pair of a master: filter, sort by any column, export to CSV.

Type in the filter to keep pairs whose left or right side contains the text (glyph or @class
name); "=" anchors a whole side, so "=T" shows pairs with exactly T on one side. Click a header
to sort; values sort numerically. Export writes the pairs shown to a CSV file. Read-only.
"""

import csv
import pathlib
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
# The tiny facade stays lazy until a native menu script asks for its panel.
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_dialog_type,
    kerning_pairs,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    kerning_snapshot_refresh as snapshot_refresh,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,
)

KerningDialog = kerning_dialog_type()

TITLE = "Kerning Pairs"
KEY = "kerning_list_browser"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def matches(pair: tuple[str, str], text: str) -> bool:
    """Filter rule: substring of either side; '=name' must equal a whole side."""
    text = text.strip()
    if not text:
        return True
    if text.startswith("="):
        return text[1:] in pair
    return any(text in side for side in pair)


def filtered(
    pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], float], text: str
) -> list[tuple[str, str, float]]:
    """Return matching explicit pairs in stable name order."""
    return sorted((l, r, v) for (l, r), v in pairs.items() if matches((l, r), text))


def export_csv(
    rows: list[tuple[str, str, float]], master: str, path: str | pathlib.Path
) -> int:
    """Write left,right,value,master rows; returns the number of pairs written."""
    with pathlib.Path(path).open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        writer = csv.writer(handle)
        writer.writerow(["left", "right", "value", "master"])
        for left, right, value in rows:
            writer.writerow([left, right, f"{value:g}", master])
    return len(rows)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI


class PairList(KerningDialog):
    """Retain the original Pair List Browser controls on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Initialize owned controls without changing the font."""
        KerningDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)

        self.pairs, self.rows = {}, []
        root = self.root

        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.master = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for name in self.masters:
            self.master.addItem(name)
        if self.current_master in self.masters:
            self.master.setCurrentIndex(self.masters.index(self.current_master))
        self.filter = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.filter.setPlaceholderText("Filter: T, @L_A, =V …")
        self.filter.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Master"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.master, 0, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Filter"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.filter, 1, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)

        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 3)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Left", "Right", "Value"])
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(260)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.export_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Export CSV…")
        self.export_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.export_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.master.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.load())
        self._connect(self.filter.textChanged, lambda *a: self.fill())
        self._connect(self.export_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.ask_path())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.load()

    def chosen_master(self) -> str:
        """Return the master named by the original combo box."""
        return self.masters[self.master.currentIndex] if self.masters else ""

    @snapshot_refresh
    def load(self) -> None:
        """Read explicit pairs on the chosen master and refresh the table."""
        self.pairs = (
            kerning_pairs(self.package, self.chosen_master()) if self.package else {}
        )
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            classes = sum(
                1 for l, r in self.pairs if l.startswith("@") or r.startswith("@")
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{self.chosen_master()}: {len(self.pairs)} pairs, {classes} of them with a class side",
            )
        self.fill()

    @snapshot_refresh
    def fill(self) -> None:
        """Render the complete filtered rows from the current snapshot."""
        self.rows = filtered(self.pairs, self.filter.text)
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.rows))
        for row, (left, right, value) in enumerate(self.rows):
            for column, text in enumerate((left, right)):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if text.startswith("@"):
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(accent))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem()
            item.setData(
                QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole,
                int(value) if value == int(value) else value,
            )
            item.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter))
            self.table.setItem(row, 2, item)
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        shown = (
            f"{len(self.rows)} of {len(self.pairs)} pairs"
            if self.filter.text.strip()
            else f"{len(self.rows)} pairs"
        )
        self.status.setText(shown)
        self.export_button.setEnabled(bool(self.rows))

    def shown_rows(self) -> Any:
        """Rows in the table's current (possibly sorted) order."""
        return [
            (
                self.table.item(row, 0).text(),
                self.table.item(row, 1).text(),
                float(self.table.item(row, 2).data(QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole)),
            )
            for row in range(self.table.rowCount)
        ]

    def ask_path(self) -> None:
        """Non-modal save dialog (open(), never a blocking modal loop): FontLab keeps running."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        if self.file_dialog is None:
            dialog = QtGui.QFileDialog(self, "Export kerning pairs")
            dialog.setAcceptMode(QtGui.QFileDialog.AcceptSave)
            dialog.setNameFilter("CSV files (*.csv)")
            dialog.setDefaultSuffix("csv")
            dialog.setOption(QtGui.QFileDialog.DontUseNativeDialog, True)
            self._connect(dialog.fileSelected, self.export)
            self.file_dialog = dialog
        self.file_dialog.selectFile(f"kerning-{self.chosen_master()}.csv")
        self.file_dialog.open()

    def export(self, path: str) -> int:
        """Export actual shown table order after checking the complete snapshot."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        count = export_csv(self.shown_rows(), self.chosen_master(), path)
        self.last_export = {"path": path, "pairs": count}
        self.status.setText(f"Exported {count} pairs to {pathlib.Path(path).name}")
        return count


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry window and show this owned modeless panel."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(PairList, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.title: Pairs From Text
docs.text:
Type a word, see each adjacent pair's kerning on every master, and set the ones you tick.

Pairs are taken inside words (spaces separate words; /glyphname tokens work too). The table shows what FontLab applies now on each master, marking values that come from a class pair. Set or Add writes explicit glyph pairs for the ticked rows on the chosen masters; one Apply is one Undo step.

Run Kerning > Pairs From Text from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

# this_file: Scripts/Kerning/Pairs From Text.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Kerning · Pairs From Text
"""Type a word, see each adjacent pair's kerning on every master, and set the ones you tick.

Pairs are taken inside words (spaces separate words; /glyphname tokens work too). The table
shows what FontLab applies now on each master, marking values that come from a class pair.
Set or Add writes explicit glyph pairs for the ticked rows on the chosen masters; one Apply is
one Undo step.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_edit_dialog_type, kerning_selection_api
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_editor_apply as editor_apply
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_editor_make_table as make_table
from fly.ap.scripting import kerning_editor_refresh as editor_refresh
from fly.ap.scripting import names_muted as muted

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
api = kerning_selection_api()
KerningEditDialog = kerning_edit_dialog_type()
current_package = ap.scripting.current_package
kerning_pairs = ap.scripting.kerning_pairs

TITLE = "Kerning Pairs from Text"
KEY = "kerning_pairs_from_text"
MODES = [("Set to", "set"), ("Add to current", "add")]


explicit_pairs = api.explicit_pairs
parse_words = api.parse_words
adjacent_pairs = api.adjacent_pairs
current_value = api.current_value


def write_kerning(
    package: Any, edits: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], int | None]]
) -> None:
    """Retain the original console interface through the shared preflight writer."""
    ap.scripting.kerning_editor_api().write_kerning(package, edits, TITLE)


class PairsFromText(KerningEditDialog):
    """Preserve all original controls on the shared snapshot-bound native panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Create original controls; connect every callback through owned guards."""
        KerningEditDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(600)
        self.resize(640, 560)
        self.pairs = []
        self.values = {}
        self.filling = False
        root = self.root

        self.text = QtGui.QLineEdit("AVATAR Type")
        self.text.setPlaceholderText("Words to kern, e.g. AVATAR Type /Aacute/V")
        root.addWidget(self.text)

        self.table = make_table(["Pair", *self.masters])
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.mode = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for label, _ in MODES:
            self.mode.addItem(label)
        self.value = QtGui.QSpinBox()
        self.value.setRange(-2000, 2000)
        self.value.setAlignment(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight)
        self.value.setSuffix(" units")
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Current master ({self.current_master})")
        self.scope.addItem(f"All masters ({len(self.masters)})")
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Ticked pairs"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.mode, 0, 1)
        form.addWidget(self.value, 0, 2)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Masters"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.scope, 1, 1, 1, 2)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        form.setColumnStretch(2, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.apply_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Apply")
        self.apply_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.apply_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self.add_refresh(footer, self.refresh)
        self._connect(self.text.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.table.itemChanged, lambda *a: self.count())
        self._connect(self.mode.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.count())
        self._connect(self.value.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.count())
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.count())
        self._connect(self.apply_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.apply())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()

    def chosen_masters(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return current or all originally captured masters, retaining scope semantics."""
        return [self.current_master] if self.scope.currentIndex == 0 else self.masters

    @editor_refresh
    def refresh(self, keep_ticks: list[tuple[str, str]] | None = None) -> None:
        """Publish the complete effective/explicit preview and original default ticks."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        self.pairs = adjacent_pairs(parse_words(self.text.text, self.package))
        self.values = api.text_values(self.package, self.masters, self.pairs)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(self.pairs)} pairs from the text. Values are what each master applies now; "
            "“class” marks values inherited from a class pair.",
        )
        dim = QtGui.QColor(muted(self))
        self.filling = True
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.pairs))
        for row, pair in enumerate(self.pairs):
            name = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(f"{pair[0]}  {pair[1]}")
            ticked = keep_ticks is None or pair in keep_ticks
            name.setCheckState(QtCore.Qt.Checked if ticked else QtCore.Qt.Unchecked)
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, name)
            for column, master in enumerate(self.masters, 1):
                value, own = self.values[pair, master]
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(
                    f"{value:g}" if own else (f"{value:g}  class" if value else "–"),
                )
                item.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                )
                if not own:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(dim))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.filling = False
        self.count()

    def ticked(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """Read actual table check states; never substitute stored tick intentions."""
        return [
            self.pairs[r]
            for r in range(self.table.rowCount)
            if self.table.item(r, 0).checkState() == QtCore.Qt.Checked
        ]

    def tick(self, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
        """Tick exactly these pairs (used by tests and handy from the console)."""
        self.filling = True
        for row, pair in enumerate(self.pairs):
            self.table.item(row, 0).setCheckState(
                QtCore.Qt.Checked if pair in pairs else QtCore.Qt.Unchecked,
            )
        self.filling = False
        self.count()

    def plan(self) -> dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], int]]:
        """Stage only ticked pairs using the displayed effective baseline for Add."""
        return api.text_plan(
            self.chosen_masters(),
            self.ticked(),
            self.values,
            MODES[self.mode.currentIndex][1],
            self.value.value,
        )

    def count(self) -> None:
        """Update original tick counts and enable Apply only for selected rows."""
        if self.filling:
            return
        edits = self.plan()
        cells = sum(len(p) for p in edits.values())
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.ticked())} of {len(self.pairs)} pairs ticked · {cells} values to write",
        )
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(cells))

    @editor_apply
    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Preflight the complete ticked batch, write once, then refresh its baseline."""
        edits = self.plan()
        self.write_edits(edits, TITLE)
        self.last_result = {m: len(p) for m, p in edits.items()}
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        keep_ticks = self.ticked()
        self.refresh_after_apply(lambda: self.refresh(keep_ticks=keep_ticks))
        self.status.setText(f"Wrote {sum(self.last_result.values())} pair values")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace only this tool's registry entry and show its owned modeless dialog."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(PairsFromText, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def parse_text(text: str, package: Any) -> list[str]:
    """Glyph names for the text: characters by Unicode, '/name' tokens by name (ended by space or '/')."""
    names, i = [], 0
    while i < len(text):
        char = text[i]
        if char == "/":
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(text) and text[j] not in " /":
                j += 1
            token = text[i + 1 : j]
            if token and package.findName(token) is not None:
                names.append(token)
            i = j + (1 if j < len(text) and text[j] == " " else 0)
            continue
        glyph = package.findUnicode(ord(char))
        if glyph is not None:
            names.append(glyph.name)
        i += 1
    return names


def outline(layer: Any) -> Any:
    """The layer's outline as one QPainterPath, components placed by their transforms."""
    path = QtGui.QPainterPath()
    path.setFillRule(QtCore.Qt.WindingFill)
    for shape in layer.shapes:
        part = QtGui.QPainterPath()
        for contour in shape.getContours():
            part.addPath(contour.path())
        path.addPath(shape.transform.map(part))
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI


class Canvas(QtGui.QWidget):
    """Paints the laid-out glyphs at the chosen size, wrapping lines to the widget width."""

    def __init__(self, owner: Any) -> None:
        """Initialize owned controls without changing the font."""
        QtGui.QWidget.__init__(self)
        self.paint_error = None
        self.owner = owner
        self.setMinimumSize(560, 260)

    def paintEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Contain every painter failure and always release the painter."""
        painter = None
        try:
            painter = QtGui.QPainter(self)
            self.draw(painter)
            self.paint_error = None
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - native paint boundary
            self.fail(error)
        finally:
            if painter is not None:
                try:
                    painter.end()
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - native cleanup boundary
                    self.fail(error)

    def fail(self, error: Exception) -> None:
        """Contain failures even when invalidating the owner or its status fails."""
        self.paint_error = repr(error)
        try:
            self.owner.invalidate()
            self.owner.status.setText("Proof error: " + self.paint_error)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - error hooks cannot escape PythonQt
            self.error_hook_failed = True

    def draw(self, painter: Any) -> None:
        """Draw every fitted font outline and optional effective-kerning label."""
        owner = self.owner
        palette = self.palette
        painter.fillRect(self.rect, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Base))
        if owner.rows:
            owner.ensure_snapshot()
        rows = owner.rows
        if not rows:
            painter.setPen(QtGui.QColor(muted(self)))
            painter.drawText(
                self.rect,
                int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter),
                owner.empty_message(),
            )
            return
        painter.setRenderHint(QtGui.QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
        scale = owner.size_slider.value / owner.upm
        values = owner.show_values.isChecked()
        ink = QtGui.QColor(palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        accent = QtGui.QColor(palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        small = painter.font()
        small.setPointSizeF(max(small.pointSizeF() * 0.8, 8))
        painter.setFont(small)
        bounds = {}
        for name, *_ in rows:
            box = owner.path(name).boundingRect()
            bounds[name] = (box.left(), box.top(), box.right(), box.bottom())
        scale, positions = ap.scripting.kerning_proof_geometry(
            rows,
            bounds,
            self.width - 2 * MARGIN,
            self.height - 2 * MARGIN,
            scale,
            owner.ascender,
            owner.descender,
            values,
        )
        label_scale = scale / (owner.size_slider.value / owner.upm)
        small.setPointSizeF(max(0.1, small.pointSizeF() * label_scale))
        painter.setFont(small)
        for name, left, baseline, kern in positions:
            left, baseline = left + MARGIN, baseline + MARGIN
            if kern and values:
                painter.setPen(accent)
                painter.drawText(
                    QtCore.QRectF(
                        left - 20 * label_scale,
                        baseline - owner.descender * scale + 2 * label_scale,
                        40 * label_scale,
                        16 * label_scale,
                    ),
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter),
                    f"{kern:g}",
                )
            painter.save()
            painter.translate(left, baseline)
            painter.scale(scale, -scale)
            painter.setPen(QtCore.Qt.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QtGui.QBrush(ink))
            painter.drawPath(owner.path(name))
            painter.restore()


class TextPreview(KerningDialog):
    """Retain the original Text Preview controls on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Initialize owned controls without changing the font."""
        KerningDialog.__init__(self, parent, TITLE, KEY)

        self.upm = self.package.upm if self.package else 1000
        self.ascender = self.package.ascender_value if self.package else 800
        self.descender = self.package.descender_value if self.package else -200
        self.rows, self.paths = [], {}
        root = self.root

        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.text = QtGui.QLineEdit(DEFAULT_TEXT)
        self.text.setPlaceholderText("Text, or /glyphname tokens")
        self.master = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for name in self.masters:
            self.master.addItem(name)
        if self.current_master in self.masters:
            self.master.setCurrentIndex(self.masters.index(self.current_master))
        self.size_slider = QtGui.QSlider(QtCore.Qt.Horizontal)
        self.size_slider.setRange(16, 240)
        self.size_slider.setValue(72)
        self.size_label = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.kerned = QtGui.QCheckBox("Kerning")
        self.kerned.setChecked(True)
        self.show_values = QtGui.QCheckBox("Show values")
        self.show_values.setChecked(True)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Text"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.text, 0, 1, 1, 4)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Master"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.master, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(self.kerned, 1, 2)
        form.addWidget(self.show_values, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Size"), 2, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.size_slider, 2, 1, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(self.size_label, 2, 4)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)

        self.canvas = Canvas(self)
        root.addWidget(self.canvas, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.close_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.text.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.master.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.kerned.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.show_values.toggled, lambda *a: self.canvas.update())
        self._connect(self.size_slider.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.resized())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.resized()
        self.refresh()

    def chosen_master(self) -> str:
        """Return the master named by the original combo box."""
        return self.masters[self.master.currentIndex] if self.masters else ""

    def path(self, name: str) -> Any:
        """Cache the actual transformed outline on the requested master."""
        key = (name, self.chosen_master())
        if key not in self.paths:
            self.paths[key] = outline(self.package.findName(name).findLayer(key[1]))
        return self.paths[key]

    def empty_message(self) -> str:
        """Prompt for a font or text when the outline proof has no glyph rows."""
        return "Open a font first." if self.package is None else "Type some text above."

    def resized(self) -> None:
        """Update the size label and request a proof repaint."""
        self.size_label.setText(f"{self.size_slider.value} px")
        self.canvas.update()

    @snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render a complete native snapshot for the chosen controls."""
        self.paths = {}
        if self.package is None:
            self.rows = []
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            names = parse_text(self.text.text, self.package)
            self.rows = layout(
                self.package,
                names,
                self.chosen_master(),
                self.kerned.isChecked(),
            )
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{self.chosen_master()} master · glyph outlines with "
                f"{'kerning applied' if self.kerned.isChecked() else 'kerning off'}",
            )
        for name, *_ in self.rows:
            self.path(name)  # Materialize every outline before publishing the snapshot.
        kerned = [r for r in self.rows if r[3]]
        total = sum(r[3] for r in kerned)
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.rows)} glyphs · {len(kerned)} kerned gaps, {total:g} units in total",
        )
        self.canvas.update()


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry window and show this owned modeless panel."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(TextPreview, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Masters/Compatibility Check.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Masters · Compatibility Check
"""Check that every master of each glyph can interpolate: same contours, nodes, anchors, components.

The tree lists each glyph with ✓ or ✗; expand it to see the counts per master, with the values
that differ from the other masters highlighted. Contour structure is compared node by node
(on-curve / handle pattern), anchors by name and components by base glyph. Select the failing
glyphs in the Font window with one click. Read-only.
"""

from typing import Any, ClassVar

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    masters_api,
    masters_dialog_type,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_make_table as make_table,  # noqa: F401 - original helper interface
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = masters_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_names = _api.selected_names
master_layers = _api.master_layers
own_contours = _api.own_contours
node_points = _api.node_points
signature = _api.signature
summary = _api.summary
check_glyph = _api.check_glyph
all_names = _api.all_names
TITLE = "Master Compatibility"
KEY = "masters_compatibility_check"


class SampleDialog(masters_dialog_type()):
    """Keep the original per-menu shell interface on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every control before initial binding or native reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


def select_in_font_window(names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Preserve the public original selector, guarded by the active dialog snapshot."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open the compatibility panel before selecting results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


class Compatibility(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original read-only Masters tool with guarded native actions."""

    ACTION = "Select ✗ Glyphs"
    COLUMNS: ClassVar[list[str]] = [
        "Glyph · master",
        "Contours",
        "Nodes",
        "Anchors",
        "Components",
        "Status",
    ]

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original chart/table/tree control and guarded action connection."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(600)
        grid = self.form()
        self.source = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.source.addItem(f"Selected glyphs ({len(self.names)})")
        self.source.addItem("Whole font")
        self._connect(self.source.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyphs"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.source, 0, 1)
        grid.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        self.tree = QtGui.QTreeWidget()
        self.tree.setColumnCount(len(self.COLUMNS))
        self.tree.setHeaderLabels(self.COLUMNS)
        self.tree.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.tree.setRootIsDecorated(True)
        self.tree.setUniformRowHeights(True)
        header = self.tree.header()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(5, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        self.tree.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.tree.setMinimumHeight(300)
        self.root.addWidget(self.tree, 1)

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render complete results from the original bound font and selection."""
        (self.results, self.failing) = ({}, [])
        self._structures = {}
        self.tree.clear()
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            self.apply_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self._scope_whole = self.source.currentIndex == 1
        names = all_names() if self._scope_whole else self.names
        self._scope_names = tuple(names)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(names)} glyphs across {len(self.masters)} masters: {', '.join(self.masters)}"
        )
        accent = QtGui.QColor(
            self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Active, QtGui.QPalette.Link)
        )
        bad = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
        ink = QtGui.QBrush(
            self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Active, QtGui.QPalette.WindowText)
        )
        muted_color = QtGui.QColor(
            self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Active, QtGui.QPalette.WindowText)
        )
        muted_color.setAlpha(130)
        right = int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
        for name in names:
            glyph = self.package.findName(name)
            if glyph is None:
                continue
            (sigs, ok, problems) = check_glyph(glyph, self.masters)
            self._structures[name] = sigs
            self.results[name] = ok
            if not ok:
                self.failing.append(name)
            top = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem(self.tree)
            top.setText(0, name)
            top.setForeground(0, ink)
            top.setText(5, "✓" if ok else "✗ " + ", ".join(problems))
            top.setTextAlignment(5, right)
            top.setForeground(5, QtGui.QBrush(muted_color if ok else bad))
            values = {m: summary(s) for (m, s) in sigs.items() if s is not None}
            for master, sig in sigs.items():
                child = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem(top)
                child.setText(0, master)
                for column in range(5):
                    child.setForeground(column, ink)
                if sig is None:
                    child.setText(1, "auto layer · not compared")
                    child.setForeground(1, QtGui.QBrush(muted_color))
                    continue
                for column, value in enumerate(summary(sig), start=1):
                    child.setText(column, str(value))
                    child.setTextAlignment(column, right)
                    others = [v[column - 1] for (m, v) in values.items() if m != master]
                    if others and value != max(set(others), key=others.count):
                        font = child.font(column)
                        font.setBold(True)
                        child.setFont(column, font)
                        child.setForeground(column, QtGui.QBrush(accent))
            top.setExpanded(not ok)
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(self.failing))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.failing)} of {len(self.results)} glyphs incompatible"
        )

    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Refuse changed displayed source before the original explicit UI action."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        self.select_names(self.failing)
        self.last_result = {"selected": list(self.failing)}
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(self.failing)} incompatible glyphs in the Font window"
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show this owned original Masters tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(Compatibility, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

subtracted by nesting. Overlapping contours are counted twice, so remove overlaps first for exact

class SampleDialog(masters_dialog_type()):

class WeightChart(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original read-only Masters tool with guarded native actions."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original chart/table/tree control and guarded action connection."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)

        self.chart.report = self.paint_report
        self.root.addWidget(self.chart, 1)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render complete results from the original bound font and selection."""
        if not hasattr(self, "chart"):
            return
        self.areas = {}
        if not self.describe_selection():
            self.chart.groups = []
            self.chart.update()
            return
        order = master_order(self.package)
        for glyph in self.glyphs()[:MAX_GLYPHS]:
            found = master_layers(glyph, order)

                ink_area(layer_contours(found[m])) if m in found else 0.0 for m in order

        self.chart.masters = order
        self.chart.groups = list(self.areas.items())
        self.chart.update()
        self.table.setColumnCount(len(order) + 1)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Glyph"] + [f"{m} (units²)" for m in order]
        )
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents
        )
        fill_table(
            self.table,
            [
                (name, *tuple(f"{v:,.0f}" for v in row))
                for (name, row) in self.areas.items()
            ],
        )
        self.status.setText("Ink area per master · overlapping contours count twice")

        self._connect(self.slider.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyph"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.glyph_combo, 0, 1, 1, 3)
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Between"), 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.first, 1, 1)
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("and"), 1, 2)
        grid.addWidget(self.second, 1, 3)
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Position"), 2, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.slider, 2, 1, 1, 2)
        grid.addWidget(self.percent, 2, 3)
        grid.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        grid.setColumnStretch(3, 1)
        self.view = BlendView()
        self.view.report = self.paint_report
        self.root.addWidget(self.view, 1)

    @review_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Blend complete corresponding nodes after validating the old cached source."""
        if not hasattr(self, "view"):
            return
        self.mix = []
        if not self.describe_selection():
            self.view.a = self.view.b = self.view.mix = []
            self.view.update()
            return
        glyph = self.package.findName(self.glyph_combo.currentText)
        layers = master_layers(glyph, self.masters)
        first, second = (
            layers.get(self.first.currentText),
            layers.get(self.second.currentText),
        )
        t = self.slider.value / 100.0
        self.percent.setText(f"{self.slider.value} %")
        a = outline(first) if first is not None else []
        b = outline(second) if second is not None else []
        why = problem(a, b)
        self.view.a, self.view.b = (a, b)
        if why is None:
            self.mix = blend(a, b, t)
            self.view.message = ""
            self.status.setText(
                f"{glyph.name}: {self.slider.value} % from {self.first.currentText} to {self.second.currentText} · {sum(len(c) for c in a)} nodes"
            )
        else:
            self.view.message = f"Not compatible: {why}"
            self.status.setText(
                f"{glyph.name} cannot interpolate between these masters: {why}"
            )
        self.view.mix = self.mix
        self.view.update()


def main() -> Any:
    """Show the original non-modal interpolation controls and complete painter."""
    return show_script_dialog(Interpolation, KEY)

    main()

    _api.location_label,

TITLE, KEY = "Master Switcher", "masters_switcher_palette"
BUTTON_COLUMNS = 3

    """Keep the original shell interface on the existing guarded Masters dialog."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class Switcher(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original master buttons, populated only after native binding."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Create the owned row/group before the first native source read."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(360)
        self.buttons = {}
        self.button_grid = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        self.button_grid.setHorizontalSpacing(8)
        self.button_grid.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.group = QtGui.QButtonGroup(self)
        self.group.setExclusive(True)
        self.root.addLayout(self.button_grid)

    def populate_buttons(self, values: tuple) -> None:
        """Retain original labels, sizes, shortcuts and exclusive checkable state."""
        for index, (master, where) in enumerate(values):
            if master in self.buttons:
                continue
            button = QtGui.QToolButton(self)
            button.setText(master + (f"\n{where}" if where else ""))
            button.setCheckable(True)
            button.setToolButtonStyle(QtCore.Qt.ToolButtonTextOnly)
            button.setMinimumSize(96, 52)
            button.setSizePolicy(QtGui.QSizePolicy.Expanding, QtGui.QSizePolicy.Fixed)
            if index < 9:
                button.setToolTip(
                    f"{master} (⌘{index + 1} while this palette is focused)"
                )
                button.setShortcut(QtGui.QKeySequence(f"Ctrl+{index + 1}"))
            self.group.addButton(button)
            self.buttons[master] = button
            self.button_grid.addWidget(
                button, index // BUTTON_COLUMNS, index % BUTTON_COLUMNS
            )
            self._connect(button.clicked, lambda *a, m=master: self.choose(m))

    def choose(self, master: str) -> None:
        """Check the bound source before making an explicit master current."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        switch(self.package, master)
        self.refresh()

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Publish original current-master emphasis from the bound font."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        current = self.package.master
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(self.masters)} masters · click to make one current"
        )
        for master, button in self.buttons.items():
            button.setChecked(master == current)
            font = button.font
            font.setBold(master == current)
            button.setFont(font)
        self.status.setText(f"Current master: {current}")

"""One table of all masters: axis location, vertical metrics and italic angle.

Rows follow the font's master order; the current master is bold. Vertical metrics come from
``fontlab.FontMetrics(package, master)``; FontLab has no per-master italic-angle accessor, so each
master is made current for the read and the original master is restored. Double-click a row to
make that master current. Read-only otherwise.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    masters_api,
    masters_dialog_type,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_fill_table as fill_table,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_make_table as make_table,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = masters_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_names = _api.selected_names
location_text = _api.location_text
italic_angles = _api.italic_angles
overview = _api.overview
TITLE = "Masters Overview"
KEY = "masters_overview"
METRICS = [
    ("Ascender", "ascender"),
    ("Cap height", "capsHeight"),
    ("x-height", "xHeight"),
    ("Descender", "descender"),
]


class SampleDialog(masters_dialog_type()):
    """Keep the original per-menu shell interface on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every control before initial binding or native reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class Overview(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original read-only Masters tool with guarded native actions."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original chart/table/tree control and guarded action connection."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(680)
        headers = (
            ["Master", "Location"]
            + [label for (label, _) in METRICS]
            + ["Italic angle"]
        )
        self.table = make_table(headers, 200)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            1, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents
        )
        self.root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked, lambda row, column, *a: self.make_current(row)
        )
        hint = QtGui.QLabel(
            "Double-click a master to make it current. Values that differ between masters are highlighted."
        )
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        self.root.addWidget(hint)

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render complete results from the original bound font and selection."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            self.rows = []
            return
        self.rows = overview(self.package)
        axes = ", ".join(f"{a.name} ({a.tag})" for a in self.package.axes) or "no axes"
        self.subtitle.setText(f"{len(self.rows)} masters · {axes}")
        varies = {c for c in range(2, 7) if len({row[c] for row in self.rows}) > 1}
        cells = [
            (r[0], r[1], *tuple(f"{v:g}" for v in r[2:6]), f"{r[6]:g}°")
            for r in self.rows
        ]
        fill_table(self.table, cells, lambda r, c, text: c in varies)
        current = self.package.master
        for row, cells_row in enumerate(cells):
            if cells_row[0] == current:
                item = self.table.item(row, 0)
                font = item.font()
                font.setBold(True)
                item.setFont(font)
                item.setText(cells_row[0] + "  (current)")
        self.status.setText(f"Current master: {current}")

    def make_current(self, row: Any) -> None:
        """Refuse changed displayed source before the original explicit UI action."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        master = self.rows[row][0]
        self.package.setMaster(master, True)
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.refresh()


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show this owned original Masters tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(Overview, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Render a spacing control string such as HOHnono from the font's own outlines and advances.

Type characters or /glyphname tokens, pick a master, and judge the rhythm of straight and round
sidebearings without generating a font. Advance boxes and LSB/RSB numbers can be shown under
each glyph. Nothing is edited; the preview follows the outlines as they are now."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package as current_package,  # noqa: PLC0414 - original public helper
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    inspectors_api,
    inspectors_dialog_type,
    inspectors_snapshot_refresh,
    inspectors_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = inspectors_api()
muted = _api.muted
parse_text = _api.parse_text
outline = _api.outline
layout = _api.layout
Canvas = inspectors_view_types().Canvas
TITLE = "Spacing String Preview"
KEY = "metrics_spacing_string_preview"
DEFAULT_TEXT = "HHOHOOH nnonoon"
MARGIN = 24


class SampleDialog(inspectors_dialog_type()):
    """Original menu shell on the existing owned Proof/Names/Masters lifecycle."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Finish controls/status/Close before fallible font reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class SpacingPreview(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original inspector with complete snapshots and owned cleanup."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Retain every original control/default before reading native data."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(640)
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.text = QtGui.QLineEdit(DEFAULT_TEXT)
        self.text.setPlaceholderText("Characters, or /glyphname tokens")
        self.master = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for name in self.masters:
            self.master.addItem(name)
        if self.current_master in self.masters:
            self.master.setCurrentIndex(self.masters.index(self.current_master))
        self.show_boxes = QtGui.QCheckBox("Advance boxes")
        self.show_boxes.setChecked(True)
        self.show_numbers = QtGui.QCheckBox("LSB / RSB numbers")
        self.show_numbers.setChecked(True)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Text"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.text, 0, 1, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Master"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.master, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(self.show_boxes, 1, 2)
        form.addWidget(self.show_numbers, 1, 3)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        self.root.addLayout(form)

        self.canvas = Canvas(self)
        self.root.addWidget(self.canvas, 1)

        self._connect(self.text.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.master.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.show_boxes.toggled, lambda *a: self.canvas.update())
        self._connect(self.show_numbers.toggled, lambda *a: self.canvas.update())

    def chosen_master(self) -> Any:
        """Return the original selector master without changing the font master."""
        return self.masters[self.master.currentIndex] if self.masters else ""

    def path(self, name: Any) -> Any:
        """Return only a path captured by the completed refresh."""
        return self.paths[(name, self.chosen_master())]

    def empty_message(self) -> str:
        """Keep the original no-font and empty-text canvas messages."""
        if self.package is None:
            return "Open a font first."
        return "Type characters or /glyphname tokens above."

    @inspectors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete original report under the shared font/master snapshot guard."""
        self.sync_controls()
        self.ascender = self.package.ascender_value if self.package else 800
        self.descender = self.package.descender_value if self.package else -200
        self.paths, self._outline_sources = {}, {}
        if self.package is None:
            self.rows = []
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            names = parse_text(self.text.text, self.package)
            self.rows = layout(self.package, names, self.chosen_master())
            self.paths = {
                (name, self.chosen_master()): outline(
                    self.package.findName(name).findLayer(self.chosen_master())
                )
                for name, *_ in self.rows
            }
            self._outline_sources = {
                (name, self.chosen_master()): _api.outline_source(
                    self.package.findName(name).findLayer(self.chosen_master())
                )
                for name, *_ in self.rows
            }
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{self.chosen_master()} master · {len(names)} glyphs drawn from their outlines and advances, no kerning",
            )
        width = self.rows[-1][1] + self.rows[-1][2] if self.rows else 0
        self.status.setText(f"{len(self.rows)} glyphs · line width {width:g} units")
        self.canvas.update()


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned inspector."""
    return show_script_dialog(SpacingPreview, KEY)

    main()

# FLM: Metrics · Width Table
"""Advance widths of the selected glyphs across all masters, sortable, with odd progressions flagged.

In a weight family the widths usually grow (or shrink) steadily from master to master. A glyph
whose width goes up and then down again is flagged: often a spacing slip. Click a column header
to sort; "Select flagged" selects those glyphs in the Font window. Nothing is edited."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package as current_package,  # noqa: PLC0414 - original public helper
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    inspectors_api,
    inspectors_dialog_type,
    inspectors_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = inspectors_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_glyphs = _api.selected_glyphs
widths = _api.widths
progression = _api.progression
report = _api.report
TITLE = "Width Table"
KEY = "metrics_width_table"


class SampleDialog(inspectors_dialog_type()):
    """Original menu shell on the existing owned Proof/Names/Masters lifecycle."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Finish controls/status/Close before fallible font reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


def select_in_font(names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Select through the active panel's complete source and identity preflight."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open this panel before selecting its results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


class WidthTable(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original inspector with complete snapshots and owned cleanup."""

    ACTION = "Select flagged"

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Retain every original control/default before reading native data."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        options = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.only_flagged = QtGui.QCheckBox("Show only mixed progressions")
        options.addWidget(self.only_flagged)
        options.addStretch(1)
        self.root.addLayout(options)

        headers = ["Glyph", *self.masters, "Progression"]
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(headers))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(headers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(240)
        self.root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        self._connect(self.only_flagged.toggled, lambda *a: self.fill())

    def flagged(self) -> Any:
        """Return mixed progressions in captured glyph order."""
        return [name for name, _, trend in self.rows if trend == "mixed"]

    @inspectors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete original report under the shared font/master snapshot guard."""
        self.glyphs = (
            [self.package.findName(name) for name in self.names] if self.package else []
        )
        if any(g is None or g.isNull for g in self.glyphs):
            raise ValueError("Selected glyph source changed; reopen this tool.")
        self.table.setColumnCount(len(self.masters) + 2)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Glyph", *self.masters, "Progression"])
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again.",
            )
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{count} glyph{'s' if count != 1 else ''} × {len(self.masters)} masters, "
                f"masters in font order: {' → '.join(self.masters)}",
            )
        self.rows = report(self.glyphs, self.masters)
        self.fill()

    def fill(self) -> None:
        """Render all original numeric cells, warning labels and exact mixed filter."""
        if self._snapshot_valid:
            self.ensure_snapshot()
        warn = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
        shown = [
            r for r in self.rows if not self.only_flagged.isChecked() or r[2] == "mixed"
        ]
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        self.table.setRowCount(len(shown))
        for row, (name, values, trend) in enumerate(shown):
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(name))
            for column, value in enumerate(values, 1):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("–")
                if value is not None:
                    item.setData(
                        QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole,
                        value,
                    )  # an int sorts numerically
                item.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                )
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            flag = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("⚠ mixed" if trend == "mixed" else trend)
            flag.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter))
            if trend == "mixed":
                bold = flag.font()
                bold.setBold(True)
                flag.setFont(bold)
                flag.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(warn))
            self.table.setItem(row, len(values) + 1, flag)
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        flagged = self.flagged()
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(flagged)} of {len(self.rows)} glyphs with a mixed progression",
        )
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(flagged))

    def table_values(self) -> Any:
        """{glyph: [widths]} as shown (used by tests and handy for copying)."""
        out = {}
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount):
            name = self.table.item(row, 0).text()
            out[name] = [
                self.table.item(row, c).data(QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole)
                for c in range(1, len(self.masters) + 1)
            ]
        return out

    def select_flagged(self) -> None:
        """Preflight displayed widths before selecting exactly the mixed glyphs."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        flagged = self.flagged()
        self.select_names(flagged)
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(flagged)} glyph{'s' if len(flagged) != 1 else ''} in the Font window",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned inspector."""
    return show_script_dialog(WidthTable, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Names/Case Pairs.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Case Pairs
"""Find the upper- or lowercase counterparts of the selected glyphs and select them.

Counterparts come from Unicode case mapping of each glyph's code point;
unencoded alternates use their base name (a.ss01 -> A.ss01). Select the
counterparts alone or together with the originals. Nothing in the font
changes.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_font_glyphs,
    names_muted,
    names_selected_names,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Case Pairs"
KEY = "names_case_pairs"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def selected_names() -> list[str]:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return names_selected_names()


def font_glyphs() -> list[tuple[str, list[int]]]:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return names_font_glyphs()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def swap_case(char: str) -> str:
    """The single-character case counterpart, or "" (ß -> SS has no single counterpart)."""
    other = char.lower() if char != char.lower() else char.upper()
    return other if len(other) == 1 and other != char else ""


def index(
    glyphs: list[tuple[str, list[int]]],
) -> tuple[dict[str, list[int]], dict[int, str]]:
    """(codes by name, first glyph by code) for fast lookups."""
    by_code = {}
    for glyph, codes in glyphs:
        for code in codes:
            by_code.setdefault(code, glyph)
    return dict(glyphs), by_code


def counterpart(
    name: str, codes_of: dict[str, list[int]], by_code: dict[int, str]
) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    """(counterpart name or None, how) for one glyph name."""
    codes = codes_of.get(name, [])
    if codes:
        other = swap_case(chr(codes[0]))
        if other and ord(other) in by_code:
            return by_code[ord(other)], f"{chr(codes[0])} → {other}"
        return (
            None,
            f"{chr(codes[0])} has no counterpart in the font" if other else "no case",
        )
    base, dot, suffix = name.partition(".")
    base_codes = codes_of.get(base, [])
    if dot and base_codes:
        partner, _ = counterpart(base, codes_of, by_code)
        if partner and f"{partner}.{suffix}" in codes_of:
            return f"{partner}.{suffix}", f"via {base} → {partner}"
    return None, "unencoded"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class CasePairs(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(480)
        self.resize(500, 440)
        self.pairs = []
        root = self.root

        self.table = self.make_table(["Glyph", "Counterpart", "How"])
        self.table.setFocusPolicy(QtCore.Qt.NoFocus)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        self.keep = QtGui.QCheckBox("Keep the original glyphs selected too")
        root.addWidget(self.keep)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.reload_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Reload selection")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select counterparts")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.reload_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.reload_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.reload())
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_counterparts())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.reload()

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def reload(self) -> None:
        """Rescan the current font; render complete rows before enabling selection."""
        glyphs = font_glyphs()
        self.selection = selected_names() if glyphs else []
        codes_of, by_code = index(glyphs)
        self.pairs = [
            (name, *counterpart(name, codes_of, by_code)) for name in self.selection
        ]
        found = [p for p in self.pairs if p[1]]
        if not glyphs:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not self.selection:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then click Reload selection.",
            )
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(found)} of {len(self.selection)} selected glyphs have a case counterpart "
                "in this font.",
            )
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.pairs))
        for row, (name, partner, how) in enumerate(self.pairs):
            for column, text in enumerate((name, partner or "–", how)):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column == 1 and partner:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(accent))
                if column == 2:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(QtGui.QColor(muted(self))))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(found))
        self.status.setText(f"{len(found)} counterpart{'s' if len(found) != 1 else ''}")

    def select_counterparts(self) -> None:
        """Select mapped partners; optionally retain the originally scanned glyphs."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        names = [p[1] for p in self.pairs if p[1]]
        if self.keep.isChecked():
            names += self.selection
        selected = self.select_names(names)
        self.last_result = {"selected": selected}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(selected)} glyph{'s' if len(selected) != 1 else ''}",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(CasePairs, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
