Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Names/Character Info.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Character Info
"""A live panel describing the character of the glyph selected in the Font window.

Shows the outline next to the system font's rendering, the code point, the
Unicode name and category (Python's unicodedata), case counterpart,
decomposition and the UTF-8/UTF-16 encodings. It follows the selection
twice a second; nothing in the font changes.
"""

import unicodedata
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_muted,
    names_selected_names,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Character Info"
KEY = "names_character_info"
POLL_MS = 500
CATEGORIES = {
    "Lu": "Letter, uppercase",
    "Ll": "Letter, lowercase",
    "Lt": "Letter, titlecase",
    "Lm": "Letter, modifier",
    "Lo": "Letter, other",
    "Mn": "Mark, nonspacing",
    "Mc": "Mark, spacing",
    "Me": "Mark, enclosing",
    "Nd": "Number, decimal",
    "Nl": "Number, letter",
    "No": "Number, other",
    "Pc": "Punctuation, connector",
    "Pd": "Punctuation, dash",
    "Ps": "Punctuation, open",
    "Pe": "Punctuation, close",
    "Pi": "Punctuation, initial",
    "Pf": "Punctuation, final",
    "Po": "Punctuation, other",
    "Sm": "Symbol, math",
    "Sc": "Symbol, currency",
    "Sk": "Symbol, modifier",
    "So": "Symbol, other",
    "Zs": "Separator, space",
    "Cc": "Control",
    "Cf": "Format",
    "Co": "Private use",
    "Cn": "Unassigned",
}
FIELDS = [
    "Glyph",
    "Code point",
    "Unicode name",
    "Category",
    "Case pair",
    "Decomposition",
    "UTF-8",
    "UTF-16",
    "Escape",
]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def current_package() -> Any | None:
    """Read current native font state without changing font data."""
    package = fontlab.flWorkspace.instance().currentPackage
    if package is None or package.isNull:
        return None
    return package


def focused_name() -> str | None:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return next(iter(names_selected_names()), None)


def layer_path(layer: Any) -> Any:
    """The layer's outline as one QPainterPath in font units (y up), components placed."""
    path = QtGui.QPainterPath()
    path.setFillRule(QtCore.Qt.WindingFill)
    for shape in layer.shapes:
        for part in (shape.closedPath, shape.openedPath):
            if part is not None and not part.isEmpty():
                path.addPath(shape.transform.map(part))
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def describe(code: int) -> dict[str, str]:
    """{field: text} for one code point (pure Python, no font access)."""
    char = chr(code)
    category = unicodedata.category(char)
    upper, lower = char.upper(), char.lower()
    pair = lower if char != lower else upper if char != upper else ""
    utf16 = char.encode("utf-16-be")
    return {
        "Code point": f"U+{code:04X}",
        "Unicode name": unicodedata.name(char, "(no name)"),
        "Category": f"{category} · {CATEGORIES.get(category, '')}",
        "Case pair": " ".join(f"{c} U+{ord(c):04X}" for c in pair) if pair else "–",
        "Decomposition": unicodedata.decomposition(char) or "–",
        "UTF-8": " ".join(f"{b:02X}" for b in char.encode("utf-8")),
        "UTF-16": " ".join(
            utf16[i : i + 2].hex().upper() for i in range(0, len(utf16), 2)
        ),
        "Escape": f"\\u{code:04x}" if code <= 0xFFFF else f"\\U{code:08x}",
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class Specimen(QtGui.QWidget):
    """Custom painter: the glyph outline (left) and the system font's character (right)."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        QtGui.QWidget.__init__(self, parent)
        self.paint_error = ""
        self.on_error = None  # dialog hook: show drawing errors in the status label
        self.setMinimumHeight(150)
        self.path, self.advance, self.char = None, 0, ""
        self.frame = (-250, 750)

    def set_content(
        self, path: Any, advance: float, char: str, frame: tuple[float, float]
    ) -> None:
        """Replace proof outline, advance, character and vertical frame."""
        self.path, self.advance, self.char, self.frame = path, advance, char, frame
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Draw the proof; contain native painter errors and always end painting."""
        painter = QtGui.QPainter(self)
        try:
            self.draw(painter)
            self.paint_error = ""
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - contain native painter failures
            self.paint_error = repr(error)
            if self.on_error is not None:
                try:
                    self.on_error(self.paint_error)
                except Exception as hook_error:  # noqa: BLE001 - contain error hook
                    self.paint_error += f"; error hook: {hook_error!r}"
        finally:
            painter.end()

    def draw(self, painter: Any) -> None:
        """Fit the full outline and metric frame inside the padded left proof.

        Include overhangs and tall accents in both-axis fitting; retain the
        baseline, labels and independent system-font proof on the right.
        """
        painter.setRenderHint(QtGui.QPainter.Antialiasing)
        text = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Text))
        faint = QtGui.QColor(text)
        faint.setAlpha(35)
        soft = QtGui.QColor(text)
        soft.setAlpha(120)
        half = self.width / 2.0
        height = self.height
        painter.setPen(QtGui.QPen(QtGui.QBrush(faint), 1.0))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(QtCore.QRectF(0.5, 0.5, half - 6, height - 1), 8, 8)
        painter.drawRoundedRect(
            QtCore.QRectF(half + 6, 0.5, half - 6.5, height - 1),
            8,
            8,
        )
        small = QtGui.QFont(painter.font())
        small.setPointSizeF(max(8.0, small.pointSizeF() * 0.85))
        painter.setFont(small)
        painter.setPen(soft)
        painter.drawText(
            QtCore.QRectF(8, height - 22, half - 20, 18),
            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignLeft),
            "Font outline",
        )
        painter.drawText(
            QtCore.QRectF(half + 14, height - 22, half - 20, 18),
            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignLeft),
            "System font",
        )
        descender, ascender = self.frame
        if self.path is not None:
            bounds = self.path.boundingRect()
            left = min(0.0, self.advance, bounds.left())
            right = max(0.0, self.advance, bounds.right())
            bottom = min(0.0, descender, bounds.top())
            top = max(0.0, ascender, bounds.bottom())
            proof_width, proof_height = half - 22, height - 38
            scale = min(
                proof_width / max(1.0, right - left),
                proof_height / max(1.0, top - bottom),
            )
            origin = 8 + (proof_width - (right - left) * scale) / 2 - left * scale
            baseline = 8 + (proof_height - (top - bottom) * scale) / 2 + top * scale
            painter.setPen(QtGui.QPen(QtGui.QBrush(faint), 1.0))
            painter.drawLine(
                QtCore.QPointF(8, baseline),
                QtCore.QPointF(half - 14, baseline),
            )
            painter.save()
            painter.translate(origin, baseline)
            painter.scale(scale, 0 - scale)
            painter.fillPath(self.path, QtGui.QBrush(text))
            painter.restore()
        if self.char:
            big = QtGui.QFont(painter.font())
            big.setPixelSize(int(height * 0.55))
            painter.setFont(big)
            painter.setPen(text)
            painter.drawText(
                QtCore.QRectF(half + 6, 0, half - 6, height - 18),
                int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter),
                self.char,
            )


class CharacterInfo(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(480)
        self.shown_name = None
        root = self.root

        self.specimen = Specimen()
        root.addWidget(self.specimen)

        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(14)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(6)
        self.fields = {}
        for row, label in enumerate(FIELDS):
            caption = QtGui.QLabel(label)
            caption.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
            value = QtGui.QLabel("–")
            value.setTextInteractionFlags(QtCore.Qt.TextSelectableByMouse)
            value.setWordWrap(True)
            caption.setAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignTop))
            form.addWidget(caption, row, 0)
            form.addWidget(value, row, 1)
            self.fields[label] = value
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.others = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.others.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.others)
        root.addStretch(1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.specimen.on_error = lambda text: self.status.setText(
            "Drawing failed: " + text,
        )
        self.copy_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy character")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self.timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.timer.setInterval(POLL_MS)
        self._connect(self.timer.timeout, lambda *a: self.poll())
        self._connect(self.copy_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.copy())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()
        self.timer.start()

    def poll(self) -> None:
        """Refresh at each timer tick, including font and master switches."""
        self.refresh()

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self, name: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Read current font data; update original fields and action availability."""
        package = current_package()
        name = name or (focused_name() if package else None)
        self.shown_name = name
        glyph = package.findName(name) if package and name else None
        self.current = {}
        if glyph is None:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Open a font and select a glyph in the Font window."
                if package is None
                else "Select a glyph in the Font window.",
            )
            for value in self.fields.values():
                value.setText("–")
            self.specimen.set_content(None, 0, "", (-250, 750))
            self.copy_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        codes = list(glyph.fgGlyph.unicodes)
        layer = glyph.findLayer(package.master)
        path = layer_path(layer) if layer is not None else None
        char = chr(codes[0]) if codes else ""
        frame = (package.descender_value, package.ascender_value)
        self.specimen.set_content(
            path,
            layer.advanceWidth if layer is not None else 0,
            char,
            frame,
        )
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"Follows the Font window selection · master {package.master}",
        )
        self.current = describe(codes[0]) if codes else {}
        self.current["Glyph"] = name
        for label, value in self.fields.items():
            value.setText(
                self.current.get(
                    label,
                    "– (unencoded)" if label == "Code point" else "–",
                ),
            )
        self.others.setText(
            "Also encoded: " + ", ".join(f"U+{c:04X}" for c in codes[1:])
            if len(codes) > 1
            else "",
        )
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(char))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{name} · {len(codes)} code point{'s' if len(codes) != 1 else ''}",
        )

    def copy(self) -> None:
        """Copy the current encoded character from a valid live snapshot."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        if self.specimen.char:
            QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.specimen.char)
            self.status.setText(f"Copied {self.specimen.char}")


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(CharacterInfo, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.text:
Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Names/Character Set Compare.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Charset Compare
"""Paste a text or a character set and compare it with the font's encoded characters.

Lists characters of the text the font lacks and characters the font has
that the text does not use, with names from unicodedata. Language presets
fill in common alphabets. Copy the missing set, or select the extra glyphs
in the Font window. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

import unicodedata
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_muted,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Charset Compare"
KEY = "names_charset_compare"
LATIN = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
PRESETS = [
    ("Paste your own text…", ""),
    ("Basic Latin (ASCII)", "".join(chr(c) for c in range(0x21, 0x7F))),
    (
        "Latin-1 letters",
        LATIN + "".join(chr(c) for c in range(0xC0, 0x100) if chr(c).isalpha()),
    ),
    ("Polish", LATIN + "ĄĆĘŁŃÓŚŹŻąćęłńóśźż"),
    ("Czech", LATIN + "ÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽáčďéěíňóřšťúůýž"),
    ("German", LATIN + "ÄÖÜẞäöüß„“‚‘"),
    ("French", LATIN + "ÀÂÆÇÉÈÊËÎÏÔŒÙÛÜŸàâæçéèêëîïôœùûüÿ«»"),
    ("Spanish", LATIN + "ÁÉÍÑÓÚÜáéíñóúü¡¿"),
    ("Turkish", LATIN + "ÇĞİÖŞÜçğıöşü"),
]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def font_chars() -> dict[str, str]:
    """{character: glyph name} for every encoded glyph of the current font."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    out = {}
    for glyph in font.glyphs if font is not None else []:
        for code in glyph.unicodes:
            out.setdefault(chr(code), glyph.name)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def text_chars(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Distinct non-whitespace characters of the text, sorted by code point."""
    return sorted({c for c in text if not c.isspace()}, key=ord)


def compare(text: str, available: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """(missing, extra): characters of the text absent from the font, and font characters absent from it."""
    wanted = text_chars(text)
    wanted_set = set(wanted)
    missing = [c for c in wanted if c not in available]
    extra = sorted(
        (c for c in available if c not in wanted_set and not c.isspace()),
        key=ord,
    )
    return missing, extra


def describe(char: str) -> str:
    """Format a character, code point and Unicode name for comparison lists."""
    return f"{char}   U+{ord(char):04X}   {unicodedata.name(char, '').title()}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class CharsetCompare(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)
        self.resize(680, 560)
        self.available = font_chars()
        self.missing, self.extra = [], []
        root = self.root

        row = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        row.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Preset"))
        self.preset = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for label, _ in PRESETS:
            self.preset.addItem(label)
        row.addWidget(self.preset, 1)
        root.addLayout(row)
        self.text = QtGui.QPlainTextEdit()
        self.text.setPlaceholderText("Paste a text or a list of characters…")
        self.text.setMaximumHeight(90)
        root.addWidget(self.text)

        lists = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        lists.setSpacing(12)
        self.missing_label, self.missing_list = self._column(lists)
        self.extra_label, self.extra_list = self._column(lists)
        root.addLayout(lists, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.copy_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy missing")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select extra glyphs")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(
            self.preset.currentIndexChanged,
            lambda *a: self.use_preset(self.preset.currentIndex),
        )
        self._connect(self.text.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.copy_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.copy_missing())
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_extra())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()

    def _column(self, parent: Any) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
        """Create a read-only character list with its count heading."""
        column = QtGui.QVBoxLayout()
        label = QtGui.QLabel()
        bold = label.font
        bold.setBold(True)
        label.setFont(bold)
        listing = QtGui.QListWidget()
        listing.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        listing.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        listing.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        listing.setTextElideMode(QtCore.Qt.ElideRight)
        column.addWidget(label)
        column.addWidget(listing, 1)
        parent.addLayout(column, 1)
        return label, listing

    def use_preset(self, index: int) -> None:
        """Fill the text control with the complete selected language alphabet."""
        if 0 < index < len(PRESETS):
            self.text.setPlainText(PRESETS[index][1])

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read current font data; update original fields and action availability."""
        self.available = font_chars()
        text = self.text.toPlainText()
        self.missing, self.extra = compare(text, self.available)
        count = len(text_chars(text))
        if not self.available:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font with encoded glyphs first.")
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"The font encodes {len(self.available)} characters; the text uses {count}.",
            )
        self.missing_label.setText(f"Missing from the font ({len(self.missing)})")
        self.extra_label.setText(f"In the font, not in the text ({len(self.extra)})")
        alert = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
        self.missing_list.clear()
        for char in self.missing:
            item = QtGui.QListWidgetItem(describe(char))
            item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(alert))
            self.missing_list.addItem(item)
        self.extra_list.clear()
        for char in self.extra:
            self.extra_list.addItem(
                QtGui.QListWidgetItem(f"{describe(char)}   · {self.available[char]}"),
            )
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(self.missing))
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(self.extra) and bool(text.strip()))
        covered = count - len(self.missing)
        self.status.setText(
            f"Coverage {covered}/{count}"
            + (f" · {100.0 * covered / count:.0f}%" if count else ""),
        )

    def copy_missing(self) -> None:
        """Copy the missing character set from a valid comparison snapshot."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText("".join(self.missing))
        self.status.setText(f"Copied {len(self.missing)} characters")

    def select_extra(self) -> None:
        """Select encoded characters absent from the text in the scanned font."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        names = [self.available[c] for c in self.extra]
        count = len(self.select_names(names))
        self.last_result = {"selected": names}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {count} extra glyph{'s' if count != 1 else ''} in the Font window",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(CharsetCompare, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Names/Glyph Finder.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Glyph Finder
"""Type to find glyphs by name, character or code point; Enter selects them in the Font window.

Accepts a name fragment (acute), a wildcard pattern (*.ss0?), a character
(é), or a code point (U+00E9, 0x1E82, uni00E9). The list updates as you
type; double-click a row to select just that glyph. Nothing in the font
changes.
"""

import fnmatch
import re
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_font_glyphs,
    names_muted,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Glyph Finder"
KEY = "names_glyph_finder"
MAX_ROWS = 3000
CODE = re.compile(r"^(?:U\+|u\+|0x|0X|uni|u)([0-9A-Fa-f]{4,6})$")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def font_glyphs() -> list[tuple[str, list[int]]]:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return names_font_glyphs()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def matcher(query: str) -> tuple[str, Callable[[str, list[int]], bool]]:
    """(kind, test(name, codes) -> bool) for a query string."""
    query = query.strip()
    code = CODE.match(query)
    if code:
        value = int(code.group(1), 16)
        return "code point", lambda name, codes: value in codes
    if (len(query) == 1 and not query.isalnum()) or (
        len(query) == 1 and ord(query) > 127
    ):
        value = ord(query)
        return "character", lambda name, codes: value in codes
    if any(c in query for c in "*?["):
        return "pattern", lambda name, codes: fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, query)
    lowered = query.lower()
    if len(query) == 1:
        value = ord(query)
        return (
            "name or character",
            lambda name, codes: value in codes or lowered in name.lower(),
        )
    return "name", lambda name, codes: lowered in name.lower()


def find(
    glyphs: list[tuple[str, list[int]]], query: str
) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, list[int]]]]:
    """(kind, [(name, codes)]) matching the query; everything for an empty query."""
    if not query.strip():
        return "all", list(glyphs)
    kind, test = matcher(query)
    return kind, [(name, codes) for name, codes in glyphs if test(name, codes)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class Finder(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(480)
        self.resize(500, 560)
        self.glyphs = font_glyphs()
        self.matches = []
        root = self.root

        self.search = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.search.setPlaceholderText("acute · *.ss0? · é · U+00E9")
        self.search.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        big = self.search.font
        big.setPointSizeF(big.pointSizeF() * 1.15)
        self.search.setFont(big)
        root.addWidget(self.search)

        self.table = self.make_table(["Glyph", "Char", "Unicode"])
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select in Font window")
        self.close_button.setAutoDefault(False)
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.search.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.search.returnPressed, lambda *a: self.select_matches())
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked,
            lambda row, *a: self.select_row(row),
        )
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_matches())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()
        self.search.setFocus()

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read current font data; update original fields and action availability."""
        self.glyphs = font_glyphs()
        if not self.glyphs:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        kind, self.matches = find(self.glyphs, self.search.text)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"Searching {len(self.glyphs)} glyphs by {kind}. "
            "Enter selects every match in the Font window.",
        )
        shown = self.matches[:MAX_ROWS]
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        self.table.setRowCount(len(shown))
        for row, (name, codes) in enumerate(shown):
            char = "".join(chr(c) for c in codes[:1])
            cells = [name, char, " ".join(f"U+{c:04X}" for c in codes) or "–"]
            for column, text in enumerate(cells):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column == 1:
                    item.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter))
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(accent))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        more = f" (showing {MAX_ROWS})" if len(self.matches) > MAX_ROWS else ""
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(self.matches))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.matches)} match{'es' if len(self.matches) != 1 else ''}{more}",
        )

    def select_matches(self) -> None:
        """Select chosen rows, or every match, in the scanned font only."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        rows = sorted(
            {index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()},
        )
        names = (
            [self.matches[r][0] for r in rows]
            if rows
            else [name for name, _ in self.matches]
        )
        count = len(self.select_names(names))
        self.last_result = {"selected": names}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {count} glyph{'s' if count != 1 else ''} in the Font window",
        )

    def select_row(self, row: int) -> None:
        """Select one double-clicked result in the scanned font only."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        if 0 <= row < len(self.matches):
            count = len(self.select_names([self.matches[row][0]]))
            self.last_result = {"selected": [self.matches[row][0]]}
            self.status.setText(
                f"Selected {self.matches[row][0]}" if count else "Glyph not found",
            )


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(Finder, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.text:
Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Names/Select by Mark.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Select by Mark
"""Select glyphs in the Font window by their mark colour.

Lists every mark colour used in the font (and unmarked glyphs) with a
swatch and a count. Pick one or more rows and click Select, or double-click
a row. Optionally add to the current selection. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_font_window_selection,
    names_muted,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Select by Mark"
KEY = "names_select_by_mark"
HUES = [
    (15, "red"),
    (45, "orange"),
    (70, "yellow"),
    (160, "green"),
    (200, "teal"),
    (255, "blue"),
    (290, "purple"),
    (335, "pink"),
    (361, "red"),
]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def font_marks() -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """[(glyph name, mark)] for the current font, in font order."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    return [(g.name, int(g.mark or 0)) for g in font.glyphs] if font is not None else []


def font_window_selection() -> list[str]:
    """Read exact Font window selection through the shared helper, no fallback."""
    return names_font_window_selection()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def mark_color(mark: int, lightness: int = 150) -> Any | None:
    """The QColor FontLab shows for a mark value, or None for no mark."""
    if mark <= 0:
        return None
    if mark <= 360:
        return QtGui.QColor.fromHsl(mark - 1, 200, lightness)
    grey = min(255, lightness // 2 + max(0, mark - 1000) // 2)
    return QtGui.QColor(grey, grey, grey)


def mark_label(mark: int) -> str:
    """Describe native mark hue or grey value; zero means unmarked."""
    if mark <= 0:
        return "Unmarked"
    if mark > 360:
        return f"Grey {mark - 1000}"
    hue = mark - 1
    return (
        next(name for limit, name in HUES if hue < limit).capitalize()
        + f" (hue {hue}°)"
    )


def groups(marks: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> list[tuple[int, list[str]]]:
    """[(mark, [names])], marked colours by hue first, unmarked last."""
    out = {}
    for name, mark in marks:
        out.setdefault(mark, []).append(name)
    return sorted(out.items(), key=lambda item: (item[0] == 0, item[0]))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


def swatch(mark: int, size: int = 16) -> Any:
    """Paint a native mark icon; always release the owned painter."""
    pixmap = QtGui.QPixmap(size, size)
    pixmap.fill(QtGui.QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
    painter = QtGui.QPainter(pixmap)
    try:
        painter.setRenderHint(QtGui.QPainter.Antialiasing)
        color = mark_color(mark)
        if color is None:
            painter.setPen(
                QtGui.QPen(
                    QtGui.QBrush(QtGui.QColor(128, 128, 128)),
                    1.0,
                    QtCore.Qt.DashLine,
                ),
            )
            painter.drawRoundedRect(QtCore.QRectF(1, 1, size - 2, size - 2), 4, 4)
        else:
            painter.setPen(QtCore.Qt.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QtGui.QBrush(color))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(QtCore.QRectF(0, 0, size, size), 4, 4)
    finally:
        painter.end()
    return QtGui.QIcon(pixmap)


class SelectByMark(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(520)
        self.resize(540, 460)
        self.groups = []
        root = self.root

        self.table = self.make_table(["Mark", "Glyphs", "Examples"])
        self.table.setIconSize(QtCore.QSize(16, 16))
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        self.add = QtGui.QCheckBox("Add to the current selection")
        root.addWidget(self.add)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.reload_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Reload")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.reload_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked,
            lambda row, *a: self.select_rows([row]),
        )
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_rows())
        self._connect(self.reload_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.reload())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.reload()

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def reload(self) -> None:
        """Rescan the current font; render complete rows before enabling selection."""
        marks = font_marks()
        self.groups = groups(marks)
        if not marks:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            marked = sum(len(names) for mark, names in self.groups if mark)
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{marked} of {len(marks)} glyphs carry a mark. Pick colours and click Select "
                "(or double-click a row).",
            )
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.groups))
        for row, (mark, names) in enumerate(self.groups):
            label = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(swatch(mark), mark_label(mark))
            count = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(str(len(names)))
            count.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter))
            sample = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(
                " ".join(names[:6]) + (" …" if len(names) > 6 else ""),
            )
            sample.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link)))
            for column, item in enumerate((label, count, sample)):
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(self.groups))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.groups)} mark value{'s' if len(self.groups) != 1 else ''}",
        )

    def select_rows(self, rows: list[int] | None = None) -> None:
        """Select requested mark groups; optionally add current selection."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        if rows is None:
            rows = sorted(
                {index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()},
            )
        names = [
            name
            for row in rows
            if 0 <= row < len(self.groups)
            for name in self.groups[row][1]
        ]
        if not names:
            self.status.setText("Pick at least one row first.")
            return
        count = len(self.select_names(names, add=self.add.isChecked()))
        self.last_result = {
            "marks": [self.groups[r][0] for r in rows],
            "names": names,
            "selected": count,
        }
        self.status.setText(f"Selected {count} glyph{'s' if count != 1 else ''}")


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(SelectByMark, KEY)

# this_file: Scripts/Proof/Glyph Grid.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Proof · Glyph Grid
"""Show the selected glyphs on every master side by side, drawn from their outlines.

Rows are glyphs, columns are masters; all cells share one scale so weights
and widths compare directly. The slider zooms. Composites are drawn with
their components in place. Nothing in the font changes."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    proof_api,
    proof_dialog_type,
    proof_snapshot_refresh,
    proof_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
)

QtCore, QtGui = (qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui)
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = proof_api()
selected_glyphs = _api.selected_glyphs
layer_path = _api.layer_path
metrics = _api.metrics
Grid = proof_view_types().Grid
TITLE = "Glyph Grid"
KEY = "proof_glyph_grid"


class GlyphGrid(proof_dialog_type()):
    """Retain the original Proof controls on the shared owned dialog."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original controls and retain only owned native UI resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self.resize(640, 560)
        self.glyphs, self.masters = [], []
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        form.setSpacing(10)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Zoom"))
        self.zoom = QtGui.QSlider(QtCore.Qt.Horizontal)
        self.zoom.setRange(48, 240)
        self.zoom.setValue(110)
        form.addWidget(self.zoom, 1)
        self.zoom_label = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.zoom_label.setMinimumWidth(48)
        form.addWidget(self.zoom_label)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.grid = Grid()
        self.add_proof_view(self.grid)
        self.add_proof_footer(reload_selection=True)
        self._connect(self.zoom.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.reload_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.reload())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    def load_initial(self) -> None:
        """Read selection and masters inside the complete guarded initial transaction."""
        glyphs = selected_glyphs(self.package) if self.package else []
        masters = list(self.package.masters) if self.package else []
        self.glyphs, self.masters = glyphs, masters

    def reload(self) -> None:
        """Explicitly reload the current font and selection without changing either."""
        self._initial_ready = self._binding_set = False
        self.refresh()

    @proof_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete bound-font proof for the original controls."""
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then click Reload selection."
            )
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{count} glyph{('s' if count != 1 else '')} × {len(self.masters)} masters, one scale for all cells; numbers are advance widths."
            )
        cells = []
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            row = []
            for master in self.masters:
                layer = glyph.findLayer(master)
                if layer is None or layer.isNull:
                    row.append((master, None, 0))
                else:
                    row.append((master, layer_path(layer), layer.advanceWidth))
            cells.append((glyph.name, row))
        frame = metrics(self.package) if self.package else (-250, 750)
        for _, row in cells:
            for _, path, _ in row:
                if path is not None and (not path.isEmpty()):
                    box = path.boundingRect()
                    frame = (min(frame[0], box.top()), max(frame[1], box.bottom()))
        self.grid.set_content(cells, self.masters, frame, self.zoom.value)
        self.zoom_label.setText(f"{self.zoom.value} px")
        self.status.setText(f"{count * len(self.masters)} cells")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry entry with this owned modeless Proof tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(GlyphGrid, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.title: Glyphs Between Lining Figures
docs.text:
Open a new native Glyph tab with glyphs between lining figures.

Select glyphs in a Font window or occurrences in a Glyph window, then run this Proof command. Keep their actual order and repeated editor occurrences. The new tab uses the font's current master; source layer overrides are not copied. The selected glyph name appears between each context name, or inside repeated H, I, HHOHH or nnonn contexts, as indicated by the command. Between sequences end with the selected glyph and two newlines per occurrence. Surround sequences end with one final context. With no selection, Between opens an empty tab; Surround opens its context alone. The original behavior is retained.

App builds all glyph-name rows before opening. Named native symbols retain unencoded glyphs and oldstyle .osf names without slash-text or Unicode fallback. No context is filtered or substituted when a name is missing; native missing-name behavior still needs qualification. One deadline covers selected-layer capture, generation, symbols and preflight. A changed source selection/font or invalid input refuses the complete operation. A named-content writer can target only a verified new active tab belonging to the captured source font. It never populates an existing or foreign tab. Native failure can leave a new tab; no atomic UI rollback is claimed. The owned native sender is disconnected and deleted.

This adaptation preserves Output instead of clearing/printing status. It calls no glyph geometry, history, preference or master writer. Native tab text/order, missing names, selection/focus and complete font/history/dirty preservation remain pending. Requires reviewed App>=0.2.40.dev0 and Fly in FontLab9 Python3.11. docs.text:
Open the exact highest and lowest foreground layers in a fresh FontLab tab.

Run this Proof command with a font open. Scan all foreground masters and ordinary auxiliary layers; omit masks/service caches. Keep font glyph order and the first layer on equal coordinates. Empty bounds participate, and the same winner appears twice when it is both extrema. Preserve unencoded glyph names and exact layer names rather than substituting Unicode or slash text. Missing/ambiguous layers and stale/slow reads fail before a proof. A modeless coordinate panel preserves the source messages without changing Output. Run Again repeats the complete scan and new-tab action.

Fly loads shared App capture, extrema selection and native named-layer tabs. No missing layer is created; no master/selection/font/history/Output writer or application-wide event loop is used. docs.title: Random Lowercase Nontext
docs.text:
Open a new FontLab Glyph tab with random lowercase nontext.

Open a font and run this Proof command. It uses the current font and opens one new tab, preserving existing tabs. Run again to get another proof. Content is 700 lowercase letters; draw a divisor from 3, 5 and 7 at every index. Keep all source draw order, spaces, duplicate entries and compound names. Spaces for non-text/numbers follow index modulo a fresh random divisor, including index zero. Words keep their final space. Do not trim or filter characters absent from the font; send them unchanged to the native editor.

Shared App code generates the complete text before a tab is opened. Fly loads App. The native doCreateTextBlock operation opens the new FontLab Glyph tab. No application-wide event loop or replacement editor is needed. No open font is an error before random draws/tab creation. Resource/generation failure opens no tab. A native tab failure propagates; it may leave an empty new tab, so atomic rollback is not claimed. Native tab content, missing-character handling, source-font binding and full data/history preservation remain pending.

The port repairs the source's undefined Font global with explicit current-font lookup. It preserves Output instead of clearing it or printing status there. Requires reviewed App>=0.2.38.dev0 and Fly in FontLab9 Python3.11. Adapted from Pedro Arilla's Apache-2.0 Random/Random lowercase non-text.py. docs.title: Random Title Words
docs.text:
Open a new FontLab Glyph tab with random title words.

Open a font and run this Proof command. It uses the current font and opens one new tab, preserving existing tabs. Run again to get another proof. Content is One entry per a..z bucket from all 4,991 source entries, with whole-text title casing. Keep all source draw order, spaces, duplicate entries and compound names. Spaces for non-text/numbers follow index modulo a fresh random divisor, including index zero. Words keep their final space. Do not trim or filter characters absent from the font; send them unchanged to the native editor.

Shared App code generates the complete text before a tab is opened. Fly loads App. The native doCreateTextBlock operation opens the new FontLab Glyph tab. No application-wide event loop or replacement editor is needed. No open font is an error before random draws/tab creation. Resource/generation failure opens no tab. A native tab failure propagates; it may leave an empty new tab, so atomic rollback is not claimed. Native tab content, missing-character handling, source-font binding and full data/history preservation remain pending.

The port repairs the source's undefined Font global with explicit current-font lookup. It preserves Output instead of clearing it or printing status there. Requires reviewed App>=0.2.38.dev0 and Fly in FontLab9 Python3.11. Adapted from Pedro Arilla's Apache-2.0 Random/Random Title words.py. See NOTICE and additional-tools.json for source/data/license provenance.

Run Proof > Random Title Words from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

docs.title: Tallest and Shortest
docs.text:
Open the exact highest and lowest current-master layers in a fresh FontLab tab.

Run this Proof command with a font open. Scan only the selected master. Keep font glyph order and the first layer on equal coordinates. Empty bounds participate, and the same winner appears twice when it is both extrema. Preserve unencoded glyph names and exact layer names rather than substituting Unicode or slash text. Missing/ambiguous layers and stale/slow reads fail before a proof. Return both winning layers and coordinates for Python callers.

Fly loads shared App capture, extrema selection and native named-layer tabs. No missing layer is created; no master/selection/font/history/Output writer or application-wide event loop is used. A native tab failure can leave a new tab; no atomic UI rollback is claimed. Native scope/order/role/bounds/tab and full font/history/dirty/save/reopen preservation still require owned qualification. Requires reviewed unpublished App>=0.2.49.dev0 and Fly in FontLab9/Python3.11. Modified from simoncozens--GlyphsScripts/Tallest And Shortest.py; see NOTICE/additional-tools.json. The port fixes the undefined font global and +/-9999 sentinels.

Run Proof > Tallest and Shortest from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

docs.title: Text By Master
docs.text:
Render the same text once per master, stacked, to compare weight and width at a glance.

Each row is drawn from that master's outlines with its line width in units. Type text (use /glyphname for unencoded glyphs), adjust the size and scroll through the masters. Advance widths only: kerning is not applied. Nothing in the font changes.

Run Proof > Text By Master from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

docs.title: Source
docs.text:
Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Proof/Text By Master.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Proof · Text By Master
"""Render the same text once per master, stacked, to compare weight and width at a glance.

Each row is drawn from that master's outlines with its line width in units.
Type text (use /glyphname for unencoded glyphs), adjust the size and scroll
through the masters. Advance widths only: kerning is not applied. Nothing in
the font changes."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    proof_api,
    proof_dialog_type,
    proof_snapshot_refresh,
    proof_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
)

QtCore, QtGui = (qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui)
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = proof_api()
font_maps = _api.font_maps
layer_path = _api.layer_path
parse_text = _api.parse_text
glyph_run = _api.glyph_run
MasterRows = proof_view_types().MasterRows
TITLE = "Text by Master"
KEY = "proof_text_by_master"
DEFAULT_TEXT = "Hamburgefonstiv"


class TextByMaster(proof_dialog_type()):
    """Retain the original Proof controls on the shared owned dialog."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original controls and retain only owned native UI resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(600)
        self.resize(720, 600)
        self.cmap, self.names = {}, set()
        self.rows = []
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.text = QtGui.QLineEdit(DEFAULT_TEXT)
        self.size_slider = QtGui.QSlider(QtCore.Qt.Horizontal)
        self.size_slider.setRange(12, 160)
        self.size_slider.setValue(48)
        self.size_label = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.size_label.setMinimumWidth(48)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Text"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.text, 0, 1, 1, 2)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Size"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.size_slider, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(self.size_label, 1, 2)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.view = MasterRows()
        self.add_proof_view(self.view, background=True)
        self.add_proof_footer()
        self._connect(self.text.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.size_slider.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    def load_initial(self) -> None:
        """Read the complete encoding/name maps after the empty UI and Close exist."""
        self.cmap, self.names = font_maps()

    @proof_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete bound-font proof for the original controls."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        glyph_names = parse_text(self.text.text, self.cmap, self.names)
        self.rows = []
        for master in self.package.masters:
            run = glyph_run(self.package, glyph_names, master)
            self.rows.append((master, run, sum((advance for _, advance in run))))
        frame = (self.package.descender_value, self.package.ascender_value)
        self.view.set_content(
            self.rows, self.size_slider.value, self.package.upm, frame
        )
        self.size_label.setText(f"{self.size_slider.value} px")
        missing = sum(1 for n in glyph_names if n is None)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(self.rows)} masters · {len(glyph_names)} glyphs · advance widths, no kerning."
        )
        widths = [w for _, _, w in self.rows]
        spread = f" · widths {min(widths):g}–{max(widths):g} units" if widths else ""
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.rows)} rows{spread}"
            + (f" · {missing} missing" if missing else "")
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry entry with this owned modeless Proof tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(TextByMaster, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.text:
Filter proof text in a modeless FontLab Text Simplifier panel.

Run this Proof command, enter input and a regular-expression character class, then choose Simplify. Ranges such as A-Z and escapes such as \s keep their source meaning. Output is read-only. Reset retains input and restores the original output/character defaults. All three fields and window geometry are saved in this tool's own settings namespace. Optional New Tab uses the source font captured on launch; a changed/closed font is refused by the shared sender.

Fly loads shared App controls, filtering, saved fields and owned lifecycle. No application event loop, system clipboard or font-design writer is used. Native PythonQt/settings/tab/font/history preservation remains pending. Requires the reviewed unpublished App>=0.2.48.dev0 candidate and Fly. Type any text (use /glyphname for unencoded glyphs, e.g. /a.ss01), pick a master and edit the list of pixel sizes. Characters the font lacks show as red boxes. Advance widths only: kerning is not applied. Nothing in the font changes.

docs.text:
Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Proof/Waterfall.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Proof · Waterfall
"""Render a line of text in a cascade of sizes, drawn straight from the glyph outlines.

Type any text (use /glyphname for unencoded glyphs, e.g. /a.ss01), pick a
master and edit the list of pixel sizes. Characters the font lacks show as
red boxes. Advance widths only: kerning is not applied. Nothing in the font
changes."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    proof_api,
    proof_dialog_type,
    proof_snapshot_refresh,
    proof_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_muted as muted,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
)

QtCore, QtGui = (qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui)
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = proof_api()
character_map = _api.character_map
font_maps = _api.font_maps
layer_path = _api.layer_path
parse_text = _api.parse_text
parse_sizes = _api.parse_sizes
glyph_run = _api.glyph_run
WaterfallView = proof_view_types().WaterfallView
TITLE = "Waterfall"
KEY = "proof_waterfall"
DEFAULT_TEXT = "Hamburgefonstiv 0123"
DEFAULT_SIZES = "10 12 14 18 24 32 48 64 96"


class Waterfall(proof_dialog_type()):
    """Retain the original Proof controls on the shared owned dialog."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original controls and retain only owned native UI resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)
        self.resize(760, 600)
        self.cmap, self.names = {}, set()
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.text = QtGui.QLineEdit(DEFAULT_TEXT)
        self.sizes = QtGui.QLineEdit(DEFAULT_SIZES)
        self.master = QtGui.QComboBox()
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Text"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.text, 0, 1, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Sizes (px)"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.sizes, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Master"), 1, 2)
        form.addWidget(self.master, 1, 3)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 2)
        form.setColumnStretch(3, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.view = WaterfallView()
        self.add_proof_view(self.view, background=True, horizontal_off=True)
        self.add_proof_footer()
        for line in (self.text, self.sizes):
            self._connect(line.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.master.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    def load_initial(self) -> None:
        """Read maps and master choices atomically, preserving the initial active master."""
        cmap, names = font_maps()
        masters = list(self.package.masters) if self.package else []
        active = self.package.master if self.package else ""
        blocked = self.master.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            self.master.clear()
            for name in masters:
                self.master.addItem(name)
            if active in masters:
                self.master.setCurrentIndex(masters.index(active))
        finally:
            self.master.blockSignals(blocked)
        self.cmap, self.names = cmap, names

    @proof_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete bound-font proof for the original controls."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        master = self.master.currentText
        master = master() if callable(master) else master
        self.glyph_names = parse_text(self.text.text, self.cmap, self.names)
        missing = sum(1 for n in self.glyph_names if n is None)
        glyphs = glyph_run(self.package, self.glyph_names, master)
        size_list = parse_sizes(self.sizes.text)
        self.view.set_content(
            glyphs, size_list, self.package.upm, self.package.ascender_value
        )
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"Master {master} · {len(self.glyph_names)} glyphs · advance widths, no kerning. Use /name for unencoded glyphs."
        )
        note = f" · {missing} missing (red boxes)" if missing else ""
        self.status.setText(
            f"Line width {self.view.width_units:g} units · {len(size_list)} sizes{note}"
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry entry with this owned modeless Proof tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(Waterfall, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Find real words to proof with: words the font can set, that use the letters you are working on.

Searches a small embedded English and Latin word list. Keep only words whose every letter has a glyph, require some letters (e.g. the new 'k'), or restrict to a set of letters (e.g. what is drawn so far). Copy the result as proof text. Nothing in the font changes.

Run Proof > Word Finder from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

TITLE = "Word Finder"
KEY = "proof_word_finder"


class WordFinder(proof_dialog_type()):
    """Retain the original Proof controls on the shared owned dialog."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original controls and retain only owned native UI resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        self.resize(600, 520)
        self.available = set()
        self.words = []
        root = self.root
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.must = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.must.setPlaceholderText("e.g. kz")
        self.only = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.only.setPlaceholderText("e.g. hamburgefonstiv (empty = any)")
        self.case = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for label in CASES:
            self.case.addItem(label)
        self.min_len = QtGui.QSpinBox()
        self.min_len.setRange(1, 20)
        self.min_len.setValue(3)
        self.max_len = QtGui.QSpinBox()
        self.max_len.setRange(1, 20)
        self.max_len.setValue(12)
        lengths = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        lengths.addWidget(self.min_len)
        lengths.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("to"))
        lengths.addWidget(self.max_len)
        lengths.addStretch(1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Must contain"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.must, 0, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Case"), 0, 2)
        form.addWidget(self.case, 0, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Only letters"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.only, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Length"), 1, 2)
        form.addLayout(lengths, 1, 3)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.result_view = QtGui.QPlainTextEdit()
        self.result_view.setReadOnly(True)
        bigger = self.result_view.font
        bigger.setPointSizeF(bigger.pointSizeF() * 1.2)
        self.result_view.setFont(bigger)
        root.addWidget(self.result_view, 1)
        self.add_proof_footer(copy_words=True)
        for line in (self.must, self.only):
            self._connect(line.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        for spin in (self.min_len, self.max_len):
            self._connect(spin.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.case.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.copy_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.copy())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.initial_refresh()

    def load_initial(self) -> None:
        """Read encoded characters only after the empty results and Close exist."""
        self.available = font_chars()

    @proof_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete bound-font proof for the original controls."""
        case = CASES[self.case.currentIndex]
        self.words = find_words(
            WORDS,
            self.available,
            case,
            self.must.text.strip(),
            self.only.text.strip(),
            self.min_len.value,
            self.max_len.value,
        )
        if not self.available:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font with encoded glyphs first.")
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(WORDS)} English and Latin words; showing those the font can set with its {len(self.available)} characters."
            )
        self.result_view.setPlainText(" ".join(self.words))
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(self.words))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.words)} word{('s' if len(self.words) != 1 else '')}"
        )

    def copy(self) -> None:
        """Copy exactly the filtered words after checking the bound font snapshot."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText(" ".join(self.words))
        self.status.setText(f"Copied {len(self.words)} words")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace the original registry entry with this owned modeless Proof tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(WordFinder, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.text:
Find bracket-named glyphs and all transitive component dependants.

Scan every glyph and every foreground layer in the current font. A single layer name must contain both [ and ]; this name pattern does not establish export rules. A glyph empty on one master but drawn on others is usually a mistake; spaces are empty on purpose and can be hidden. Each master is a column. Select puts the listed glyphs (or the rows you pick) into the Font window selection. Nothing in the font changes.

docs.title: Source
docs.text:
Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Reports/Empty Glyphs.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Reports · Empty Glyphs
"""List glyphs that have no outlines and no components on some or all masters, and select them.

A glyph empty on one master but drawn on others is usually a mistake;
spaces are empty on purpose and can be hidden. Each master is a column.
Select puts the listed glyphs (or the rows you pick) into the Font window
selection. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

import contextlib
import unicodedata
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package, select_glyphs

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Empty Glyphs"
KEY = "report_empty_glyphs"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def is_empty(layer: Any) -> bool:
    """Nothing drawn: no contours, counting the contours of its components."""
    return not layer.getContours()


def is_whitespace(name: str, codes: list[int]) -> bool:
    """Recognise intentional empty glyphs by Unicode category and conventional names."""
    if any(
        unicodedata.category(chr(c)) in {"Zs", "Zl", "Zp", "Cc", "Cf"} for c in codes
    ):
        return True
    return name in {
        ".notdef",
        ".null",
        "nbspace",
        "space",
        "CR",
        "nonmarkingreturn",
    } or name.endswith("space")


def scan(package: Any, skip_whitespace: bool) -> list[tuple]:
    """[(glyph name, [master, ...] where empty)] in font order."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    masters = list(package.masters)
    out = []
    for fg in font.glyphs:
        if skip_whitespace and is_whitespace(fg.name, list(fg.unicodes)):
            continue
        glyph = package.findName(fg.name)
        if glyph is None:
            continue
        empty = []
        for master in masters:
            layer = glyph.findLayer(master)
            if layer is None or is_empty(layer):
                empty.append(master)
        if empty:
            out.append((fg.name, empty))
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
def muted(widget: Any) -> str:
    """Return a translucent text colour matching the current native palette."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class EmptyGlyphs(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the modeless report with native Qt controls and guarded signals."""
        QtGui.QDialog.__init__(self, parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(TITLE)
        palette = self.palette  # FontLab can pair a light Base with a light Text (seen in dark mode): use WindowText
        palette.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Text, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.setPalette(palette)
        self.setMinimumWidth(520)
        self.resize(560, 460)
        self._connections = []
        self.rows = []
        self.package_id: int | None = None

        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
        self.subtitle.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.subtitle)
        self.skip_whitespace = QtGui.QCheckBox(
            "Hide space-like glyphs (empty on purpose)",
        )
        self.skip_whitespace.setChecked(True)
        root.addWidget(self.skip_whitespace)

        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 1)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.rescan_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Rescan")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select in Font window")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.rescan_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.skip_whitespace.toggled, lambda *a: self.rescan())
        self._connect(self.rescan_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.rescan())
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_rows())
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked,
            lambda row, *a: self.select_rows([row]),
        )
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.rescan()

    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def rescan(self) -> None:
        """Publish selectable rows only after the complete scan and display succeed.

        Invalidate the previous snapshot before native access. Any scan or Qt
        failure clears partial results and leaves explicit selection refused.
        """
        self.package_id = None
        self.rows = []
        try:
            self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            package = current_package()
            if package is None:
                self.rows = []
                self.package_id = None
                self.table.setRowCount(0)
                self.status.setText("No font open.")
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
                self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
                return
            masters = list(package.masters)
            rows = scan(package, self.skip_whitespace.isChecked())
            partial = sum(1 for _, empty in rows if len(empty) < len(masters))
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(rows)} glyph{'s' if len(rows) != 1 else ''} without outlines on at "
                f"least one of {len(masters)} masters; {partial} only on some (likely mistakes).",
            )
            self.table.clear()
            self.table.setColumnCount(1 + len(masters))
            self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Glyph", *masters])
            header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
            header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
            header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
            alert = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
            soft = QtGui.QColor(muted(self))
            self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
            for row, (name, empty) in enumerate(rows):
                self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(name))
                for column, master in enumerate(masters, start=1):
                    item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("empty" if master in empty else "✓")
                    item.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter))
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(alert if master in empty else soft))
                    self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            self.status.setText("Double-click a row to select it.")
            self.rows = rows
            self.package_id = package.id
            self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(rows))
        except Exception:  # Invalidate on any native or Qt failure, then propagate.
            self.package_id = None
            self.rows = []
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                self.table.setRowCount(0)
            raise

    def select_rows(self, rows: list[int] | None = None) -> None:
        """Select chosen report rows, or all rows, only in the scanned font."""
        if rows is None:
            rows = sorted(
                {index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()},
            )
            rows = rows or list(range(len(self.rows)))
        names = [self.rows[r][0] for r in rows if 0 <= r < len(self.rows)]
        if self.package_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Refresh the report with an open font first.")
        selected = select_glyphs(names, package_id=self.package_id)
        self.last_result = {"selected": selected}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(selected)} glyph{'s' if len(selected) != 1 else ''}",
        )

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY)


def main() -> EmptyGlyphs:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(EmptyGlyphs, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.text:
Python source
# this_file: Scripts/Reports/Font Overview.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Reports · Font Overview
"""A one-screen dashboard of the current font: glyphs, encoding, masters, kerning, composites.

Cards show glyph and code point counts, composites, glyphs without
outlines on the current master, marks and notes; the table lists each
master's vertical metrics and kerning pair count. Click Refresh after
editing. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Font Overview"
KEY = "report_font_overview"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access


def component_names(layer: Any) -> list[str]:
    """Base glyph names of the layer's components."""
    names = []
    for shape in layer.shapes:
        base = shape.shapeData.componentGlyph if shape.shapeData is not None else ""
        if base:
            names.append(base)
    return names


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def overview(package: Any) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[tuple]]:
    """{card: value} and [(master, ascender, caps, x-height, descender, kerning pairs)]."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    glyphs = list(font.glyphs)
    masters = list(package.masters)
    current = package.master
    codes = [code for glyph in glyphs for code in glyph.unicodes]
    composites = empty = marked = notes = 0
    for fg in glyphs:
        glyph = package.findName(fg.name)
        if glyph is None:
            continue
        layers = [glyph.findLayer(m) for m in masters]
        layers = [layer for layer in layers if layer is not None]
        if any(component_names(layer) for layer in layers):
            composites += 1
        layer = glyph.findLayer(current)
        if layer is not None and not layer.getContours() and not component_names(layer):
            empty += 1
        marked += 1 if int(glyph.mark or 0) else 0
        notes += 1 if (glyph.note or "").strip() else 0
    cards = {
        "Glyphs": len(glyphs),
        "Encoded glyphs": sum(1 for g in glyphs if list(g.unicodes)),
        "Code points": len(set(codes)),
        "Masters": len(masters),
        "Composites": composites,
        f"Empty on {current}": empty,
        "Marked": marked,
        "With notes": notes,
    }
    rows = []
    for master in masters:
        metrics = fontlab.FontMetrics(package, master)
        rows.append(
            (
                master,
                metrics.ascender,
                metrics.capsHeight,
                metrics.xHeight,
                metrics.descender,
                len(package.kerning(master)),
            ),
        )
    return cards, rows


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
def muted(widget: Any) -> str:
    """Return a translucent text colour matching the current native palette."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class Overview(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the modeless report with native Qt controls and guarded signals."""
        QtGui.QDialog.__init__(self, parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(TITLE)
        palette = self.palette  # FontLab can pair a light Base with a light Text (seen in dark mode): use WindowText
        palette.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Text, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.setPalette(palette)
        self.setMinimumWidth(600)
        self._connections = []
        self.cards, self.rows = {}, []

        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
