    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def card(self, index: int, label: str) -> None:
        """Build a dashboard card for one count in the overview grid."""
        frame = QtGui.QFrame()
        frame.setObjectName("card")
        base = self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Base).name()
        border = self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Mid).name()
        frame.setStyleSheet(
            f"QFrame#card {{ background: {base}; border: 1px solid {border}; border-radius: 8px; }}",
        )
        box = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(frame)
        box.setContentsMargins(12, 10, 12, 10)
        box.setSpacing(2)
        value = QtGui.QLabel("–")
        big = value.font
        big.setPointSizeF(big.pointSizeF() * 1.7)
        big.setBold(True)
        value.setFont(big)
        value.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link).name()}; border: none;",
        )
        caption = QtGui.QLabel(label)
        caption.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)}; border: none;")
        box.addWidget(value)
        box.addWidget(caption)
        self.grid.addWidget(frame, index // 4, index % 4)
        self.card_values[label] = value

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Refresh metrics and clear stale results when no font is open."""
        package = current_package()
        if package is None:
            self.rows = []
            self.package_id = None
            self.table.setRowCount(0)
            self.status.setText("No font open.")
            self.cards = {}
            for value in self.card_values.values():
                value.setText("–")
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        self.cards, self.rows = overview(package)
        if set(self.cards) != set(self.card_values):
            while self.grid.count():
                item = self.grid.takeAt(0)
                if item.widget() is not None:
                    item.widget().deleteLater()
            self.card_values = {}
            for index, label in enumerate(self.cards):
                self.card(index, label)
        for label, value in self.cards.items():
            self.card_values[label].setText(f"{value:,}")
        family = package.info.familyName
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{family} · {int(package.upm)} units per em · current master {package.master}",
        )
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.rows))
        for row, values in enumerate(self.rows):
            for column, value in enumerate(values):
                text = value if column == 0 else f"{value:g}"
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column:
                    item.setTextAlignment(
                        int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                    )
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.status.setText(
            "Composites: a component on any master. Empty: no contours and no components.",
        )

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY)


def main() -> Overview:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(Overview, KEY)

    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Reports/Glyph Table CSV.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""A sortable table of glyphs (name, Unicode, width per master, contours, components) with CSV export.

Pick all glyphs or the selection, review the table, then export it as a
UTF-8 CSV file (choose the path first) or copy it to the clipboard for a
spreadsheet. Contours count everything drawn, components included, on the
current master. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

import csv
import io
import pathlib
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package

fontlab = ap.fontlab
(QtCore, QtGui) = (qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui)
TITLE = "Glyph Table CSV"
KEY = "report_glyph_table_csv"


def selected_names() -> Any:
    """Glyph names selected in the Font window, in font order."""
    try:
        FL = ap.FL
        font = FL.fl.font
        return [font[i].name for i in range(len(font)) if FL.fl.Selected(i)]
    except (AttributeError, RuntimeError, TypeError):
        return []


def component_names(layer: Any) -> Any:
    """Return component base names in the layer shape order."""
    names = []
    for shape in layer.shapes:
        base = shape.shapeData.componentGlyph if shape.shapeData is not None else ""
        if base:
            names.append(base)
    return names


def table(package: Any, names: Any) -> Any:
    """(header, rows) with one row per glyph; widths per master, counts on the current master."""
    masters = list(package.masters)
    header = (
        ["glyph", "unicode"]
        + [f"width {m}" for m in masters]
        + ["contours", "components"]
    )
    rows = []
    for name in names:
        glyph = package.findName(name)
        if glyph is None:
            continue
        codes = " ".join(f"{c:04X}" for c in glyph.fgGlyph.unicodes)
        widths = []
        for master in masters:
            layer = glyph.findLayer(master)
            widths.append(round(layer.advanceWidth, 2) if layer is not None else "")
        layer = glyph.findLayer(package.master)
        contours = len(layer.getContours()) if layer is not None else 0
        components = " ".join(component_names(layer)) if layer is not None else ""
        rows.append([name, codes, *widths, contours, components])
    return (header, rows)


def to_csv(header: Any, rows: Any) -> Any:
    """Encode report rows with standard CSV quoting and LF line endings."""
    buffer = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(buffer, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(header)
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return buffer.getvalue()


def write_csv(path: Any, header: Any, rows: Any) -> Any:
    """Write the CSV (UTF-8 with BOM so spreadsheets detect it); returns the byte size."""
    pathlib.Path(path).write_text(
        to_csv(header, rows), encoding="utf-8-sig", newline=""
    )
    return pathlib.Path(path).stat().st_size


def muted(widget: Any) -> Any:
    """Muted."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class GlyphTable(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original modeless report controls and connect owned signals."""
        QtGui.QDialog.__init__(self, parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(TITLE)
        palette = self.palette
        palette.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Text, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.setPalette(palette)
        self.setMinimumWidth(640)
        self.resize(720, 600)
        self._connections = []
        self.package = current_package()
        self.selection = selected_names() if self.package else []
        (self.header, self.rows) = ([], [])
        self.chooser = None
        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
        self.subtitle.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.subtitle)
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem("All glyphs")
        self.scope.addItem(f"Selected glyphs ({len(self.selection)})")
        self.path = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.path.setPlaceholderText("Choose where to save the CSV…")
        self.choose_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Choose…")
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyphs"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.scope, 0, 1, 1, 2)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("File"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.path, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(self.choose_button, 1, 2)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 0)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.copy_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy CSV")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.export_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Export")
        self.export_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)

        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.scope.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.path.textChanged, lambda *a: self.update_buttons())
        self._connect(self.choose_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.choose())

        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        if len(self.selection) > 1:
            self.scope.setCurrentIndex(1)
        self.refresh()

    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Any) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild the current snapshot and publish it only after display succeeds."""
        self.package_id = None
        self.header = []
        self.rows = []
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.export_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        try:
            self.package = current_package()
            self.selection = selected_names() if self.package else []
            if self.package is None:
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
                return
            font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
            names = (
                [g.name for g in font.glyphs]
                if self.scope.currentIndex == 0
                else self.selection
            )
            (result_header, result_rows) = table(self.package, names)
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(result_rows)} glyphs · widths for {len(self.package.masters)} masters · contours and components on {self.package.master}. Click a header to sort."
            )
            self.table.setSortingEnabled(False)
            self.table.clear()
            self.table.setColumnCount(len(result_header))
            self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(result_header)
            self.table.setRowCount(len(result_rows))
            for row, values in enumerate(result_rows):
                for column, value in enumerate(values):
                    item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem()
                    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                        item.setData(QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole, value)
                        item.setTextAlignment(
                            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
                        )
                    else:
                        item.setText(str(value))
                    self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
            header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
            header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
            self.table.setSortingEnabled(True)
            self.export_button.setEnabled(
                bool(result_rows) and bool(self.path.text.strip())
            )
            self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(result_rows))
            if not self.path.text.strip():
                self.status.setText("Choose a file to export, or copy the CSV.")
            self.header = result_header
            self.rows = result_rows
            self.package_id = self.package.id
        except Exception:
            self.package_id = None
            self.header = []
            self.rows = []
            self.copy_button.setEnabled(False)
            self.export_button.setEnabled(False)
            self.table.setRowCount(0)
            raise

    def update_buttons(self) -> None:
        """Enable export only when computed rows and a destination exist."""
        self.export_button.setEnabled(bool(self.rows) and bool(self.path.text.strip()))
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(self.rows))
        if not self.path.text.strip():
            self.status.setText("Choose a file to export, or copy the CSV.")

    def choose(self) -> None:
        """Non-modal save dialog; the chosen path lands in the File field."""
        if self.chooser is not None:
            self.chooser.close()
        self.chooser = QtGui.QFileDialog(
            self,
            "Export glyph table",
            self.path.text or "glyphs.csv",
            "CSV files (*.csv)",
        )
        self.chooser.setAcceptMode(QtGui.QFileDialog.AcceptSave)
        self.chooser.setDefaultSuffix("csv")
        self._connect(
            self.chooser.fileSelected, lambda path, *a: self.path.setText(path)
        )
        self.chooser.open()

    def copy(self) -> None:
        """Copy the complete computed CSV snapshot to the clipboard."""
        QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText(to_csv(self.header, self.rows))
        self.status.setText(f"Copied {len(self.rows)} rows")

    def export(self, path: Any = None) -> Any:
        """Write the computed snapshot to the chosen UTF-8 CSV file."""
        path = path or self.path.text.strip()
        size = write_csv(path, self.header, self.rows)
        self.last_result = {"path": path, "rows": len(self.rows), "bytes": size}
        self.status.setText(f"Wrote {len(self.rows)} rows to {pathlib.Path(path).name}")
        return path

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(
            self,
            event,
            KEY,
            children=(self.chooser,) if self.chooser is not None else (),
        )
        self.chooser = None


def main() -> Any:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(GlyphTable, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Reports/Label Statistics.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Count glyphs by mark colour and by name suffix (.sc, .ss01, .loclPLK…); click a row to select them.

Two lists side by side give a quick census of a big font's working labels
and alternate sets. Clicking a row selects those glyphs in the Font window
(hold Add to extend the selection). Nothing in the font changes.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package, select_glyphs

fontlab = ap.fontlab
(QtCore, QtGui) = (qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui)
TITLE = "Label Statistics"
KEY = "report_label_statistics"
HUES = [
    (15, "red"),
    (45, "orange"),
    (70, "yellow"),
    (160, "green"),
    (200, "teal"),
    (255, "blue"),
    (290, "purple"),
    (335, "pink"),
    (361, "red"),
]


def selected_names() -> list[str]:
    """Read the current selection for the explicit Add interaction."""
    font = ap.FL.fl.font
    return [font[i].name for i in range(len(font)) if ap.FL.fl.Selected(i)]


def font_labels() -> Any:
    """[(glyph name, mark)] of the current font, in font order."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    return [(g.name, int(g.mark or 0)) for g in font.glyphs] if font is not None else []


def suffix_of(name: Any) -> Any:
    """'.ss01.sc' for 'a.ss01.sc'; '' for 'a' and '.notdef'."""
    (_head, dot, tail) = name[1:].partition(".")
    return "." + tail if dot else ""


def mark_color(mark: Any, lightness: Any = 150) -> Any:
    """Resolve a FontLab colour flag to its native swatch colour."""
    if mark <= 0:
        return None
    if mark <= 360:
        return QtGui.QColor.fromHsl(mark - 1, 200, lightness)
    grey = min(255, lightness // 2 + max(0, mark - 1000) // 2)
    return QtGui.QColor(grey, grey, grey)


def mark_label(mark: Any) -> Any:
    """Describe FontLab colour marks using the original hue buckets."""
    if mark <= 0:
        return "Unmarked"
    if mark > 360:
        return f"Grey {mark - 1000}"
    hue = mark - 1
    return (
        next(name for (limit, name) in HUES if hue < limit).capitalize()
        + f" (hue {hue}°)"
    )


def statistics(labels: Any) -> Any:
    """([(mark, [names])], [(suffix, [names])]) sorted by count, largest first."""
    (marks, suffixes) = ({}, {})
    for name, mark in labels:
        marks.setdefault(mark, []).append(name)
        suffixes.setdefault(suffix_of(name), []).append(name)

    def order(item: Any) -> Any:
        """Order."""
        return (-len(item[1]), str(item[0]))

    return (sorted(marks.items(), key=order), sorted(suffixes.items(), key=order))


def muted(widget: Any) -> Any:
    """Muted."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


def swatch(mark: Any, size: Any = 14) -> Any:
    """Draw a small mark icon and always release the native painter."""
    pixmap = QtGui.QPixmap(size, size)
    pixmap.fill(QtGui.QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
    painter = QtGui.QPainter(pixmap)
    try:
        painter.setRenderHint(QtGui.QPainter.Antialiasing)
        color = mark_color(mark)
        if color is None:
            painter.setPen(
                QtGui.QPen(
                    QtGui.QBrush(QtGui.QColor(128, 128, 128)), 1.0, QtCore.Qt.DashLine
                )
            )
            painter.drawRoundedRect(QtCore.QRectF(1, 1, size - 2, size - 2), 3, 3)
        else:
            painter.setPen(QtCore.Qt.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QtGui.QBrush(color))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(QtCore.QRectF(0, 0, size, size), 3, 3)
    finally:
        painter.end()
    return QtGui.QIcon(pixmap)


def make_table(first: Any) -> Any:
    """Build a read-only statistics table with a stretched label column."""
    table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 2)
    table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([first, "Glyphs"])
    table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
    table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
    table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
    table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SingleSelection)
    table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
    table.setShowGrid(False)
    header = table.horizontalHeader()
    header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
    header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
    table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
    return table


class LabelStatistics(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original modeless report controls and connect owned signals."""
        QtGui.QDialog.__init__(self, parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(TITLE)
        palette = self.palette
        palette.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Text, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.setPalette(palette)
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)
        self.resize(680, 520)
        self._connections = []
        (self.marks, self.suffixes) = ([], [])
        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
        self.subtitle.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.subtitle)
        columns = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        columns.setSpacing(12)
        self.mark_table = make_table("Mark colour")
        self.mark_table.setIconSize(QtCore.QSize(14, 14))
        self.suffix_table = make_table("Name suffix")
        columns.addWidget(self.mark_table, 1)
        columns.addWidget(self.suffix_table, 1)
        root.addLayout(columns, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.add = QtGui.QCheckBox("Add to selection")
        self.refresh_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Refresh")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.add)
        footer.addWidget(self.refresh_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(
            self.mark_table.cellClicked,
            lambda row, *a: self.select_group(self.marks, row),
        )
        self._connect(
            self.suffix_table.cellClicked,
            lambda row, *a: self.select_group(self.suffixes, row),
        )
        self._connect(self.refresh_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()

    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Any) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def fill(self, table: Any, groups: Any, label_of: Any, icon_of: Any = None) -> None:
        """Populate one statistics table with group labels, counts and swatches."""
        table.setRowCount(len(groups))
        for row, (key, names) in enumerate(groups):
            label = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(label_of(key))
            if icon_of is not None:
                label.setIcon(icon_of(key))
            count = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(str(len(names)))
            count.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter))
            table.setItem(row, 0, label)
            table.setItem(row, 1, count)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild the current snapshot and publish it only after display succeeds."""
        self.package_id = None
        self.marks = []
        self.suffixes = []
        self.mark_table.setRowCount(0)
        self.suffix_table.setRowCount(0)
        try:
            package = current_package()
            if package is None:
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
                return
            labels = font_labels()
            (result_marks, result_suffixes) = statistics(labels)
            if not labels:
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            else:
                marked = sum(len(n) for (m, n) in result_marks if m)
                suffixed = sum(len(n) for (s, n) in result_suffixes if s)
                self.subtitle.setText(
                    f"{len(labels)} glyphs: {marked} marked in {sum(1 for (m, _) in result_marks if m)} colours, {suffixed} with a suffix in {sum(1 for (s, _) in result_suffixes if s)} sets. Click a row to select those glyphs."
                )
            self.fill(self.mark_table, result_marks, mark_label, swatch)
            self.fill(self.suffix_table, result_suffixes, lambda s: s or "(no suffix)")
            self.status.setText("")
            self.marks = result_marks
            self.suffixes = result_suffixes
            self.package_id = package.id
        except Exception:
            self.package_id = None
            self.marks = []
            self.suffixes = []
            self.mark_table.setRowCount(0)
            self.suffix_table.setRowCount(0)
            raise

    def select_group(self, groups: Any, row: Any) -> None:
        """Select a mark or suffix group, optionally preserving current selection."""
        if self.package_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Refresh the report before selecting glyphs.")
        package = current_package()
        if package is None or package.id != self.package_id:
            raise ValueError("stale font: Refresh the report.")
        if not 0 <= row < len(groups):
            return
        (key, names) = groups[row]
        selected = select_glyphs(
            list(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (selected_names() if self.add.isChecked() else []) + list(names)
                )
            ),
            package_id=self.package_id,
        )
        self.last_result = {"group": key, "selected": selected}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(selected)} glyph{('s' if len(selected) != 1 else '')}"
        )

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY)


def main() -> Any:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(LabelStatistics, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# this_file: Scripts/Reports/Live Glyph Info.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""A live panel for the glyph you are working on: widths, side-bearings, bounds and counts per master.

It follows the first glyph selected in the Font window (or the glyph being
edited) and re-reads it twice a second, so edits show up as you make them.
Values that differ between masters stand out. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package

fontlab = ap.fontlab
(QtCore, QtGui) = (qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui)
TITLE = "Glyph Info Live"
KEY = "report_glyph_info_live"
POLL_MS = 500
COLUMNS = [
    "Master",
    "Width",
    "LSB",
    "RSB",
    "Bounds (x, y, w, h)",
    "Contours",
    "Nodes",
    "Components",
    "Anchors",
]


def focused_name() -> Any:
    """First glyph selected in the Font window, else the current glyph."""
    try:
        FL = ap.FL
        font = FL.fl.font
        for i in range(len(font)):
            if FL.fl.Selected(i):
                return font[i].name
    except (AttributeError, RuntimeError, TypeError):
        pass
    glyph = fontlab.CurrentGlyph()
    return glyph.name if glyph is not None else None


def component_names(layer: Any) -> Any:
    """Return component base names in the layer shape order."""
    names = []
    for shape in layer.shapes:
        base = shape.shapeData.componentGlyph if shape.shapeData is not None else ""
        if base:
            names.append(base)
    return names


def layer_info(layer: Any) -> Any:
    """[width, lsb, rsb, bounds, contours, nodes, components, anchors] for one layer (display strings)."""
    box = layer.boundingBox
    width = layer.advanceWidth
    contours = layer.getContours()
    drawn = box.width() > 0 or box.height() > 0
    lsb = f"{box.x():g}" if drawn else "–"
    rsb = f"{width - box.x() - box.width():g}" if drawn else "–"
    bounds = (
        f"{box.x():g}, {box.y():g}, {box.width():g}, {box.height():g}"
        if drawn
        else "empty"
    )
    nodes = sum(len(c.nodes()) for c in contours)
    components = ", ".join(component_names(layer)) or "–"
    return [
        f"{width:g}",
        lsb,
        rsb,
        bounds,
        str(len(contours)),
        str(nodes),
        components,
        str(len(layer.anchors)),
    ]


def glyph_info(package: Any, name: Any) -> Any:
    """[(master, values)] for every master of the glyph."""
    glyph = package.findName(name)
    if glyph is None:
        return []
    rows = []
    for master in package.masters:
        layer = glyph.findLayer(master)
        if layer is not None:
            rows.append((master, layer_info(layer)))
    return rows


def muted(widget: Any) -> Any:
    """Muted."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class GlyphInfoLive(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original modeless report controls and connect owned signals."""
        QtGui.QDialog.__init__(self, parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(TITLE)
        palette = self.palette
        palette.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Text, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.setPalette(palette)
        self.setMinimumWidth(680)
        self.resize(760, 300)
        self._connections = []
        (self.shown_name, self.rows) = (None, [])
        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
        self.subtitle.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.subtitle)
        self.glyph_label = QtGui.QLabel()
        big = self.glyph_label.font
        big.setPointSizeF(big.pointSizeF() * 1.6)
        big.setBold(True)
        self.glyph_label.setFont(big)
        self.glyph_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link).name()};"
        )
        root.addWidget(self.glyph_label)
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(COLUMNS)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(4, QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(7, QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.pause = QtGui.QCheckBox("Pause")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.pause)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self.timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.timer.setInterval(POLL_MS)
        self._connect(self.timer.timeout, lambda *a: self.poll())
        self._connect(
            self.pause.toggled,
            lambda checked, *a: self.timer.stop() if checked else self.timer.start(),
        )
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()
        self.timer.start()

    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Any) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def poll(self) -> None:
        """Refresh from the current font on each timer tick."""
        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self, name: Any = None) -> None:
        """Rebuild the current snapshot and publish it only after display succeeds."""
        self.package_id = None
        self.shown_name = None
        self.rows = []
        self.glyph_label.setText("–")
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        try:
            package = current_package()
            name = name or (focused_name() if package else None)
            rows = glyph_info(package, name) if package and name else []
            (result_shown_name, result_rows) = (name, rows)
            if package is None or not rows:
                self.glyph_label.setText("–")
                self.subtitle.setText(
                    "Open a font and select a glyph."
                    if package is None
                    else "Select a glyph in the Font window."
                )
                self.table.setRowCount(0)
                return
            codes = " ".join(
                f"U+{c:04X}" for c in package.findName(name).fgGlyph.unicodes
            )
            self.glyph_label.setText(f"{name}  {codes}")
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"Follows the Font window selection · refreshes every {POLL_MS} ms · values that differ between masters are highlighted."
            )
            accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
            self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
            for row, (master, values) in enumerate(rows):
                self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(master))
                for column, text in enumerate(values, start=1):
                    item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                    if column in {1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8}:
                        item.setTextAlignment(
                            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
                        )
                    if (
                        column in {5, 6, 7}
                        and len({v[column - 1] for (_, v) in rows}) > 1
                    ):
                        item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(accent))
                    self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            self.status.setText(
                f"Updated {QtCore.QTime.currentTime().toString('HH:mm:ss')}"
            )
            self.shown_name = result_shown_name
            self.rows = result_rows
            self.package_id = package.id
        except Exception:
            self.package_id = None
            self.shown_name = None
            self.rows = []
            self.glyph_label.setText("–")
            self.table.setRowCount(0)
            raise

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY, timers=(self.timer,))


def main() -> Any:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(GlyphInfoLive, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Near misses (y = 687 when the cap height is 688) are almost always slips of the mouse; real overshoots are further away and pass. Checks baseline, x-height, cap height, ascender and descender of every master. Select the glyphs to fix them. Nothing in the font changes.

# this_file: Scripts/Reports/Nodes Near Zones.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Find on-curve nodes that sit within a few units of a vertical metric but not on it.

Near misses (y = 687 when the cap height is 688) are almost always slips
of the mouse; real overshoots are further away and pass. Checks baseline,
x-height, cap height, ascender and descender of every master. Select the
glyphs to fix them. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package, select_glyphs

fontlab = ap.fontlab
(QtCore, QtGui) = (qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui)
TITLE = "Nodes Near Zones"
KEY = "report_nodes_near_zones"


def selected_names() -> Any:
    """Return selected Font window glyph names in font order."""
    try:
        FL = ap.FL
        font = FL.fl.font
        return [font[i].name for i in range(len(font)) if FL.fl.Selected(i)]
    except (AttributeError, RuntimeError, TypeError):
        return []


def master_metrics(package: Any, master: Any) -> Any:
    """[(label, y)] vertical metrics of one master."""
    m = fontlab.FontMetrics(package, master)
    return [
        ("baseline", 0.0),
        ("x-height", m.xHeight),
        ("cap height", m.capsHeight),
        ("ascender", m.ascender),
        ("descender", m.descender),
    ]


def on_curve_points(layer: Any) -> Any:
    """[(x, y)] of the layer's own on-curve nodes with each shape's transform applied."""
    points = []
    for shape in layer.shapes:
        if shape.shapeData is not None and shape.shapeData.componentGlyph:
            continue
        transform = shape.transform
        for contour in shape.getContours():
            for node in contour.nodes():
                if node.isOn():
                    p = transform.map(QtCore.QPointF(node.x, node.y))
                    points.append((p.x(), p.y()))
    return points


def near_misses(points: Any, metrics: Any, tolerance: Any) -> Any:
    """[(label, metric y, node x, node y)] for points with 0 < |y - metric| <= tolerance."""
    out = []
    for x, y in points:
        for label, value in metrics:
            delta = y - value
            if 0 < abs(delta) <= tolerance:
                out.append((label, value, x, y))
    return out


def scan(package: Any, names: Any, tolerance: Any) -> Any:
    """[(glyph, master, metric label, metric y, node x, node y)]."""
    masters = list(package.masters)
    metrics = {m: master_metrics(package, m) for m in masters}
    rows = []
    for name in names:
        glyph = package.findName(name)
        if glyph is None:
            continue
        for master in masters:
            layer = glyph.findLayer(master)
            if layer is None:
                continue
            rows.extend(
                (name, master, *hit)
                for hit in near_misses(
                    on_curve_points(layer), metrics[master], tolerance
                )
            )
    return rows


def muted(widget: Any) -> Any:
    """Muted."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class NodesNearZones(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original modeless report controls and connect owned signals."""

        self._connections = []
        self.rows = []

        self.selection = selected_names() if self.package else []
        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
        self.subtitle.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.subtitle)
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.scope = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.scope.addItem(f"Selected glyphs ({len(self.selection)})")
        self.scope.addItem("All glyphs")

        form.addWidget(self.scope, 0, 1)

        form.addWidget(self.tolerance, 0, 3)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 5)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Glyph · master", "Metric", "Node", "y", "Off by"]
        )
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()

        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.rescan_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Rescan")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select glyphs")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.rescan_button)

        )
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        if not self.selection:
            self.scope.setCurrentIndex(1)
        self.rescan()

    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Any) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def rescan(self) -> None:
        """Scan the current font and publish results only after display succeeds."""
        self.package_id = None
        self.rows = []
        self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        try:
            self.package = current_package()
            self.selection = selected_names() if self.package else []
            if self.package is None:
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
                self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
                return
            font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
            names = (
                self.selection
                if self.scope.currentIndex == 0
                else [g.name for g in font.glyphs]
            )
            tolerance = self.tolerance.value
            result_rows = scan(self.package, names, tolerance)
            glyphs = sorted({r[0] for r in result_rows})
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(names)} glyphs × {len(self.package.masters)} masters checked: on-curve nodes 1–{tolerance} units off baseline, x-height, cap height, ascender or descender."
            )
            alert = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
            self.table.setRowCount(len(result_rows))
            for row, (name, master, label, value, x, y) in enumerate(result_rows):
                cells = [
                    f"{name} · {master}",
                    f"{label} {value:g}",
                    f"{x:g}, {y:g}",
                    f"{y:g}",
                    f"{y - value:+g}",
                ]
                for column, text in enumerate(cells):
                    item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                    if column >= 2:
                        item.setTextAlignment(
                            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
                        )
                    if column == 4:
                        item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(alert))
                    self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(result_rows))
            self.status.setText(
                f"{len(result_rows)} near miss{('es' if len(result_rows) != 1 else '')} in {len(glyphs)} glyph{('s' if len(glyphs) != 1 else '')}"
            )
            self.rows = result_rows
            self.package_id = self.package.id
        except Exception:
            self.package_id = None
            self.rows = []
            self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            self.table.setRowCount(0)
            raise

    def select_rows(self, rows: Any = None) -> None:
        """Select requested report rows only in the font that produced them."""
        if self.package_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Refresh the report before selecting glyphs.")
        package = current_package()
        if package is None or package.id != self.package_id:
            raise ValueError("stale font: Refresh the report.")
        if rows is None:
            rows = sorted(
                {index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()}
            )
            rows = rows or list(range(len(self.rows)))
        names = [self.rows[r][0] for r in rows if 0 <= r < len(self.rows)]
        selected = select_glyphs(names, package_id=self.package_id)
        self.last_result = {"selected": selected}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(selected)} glyph{('s' if len(selected) != 1 else '')}"
        )

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY)


def main() -> Any:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(NodesNearZones, KEY)

# this_file: Scripts/Reports/Open Contours.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Reports · Open Contours
"""Find open contours on every master and select the glyphs that have them.

Open paths are usually unintended in a font for filling: they render
unpredictably and break overlap removal. Each row is one open contour with
its master, node count and the gap between its end points. Nothing in the
font changes.
"""

import contextlib
import math
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import current_package, select_glyphs

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Open Contours"
KEY = "report_open_contours"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def scan(package: Any) -> list[tuple]:
    """[(glyph, master, contour index, node count, gap)] for every open contour, font order."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    masters = list(package.masters)
    out = []
    for fg in font.glyphs:
        glyph = package.findName(fg.name)
        if glyph is None:
            continue
        for master in masters:
            layer = glyph.findLayer(master)
            if layer is None:
                continue
            for index, contour in enumerate(layer.getContours()):
                if contour.closed:
                    continue
                nodes = contour.nodes()
                gap = 0.0
                if len(nodes) > 1:
                    first, last = nodes[0], nodes[len(nodes) - 1]
                    gap = math.hypot(last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y)
                out.append((fg.name, master, index, len(nodes), round(gap, 1)))
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
def muted(widget: Any) -> str:
    """Return a translucent text colour matching the current native palette."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class OpenContours(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the modeless report with native Qt controls and guarded signals."""
        QtGui.QDialog.__init__(self, parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(TITLE)
        palette = self.palette  # FontLab can pair a light Base with a light Text (seen in dark mode): use WindowText
        palette.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Text, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.setPalette(palette)
        self.setMinimumWidth(500)
        self.resize(540, 440)
        self._connections = []
        self.rows = []
        self.package_id: int | None = None

        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
        self.subtitle.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.subtitle)

        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 5)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Glyph", "Master", "Contour", "Nodes", "End gap"],
        )
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.rescan_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Rescan")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select glyphs")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.rescan_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.rescan_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.rescan())
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_rows())
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked,
            lambda row, *a: self.select_rows([row]),
        )
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.rescan()

    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def rescan(self) -> None:
        """Publish selectable rows only after the complete scan and display succeed.

        Invalidate the previous snapshot before native access. Any scan or Qt
        failure clears partial results and leaves explicit selection refused.
        """
        self.package_id = None
        self.rows = []
        try:
            self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            package = current_package()
            if package is None:
                self.rows = []
                self.package_id = None
                self.table.setRowCount(0)
                self.status.setText("No font open.")
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
                self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
                return
            rows = scan(package)
            glyphs = sorted({r[0] for r in rows})
            if rows:
                self.subtitle.setText(
                    f"{len(rows)} open contour{'s' if len(rows) != 1 else ''} in "
                    f"{len(glyphs)} glyph{'s' if len(glyphs) != 1 else ''} across "
                    f"{len(package.masters)} masters.",
                )
            else:
                self.subtitle.setText(
                    f"No open contours on any of {len(package.masters)} masters.",
                )
            alert = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
            self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
            for row, values in enumerate(rows):
                for column, value in enumerate(values):
                    item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(
                        str(value) if column != 2 else f"#{value + 1}",
                    )
                    if column >= 2:
                        item.setTextAlignment(
                            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                        )
                    if column == 4 and value > 0:
                        item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(alert))
                    self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            self.status.setText(
                "Double-click a row to select that glyph." if rows else "",
            )
            self.rows = rows
            self.package_id = package.id
            self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(rows))
        except Exception:  # Invalidate on any native or Qt failure, then propagate.
            self.package_id = None
            self.rows = []
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                self.table.setRowCount(0)
            raise

    def select_rows(self, rows: list[int] | None = None) -> None:
        """Select chosen report rows, or all rows, only in the scanned font."""
        if rows is None:
            rows = sorted(
                {index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()},
            )
            rows = rows or list(range(len(self.rows)))
        names = [self.rows[r][0] for r in rows if 0 <= r < len(self.rows)]
        if self.package_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Refresh the report with an open font first.")
        selected = select_glyphs(names, package_id=self.package_id)
        self.last_result = {"selected": selected}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(selected)} glyph{'s' if len(selected) != 1 else ''}",
        )

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY)


def main() -> OpenContours:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(OpenContours, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.title: Point Counter
docs.text:
Count own contour nodes in all foreground layers of selected glyphs.

Select glyphs in a Font window or occurrences in a Glyph window, then run this Reports command. Each selected occurrence emits its glyph's complete foreground layer list in stored order, including auxiliary and empty layers. Repeated selections remain repeated. Components are not decomposed. Masks and service layers are background/cache records and are excluded explicitly.

Each row shows points, lines, curves, offcurves and paths. The original '?' marker compares a row's total with the previous two rows. Quadratic on-curves now count as curves, correcting the source's omission from point totals. Refresh replaces the complete snapshot. Select and copy report text normally. Close removes the owned modeless panel. This adaptation uses an owned report instead of clearing/writing the user's Output panel; no font, selection, history or preference writers are called. Native getter preservation, layer mapping, selection order/focus and lifecycle acceptance are pending.

Requires reviewed App>=0.2.35.dev1 and fontlab-fly in FontLab9 Python3.11. Adapted from Alex Slobzheninov's Apache-2.0 Point Counter. See NOTICE and additional-tools.json for source identity and full license provenance.

Run Reports > Point Counter from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

def font_codes() -> Any:
    """{code point: glyph name} of the current font (first glyph wins)."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    out = {}
    for glyph in font.glyphs if font is not None else []:
        for code in glyph.unicodes:
            out.setdefault(code, glyph.name)
    return out


def assigned(start: Any, end: Any) -> Any:
    """Number of assigned characters (not Cn) in a range."""
    return sum(
        1 for code in range(start, end + 1) if unicodedata.category(chr(code)) != "Cn"
    )


def coverage(codes: Any, show_all: Any = False) -> Any:
    """[(start, end, block, covered, assigned)] for blocks the font touches (or all blocks)."""
    (rows, outside) = ([], set(codes))
    for start, end, name in BLOCKS:
        inside = [c for c in codes if start <= c <= end]
        outside.difference_update(inside)
        if inside or show_all:
            rows.append((start, end, name, len(inside), assigned(start, end)))
    return (rows, sorted(outside))


def muted(widget: Any) -> Any:
    """Muted."""
    color = QtGui.QColor(widget.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
    color.setAlpha(150)
    return color.name(QtGui.QColor.HexArgb)


class Coverage(QtGui.QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build the original modeless report controls and connect owned signals."""
        QtGui.QDialog.__init__(self, parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(TITLE)
        palette = self.palette
        palette.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Text, palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.WindowText))
        self.setPalette(palette)
        self.setMinimumWidth(600)
        self.resize(640, 520)
        self._connections = []
        self.rows = []
        self.codes = {}
        root = QtGui.QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)
        heading = QtGui.QLabel(TITLE)
        font = heading.font
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * 1.35)
        font.setBold(True)
        heading.setFont(font)
        root.addWidget(heading)
        self.subtitle = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.subtitle.setWordWrap(True)
        self.subtitle.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.subtitle)
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Block", "Range", "Coverage", "Glyphs"])
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(2, QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.show_all = QtGui.QCheckBox("Show untouched blocks")
        self.refresh_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Refresh")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.show_all)
        footer.addWidget(self.refresh_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)
        self._connect(self.show_all.toggled, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.refresh_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked, lambda row, *a: self.select_block(row)
        )
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()

    def _connect(self, signal: Any, slot: Any) -> None:
        """Connect through the shared guarded native lifecycle."""
        ap.scripting.connect_guarded(self, signal, slot)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild the current snapshot and publish it only after display succeeds."""
        self.package_id = None
        self.codes = {}
        self.rows = []
        self.outside = []
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        try:
            package = current_package()
            if package is None:
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
                return
            result_codes = font_codes()
            (result_rows, result_outside) = coverage(
                list(result_codes), self.show_all.isChecked()
            )
            if not result_codes:
                self.subtitle.setText("Open a font with encoded glyphs first.")
            else:
                full = sum(1 for r in result_rows if r[3] and r[3] >= r[4])
                self.subtitle.setText(
                    f"{len(result_codes)} code points in {sum(1 for r in result_rows if r[3])} blocks; {full} complete. Double-click a block to select its glyphs."
                )
            self.table.setRowCount(len(result_rows))
            for row, (start, end, name, covered, total) in enumerate(result_rows):
                self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(name))
                span = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(f"{start:04X}–{end:04X}")
                span.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(QtGui.QColor(muted(self))))
                self.table.setItem(row, 1, span)
                bar = QtGui.QProgressBar()
                bar.setRange(0, max(1, total))
                bar.setValue(min(covered, max(1, total)))
                bar.setTextVisible(True)
                bar.setFormat(f"{100.0 * covered / total:.0f}%" if total else "–")
                bar.setMaximumHeight(16)
                self.table.setCellWidget(row, 2, bar)
                count = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(f"{covered} / {total}")
                count.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
                )
                self.table.setItem(row, 3, count)
            extra = (
                f" · {len(result_outside)} code points outside planes 0–1"
                if result_outside
                else ""
            )
            self.status.setText(f"{len(result_rows)} blocks listed{extra}")
            self.codes = result_codes
            self.rows = result_rows
            self.outside = result_outside
            self.package_id = package.id
        except Exception:
            self.package_id = None
            self.codes = {}
            self.rows = []
            self.outside = []
            self.table.setRowCount(0)
            raise

    def select_block(self, row: Any) -> None:
        """Select encoded glyphs in the requested block of the scanned font."""
        if self.package_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Refresh the report before selecting glyphs.")
        package = current_package()
        if package is None or package.id != self.package_id:
            raise ValueError("stale font: Refresh the report.")
        if not 0 <= row < len(self.rows):
            return
        (start, end, name) = self.rows[row][:3]
        names = [glyph for (code, glyph) in self.codes.items() if start <= code <= end]
        selected = select_glyphs(names, package_id=self.package_id)
        self.last_result = {"block": name, "selected": selected}
        self.status.setText(
            f"{name}: selected {len(selected)} glyph{('s' if len(selected) != 1 else '')}"
        )

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Release the owned report and its connections."""
        ap.scripting.close_script_dialog(self, event, KEY)


def main() -> Any:
    """Show the persistent modeless report."""
    return ap.scripting.show_script_dialog(Coverage, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

docs.title: Vertical Metrics Reporter
docs.text:
Compare eight stored vertical metrics across every open font and master.

Open the fonts to compare, then run this Reports command. The complete report compares typoAscender, typoDescender, typoLineGap, hheaAscender, hheaDescender, hheaLineGap, winDescent and winAscent in source order. Equal values receive a check mark; differences list every document/master and its value, in stored order. An unset hhea override is None, distinct from an explicit zero.

FontLab mapping uses master ascender/descender/lineGap, otherData hhea fields, safeBottom and safeTop. This compares stored native settings; exported or automatically derived metrics are outside its claim. No active-master switch is used. No open fonts, unreadable data, deadline or changing source produces a partial report. Native serialization/schema/order and complete preservation qualification remain pending.

Refresh replaces the entire snapshot. Select and copy text normally. Close removes this owned modeless panel. This presentation replaces the source's Output clearing; no font, history, selection, preference or Output writer is called. Requires reviewed App>=0.2.37.dev0 and Fly in FontLab9 Python3.11. Adapted from Pedro Arilla's Apache-2.0 Vertical metrics reporter.py; provenance and license are retained in NOTICE and additional-tools.json.

Run Reports > Vertical Metrics Reporter from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.

docs.title: Why You Not Compatible
docs.text:
Report original structural differences across selected glyph layers.

Select glyphs in a Font window or occurrences in a Glyph window. Run this Reports command. Every selected occurrence retains its own complete foreground layer list: masters first, then auxiliary layers. Repeated glyph groups remain repeated; mask/service layers are background/cache records.

Compare adjacent layers for path counts, ordered node counts/types, anchor-name sets and component-name sets. Coordinates, transforms, component multiplicity, path closure, hints and styles are outside these original checks. A compatible message therefore is not a variable-font/export certificate. Native cubic and quadratic endpoint types and closed-path node indexes follow the bridge mapping.

Refresh replaces the complete report or diagnoses failure without a valid prefix. Close releases the owned modeless panel. Source label/global-short-circuit bugs are repaired; name sets print deterministically. No Output panel is cleared, and no font/selection/master/history/preference writer is called. Actual native mapping, read/cache/font/history/persistence and UI acceptance remain pending.

Requires reviewed App>=0.2.51.dev0 and FontLab9 Python3.11 with fontlab-fly. Adapted from Simon Cozens' MIT Why You Not Compatible? See NOTICE and additional-tools.json for exact source and license provenance.

Run Reports > Why You Not Compatible from FontLab's Scripts menu.

Read installation and working with scripts before use.
